ex.en: Affordable nursery places allow more parents to return to work while their children receive professional care.

en: A person with deep knowledge of an academic subject.
vi: Học giả, nhà nghiên cứu chuyên sâu

ex.en: The scholar carefully examined an old book in the library.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "scholar" (Học giả, nhà nghiên cứu chuyên sâu) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Scholars increasingly argue that access to early education can reduce social inequality over the long term.

en: A large public meeting supporting a cause or expressing opinions.
vi: Cuộc mít tinh; sự tập hợp lại lực lượng

ex.en: Hundreds attended a peaceful rally in the town square.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "rally" (Cuộc mít tinh; sự tập hợp lại lực lượng) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Community leaders rallied support for a public library, arguing that free access to information benefits everyone.

en: The quality of staying similar in behaviour, standards, or results.
vi: Tính nhất quán, sự kiên định

ex.en: Our coach values consistency more than occasional brilliant performances.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "consistency" (Tính nhất quán, sự kiên định) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Greater consistency in marking standards would help ensure that students receive fair results across different examination centres.

en: a mention of someone or something
vi: Tài liệu tham khảo; sự dẫn chiếu

ex.en: Her speech included a warm reference to her grandmother.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "reference" (Tài liệu tham khảo; sự dẫn chiếu) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Academic essays should include accurate references so readers can locate the original sources of information.

en: The belief that good things will happen.
vi: Sự lạc quan, tinh thần tích cực

ex.en: Her optimism helped us stay cheerful during the storm.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "optimism" (Sự lạc quan, tinh thần tích cực) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Despite economic uncertainty, many graduates express optimism about their chances of finding meaningful employment.

en: A belief or rule that guides decisions and behaviour.
vi: Nguyên tắc cốt lõi, nguyên lý cơ bản

ex.en: I refused the extra money as a matter of principle.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "principle" (Nguyên tắc cốt lõi, nguyên lý cơ bản) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: The principle of equal opportunity should guide policies designed to improve access to higher education.

en: A group of flowers arranged together, usually as a gift.
vi: Bó hoa tươi trang trọng

ex.en: She brought a bright bouquet to her grandmother's birthday dinner.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "bouquet" (Bó hoa tươi trang trọng) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Choosing a bouquet of locally grown flowers can reduce the environmental impact associated with long-distance transport.

en: to put a plan or decision into action
vi: Triển khai, thi hành, áp dụng vào thực tế

ex.en: Our team will implement the new schedule next week.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "implement" (Triển khai, thi hành, áp dụng vào thực tế) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Governments should implement policies that make public transport more affordable for people on low incomes.

en: To make certain that something happens or is true
vi: Đảm bảo, chắc chắn rằng

ex.en: Please ensure that all windows are closed before leaving.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "ensure" (Đảm bảo, chắc chắn rằng) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Governments should ensure that affordable public transport is available to residents in both urban and rural areas.

en: A biological group whose members can usually breed with one another.
vi: Loài sinh vật (động vật hoặc thực vật)

ex.en: Several species of butterfly visit our garden each summer.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "species" (Loài sinh vật (động vật hoặc thực vật)) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Protecting natural habitats is essential for preventing the extinction of species threatened by human activity.

en: How much something happens or how far it reaches.
vi: Mức độ, phạm vi, quy mô

ex.en: We only discovered the extent of the leak yesterday.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "extent" (Mức độ, phạm vi, quy mô) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: The extent to which public transport reduces pollution depends on passenger numbers and energy sources.

en: a sharp, curved nail on an animal's foot
vi: Móng vuốt của động vật

ex.en: The cat caught my sleeve with one sharp claw.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "claw" (Móng vuốt của động vật) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Sharp claws help many predators catch prey, while other animals use them to climb or dig.

en: the early morning when daylight first appears
vi: Bình minh, lúc rạng đông; sự khởi đầu

ex.en: We left at dawn to avoid the heavy traffic.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "dawn" (Bình minh, lúc rạng đông; sự khởi đầu) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: The dawn of digital communication has transformed how people maintain relationships across national borders.

col: the dawn of a new era

en: Allowing light through so objects behind can be seen clearly.
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("transparent"): Allowing light through so objects behind can be seen clearly.

ex.en: She keeps her buttons in a transparent plastic box.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "transparent" (Từ vựng IELTS ("transparent"): Allowing light through so objects behind can be seen clearly.) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Public institutions need transparent recruitment procedures to ensure fairness and maintain the trust of local communities.

en: The way parents care for and teach a child
vi: Sự nuôi dạy, giáo dục từ thời thơ ấu

ex.en: Her upbringing taught her to share with others.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "upbringing" (Sự nuôi dạy, giáo dục từ thời thơ ấu) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: A supportive upbringing can help children develop confidence and cope more effectively with challenges at school.

en: The scientific study of the mind and behaviour.
vi: Tâm lý học

ex.en: My sister studies psychology and hopes to help children.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "psychology" (Tâm lý học) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Research in psychology suggests that regular social interaction can support emotional wellbeing among older adults.

en: A unit measuring heat energy or energy supplied by food.
vi: Calo (đơn vị đo năng lượng thực phẩm)

ex.en: I do not count every calory in my lunch.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "calory" (Calo (đơn vị đo năng lượng thực phẩm)) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Although calory intake matters, public health advice should also consider nutritional quality and access to fresh food.

en: a title introducing a section within a longer piece
vi: Tiêu đề phụ trong bài đọc

ex.en: This subheading helps me find the recipe's cooking instructions.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "subheading" (Tiêu đề phụ trong bài đọc) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Each subheading in a research report should clearly indicate the focus of the following section.

en: An amount that can be held in one hand.
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("handful"): An amount that can be held in one hand.

ex.en: He sprinkled a handful of nuts over his breakfast.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "handful" (Từ vựng IELTS ("handful"): An amount that can be held in one hand.) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Only a handful of rural communities have reliable public transport, limiting residents' access to employment and healthcare.

en: to obtain something from a particular source
vi: Bắt nguồn từ, chiết xuất từ

ex.en: I derive great pleasure from growing vegetables on my balcony.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "derive" (Bắt nguồn từ, chiết xuất từ) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Many coastal communities derive a significant proportion of their income from tourism and fishing.

en: Sharing a situation, activity, or status with someone
vi: Bạn đồng hành, đồng nghiệp nghiên cứu

ex.en: I shared my umbrella with a fellow passenger.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "fellow" (Bạn đồng hành, đồng nghiệp nghiên cứu) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Students who regularly exchange ideas with fellow learners often develop greater confidence and stronger communication skills.

en: To fall or let liquid fall in separate drops.
vi: Hành động / quá trình (drip): To fall or let liquid fall in separate drops.

ex.en: Water dripped from my umbrella onto the kitchen floor.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "drip" (Hành động / quá trình (drip): To fall or let liquid fall in separate drops.) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Leaking pipes can drip continuously, wasting substantial amounts of water in cities with ageing infrastructure.

en: Having little depth from the surface to the bottom
vi: Nông, cạn (mặt nước); hời hợt

ex.en: The children splashed happily in the shallow end of the pool.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "shallow" (Nông, cạn (mặt nước); hời hợt) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Shallow coastal waters provide important habitats for young fish, making their protection essential for sustainable fisheries.

en: to close and open one eye quickly as a signal
vi: Hành động / quá trình (wink): to close and open one eye quickly as a signal

ex.en: My sister winked at me across the dinner table.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "wink" (Hành động / quá trình (wink): to close and open one eye quickly as a signal) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: A friendly wink may communicate shared understanding, although its meaning can vary considerably across different cultures.

en: to eat growing grass, or let animals feed on it
vi: Gặm cỏ trên đồng (gia súc)

ex.en: Sheep graze quietly beside the river every summer morning.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "graze" (Gặm cỏ trên đồng (gia súc)) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Allowing cattle to graze too intensively can damage vegetation and increase the risk of soil erosion.

en: To become visible or known after being hidden.
vi: Nổi lên, xuất hiện, lộ diện

ex.en: A small rabbit emerged from beneath the garden shed.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "emerge" (Nổi lên, xuất hiện, lộ diện) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: New employment opportunities may emerge as governments invest more heavily in renewable energy infrastructure.

en: Not believing or acting as though you are better than others.
vi: Khiêm tốn, giản dị

ex.en: Despite winning the prize, she remained humble and thanked everyone.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "humble" (Khiêm tốn, giản dị) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Effective leaders remain humble enough to acknowledge mistakes and learn from colleagues with different backgrounds and experiences.

en: The work of organising and running an institution or business.
vi: Sự quản lý, ban quản trị, chính quyền

ex.en: She handles the administration for our local sports club.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "administration" (Sự quản lý, ban quản trị, chính quyền) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Efficient administration allows public hospitals to allocate resources fairly and respond more quickly to patients' needs.

en: a condition involving dependence on alcohol and difficulty controlling drinking
vi: Chứng nghiện rượu mãn tính

ex.en: The clinic offers confidential support for people with alcoholism.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "alcoholism" (Chứng nghiện rượu mãn tính) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Effective treatment for alcoholism often combines medical care, psychological support, and help from family members.

en: feeling that something good is likely to happen
vi: Đầy hy vọng, triển vọng tốt

ex.en: She felt hopeful after her first successful driving lesson.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "hopeful" (Đầy hy vọng, triển vọng tốt) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Scientists remain hopeful that improved battery technology will make renewable energy more reliable and affordable.

en: A woodwind instrument with a single reed and finger-operated keys.
vi: Kèn gỗ clarinet

ex.en: My sister practises the clarinet quietly after dinner.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "clarinet" (Kèn gỗ clarinet) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Learning to play the clarinet can help children develop concentration while encouraging participation in school orchestras.

en: a bird often associated with peace
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("dove"): a bird often associated with peace

ex.en: A white dove landed gently on our garden wall.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "dove" (Từ vựng IELTS ("dove"): a bird often associated with peace) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Political doves argue that international disputes should be resolved through negotiation rather than military intervention.

en: giving satisfaction or a sense of achievement
vi: Đáng giá, mang lại nhiều trải nghiệm bổ ích

ex.en: Teaching my little cousin to swim was surprisingly rewarding.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "rewarding" (Đáng giá, mang lại nhiều trải nghiệm bổ ích) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Volunteering can be a rewarding experience that develops practical skills and strengthens connections within local communities.

en: To order someone not to do something or disallow it
vi: Nghiêm cấm, không cho phép

ex.en: Our building rules forbid leaving bicycles in the hallway.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "forbid" (Nghiêm cấm, không cho phép) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Governments should forbid companies from releasing untreated waste into rivers to protect public health and aquatic ecosystems.

en: Better in quality or performance than another
vi: Vượt trội hơn, cấp cao hơn

ex.en: These boots offer superior grip on wet paths.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "superior" (Vượt trội hơn, cấp cao hơn) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Public transport can provide a superior alternative to private cars when services are frequent and reliable.

en: a feeling of very great surprise
vi: Sự kinh ngạc, sự sững sờ

ex.en: He stared in astonishment as the tiny seedling flowered.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "astonishment" (Sự kinh ngạc, sự sững sờ) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: The speed of technological change often causes astonishment, particularly among people who remember life before widespread internet access.

en: An escape of liquid or gas, or an opening allowing it.
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("leak"): An escape of liquid or gas, or an opening allowing it.

ex.en: A leak under the sink soaked all our cleaning cloths.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "leak" (Từ vựng IELTS ("leak"): An escape of liquid or gas, or an opening allowing it.) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Water companies should repair leaks promptly to conserve resources and reduce unnecessary pressure on local supplies.

en: A change made to improve something or suit a purpose.
vi: Sự điều chỉnh, sự sửa đổi cho phù hợp

ex.en: This small modification makes the chair much more comfortable.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "modification" (Sự điều chỉnh, sự sửa đổi cho phù hợp) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Modification of existing buildings can reduce energy consumption without the environmental costs of new construction.

en: a sale where an item goes to the highest bidder
vi: Buổi bán đấu giá

ex.en: My aunt bought this old clock at an auction.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "auction" (Buổi bán đấu giá) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Charities often auction donated artwork to raise funds for educational programmes in communities with limited resources.

en: The flat cutting part of a knife or tool.
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("blade"): The flat cutting part of a knife or tool.

ex.en: The knife's blade was too blunt to slice tomatoes.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "blade" (Từ vựng IELTS ("blade"): The flat cutting part of a knife or tool.) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Each blade of a wind turbine is designed to capture energy efficiently from moving air.

en: Unwilling to change your opinion or behaviour.
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("stubborn"): Unwilling to change your opinion or behaviour.

ex.en: My stubborn brother refused to wear a coat outside.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "stubborn" (Từ vựng IELTS ("stubborn"): Unwilling to change your opinion or behaviour.) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Stubborn resistance to change can prevent organisations from adopting more efficient and environmentally responsible practices.

en: Strong protective covering worn in battle or fitted to vehicles.
vi: Áo giáp bảo vệ thời cổ đại hoặc xe bọc thép

ex.en: The museum displayed a knight's armour beside a wooden shield.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "armour" (Áo giáp bảo vệ thời cổ đại hoặc xe bọc thép) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Surviving examples of medieval armour reveal how metalworking skills developed in response to changing military needs.

en: An informal word for a dollar.
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("buck"): An informal word for a dollar.

ex.en: I bought this warm scarf for just five bucks.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "buck" (Từ vựng IELTS ("buck"): An informal word for a dollar.) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Although shoppers may save a few bucks online, local retailers often provide more personalised advice and support.

en: deliberately inflicted severe pain, or an extremely distressing experience
vi: Sự tra tấn, sự hành hạ đau đớn

ex.en: Waiting all afternoon for the results was pure torture.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "torture" (Sự tra tấn, sự hành hạ đau đớn) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: International agreements prohibit torture and require governments to protect the basic rights of all prisoners.

en: enough to meet a need or achieve a purpose
vi: Đủ, đầy đủ

ex.en: We have sufficient food for everyone at the picnic.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "sufficient" (Đủ, đầy đủ) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Without sufficient funding, local authorities may struggle to maintain essential services for their growing populations.

en: a small soluble case containing medicine that you swallow
vi: Viên nang thuốc; khoang tàu vũ trụ

ex.en: The pharmacist told me to swallow the capsule with water.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "capsule" (Viên nang thuốc; khoang tàu vũ trụ) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: The space capsule was designed to protect its crew from extreme temperatures during their return to Earth.

en: The ability to understand something, especially language or ideas.
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("comprehension"): The ability to understand something, especially language or ideas.

ex.en: Drawing a simple diagram helped my comprehension of the instructions.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "comprehension" (Từ vựng IELTS ("comprehension"): The ability to understand something, especially language or ideas.) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Regular exposure to varied reading materials can improve students' comprehension and expand their academic vocabulary.

en: a short memorable phrase promoting an idea, group, or product
vi: Khẩu hiệu thương hiệu hoặc chiến dịch

ex.en: Our club chose a catchy slogan for its recycling campaign.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "slogan" (Khẩu hiệu thương hiệu hoặc chiến dịch) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: An effective environmental slogan can attract attention, but lasting behavioural change usually requires practical support.

en: wanting more money or possessions than one needs
vi: Tham lam

ex.en: Don't be greedy; leave some biscuits for your sister.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "greedy" (Tham lam) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Greedy investors may prioritise immediate profits over the long-term environmental consequences of their business decisions.

en: A house or other place where someone lives.
vi: Nơi cư trú, dinh thự, chỗ ở

ex.en: Their new residence overlooks a quiet garden near the river.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "residence" (Nơi cư trú, dinh thự, chỗ ở) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Applicants may need to provide proof of residence before they can access certain local services.

en: A large room used for formal social dancing
vi: Phòng khiêu vũ lớn

ex.en: Couples glided across the ballroom beneath a sparkling chandelier.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "ballroom" (Phòng khiêu vũ lớn) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Restoring the historic ballroom could attract visitors while providing local residents with a valuable space for cultural events.

en: Protected from direct sunlight.
vi: Râm mát, có bóng râm che phủ

ex.en: We found a shaded bench beneath an old tree.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "shaded" (Râm mát, có bóng râm che phủ) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Providing shaded areas in public parks encourages outdoor activity during hot weather and reduces heat exposure.

en: A large, strong bag used for storing or carrying things.
vi: Bao tải; sa thải khỏi công việc

ex.en: We carried a heavy sack of potatoes into the kitchen.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "sack" (Bao tải; sa thải khỏi công việc) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Employers should not sack workers without explaining the reasons and allowing them to challenge the decision.

en: The spiritual part of a person, separate from the body.
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("soul"): The spiritual part of a person, separate from the body.

ex.en: Walking beside the sea always seems to soothe my soul.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "soul" (Từ vựng IELTS ("soul"): The spiritual part of a person, separate from the body.) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Many cultural traditions view the soul as something that continues to exist after the body dies.

en: A solid whose particles form a regular, repeating pattern.
vi: Pha lê, tinh thể trong suốt

ex.en: We examined a salt crystal under the classroom microscope.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "crystal" (Pha lê, tinh thể trong suốt) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: The structure of a crystal influences its physical properties and determines its suitability for various industrial applications.

en: to choose someone for a position by voting

ex.en: The child poured tea for an imaginary friend.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "imaginary" (Từ vựng IELTS ("imaginary"): existing only in the mind, not in reality) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Creating imaginary worlds through storytelling can help children develop creativity and explore unfamiliar social situations safely.

en: Physical or mental pain experienced by people or animals.
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("suffering"): Physical or mental pain experienced by people or animals.

ex.en: The medicine eased her suffering and helped her sleep.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "suffering" (Từ vựng IELTS ("suffering"): Physical or mental pain experienced by people or animals.) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Improving access to clean water can reduce human suffering in communities affected by prolonged drought.

en: intended to be thrown away after use
vi: Dùng một lần rồi bỏ

ex.en: We packed disposable plates for the picnic by the lake.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "disposable" (Dùng một lần rồi bỏ) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Reducing the use of disposable packaging could significantly decrease the amount of waste sent to landfill.

en: A brownish metal made mainly from copper and tin.
vi: Đồng thiếc (hợp kim đồng); huy chương đồng

ex.en: The small statue is made of solid bronze.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "bronze" (Đồng thiếc (hợp kim đồng); huy chương đồng) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Ancient tools made from bronze reveal how advances in metalworking transformed agriculture and trade across early societies.

en: To try to find or obtain something.
vi: Hành động / quá trình (seek): To try to find or obtain something.

ex.en: You should seek advice before buying a used car.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "seek" (Hành động / quá trình (seek): To try to find or obtain something.) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Many graduates seek employment abroad to gain professional experience and develop their language skills.

en: An important victory or impressive achievement.
vi: Chiến thắng vang dội, thành tựu lớn

ex.en: Winning the local chess tournament was a triumph for Amir.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "triumph" (Chiến thắng vang dội, thành tựu lớn) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: The successful restoration of the wetland represents a triumph for conservation groups and local residents.

en: in a way that achieves the intended result
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("effectively"): in a way that achieves the intended result

ex.en: This simple brush cleans muddy shoes surprisingly effectively.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "effectively" (Từ vựng IELTS ("effectively"): in a way that achieves the intended result) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Schools can reduce waste effectively by encouraging students to reuse materials during classroom activities.

en: To become bigger or make something bigger.
vi: Hành động / quá trình (enlarge): To become bigger or make something bigger.

ex.en: Could you enlarge this photo so we can frame it?
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "enlarge" (Hành động / quá trình (enlarge): To become bigger or make something bigger.) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: The council plans to enlarge the public library to accommodate growing demand for quiet study spaces.

en: the bony structure of the head that protects the brain
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("skull"): the bony structure of the head that protects the brain

ex.en: The museum displayed the skull of a large dinosaur.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "skull" (Từ vựng IELTS ("skull"): the bony structure of the head that protects the brain) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Wearing a properly fitted helmet helps protect the skull and brain during cycling accidents.

en: a tool used to open bottles, cans, or other containers
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("opener"): a tool used to open bottles, cans, or other containers

ex.en: I keep the bottle opener in the kitchen drawer.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "opener" (Từ vựng IELTS ("opener"): a tool used to open bottles, cans, or other containers) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: The festival opener attracted a diverse audience, demonstrating the growing popularity of local cultural events.

en: a belief that something is wrong without definite proof
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("suspicion"): a belief that something is wrong without definite proof

ex.en: I had a suspicion that someone had moved my keys.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "suspicion" (Từ vựng IELTS ("suspicion"): a belief that something is wrong without definite proof) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: A lack of transparency can increase public suspicion of how government contracts are awarded.

en: the process of breaking down food so the body absorbs nutrients
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("digestion"): the process of breaking down food so the body absorbs nutrients

ex.en: Drinking enough water helps keep your digestion working well.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "digestion" (Từ vựng IELTS ("digestion"): the process of breaking down food so the body absorbs nutrients) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: A balanced diet supports healthy digestion and provides the nutrients needed for growth and daily activity.

en: the feeling that something is not as good as expected
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("dissatisfaction"): the feeling that something is not as good as expected

ex.en: He expressed his dissatisfaction with the cold meal politely.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "dissatisfaction" (Từ vựng IELTS ("dissatisfaction"): the feeling that something is not as good as expected) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Growing dissatisfaction with public transport has encouraged local authorities to review bus routes and fares.

en: The quality of being easy to understand or use.
vi: Sự đơn giản, tính dễ hiểu

ex.en: I love the simplicity of this easy vegetable soup recipe.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "simplicity" (Sự đơn giản, tính dễ hiểu) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: The simplicity of a digital service can determine whether older users feel confident accessing essential information independently.

en: A strong container used to store or transport goods.
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("crate"): A strong container used to store or transport goods.

ex.en: We carried a crate of apples into the kitchen.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "crate" (Từ vựng IELTS ("crate"): A strong container used to store or transport goods.) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Reusable plastic crates can reduce packaging waste when food suppliers establish reliable systems for collecting empty containers.

en: To injure a joint by twisting it too far.
vi: Hành động / quá trình (sprain): To injure a joint by twisting it too far.

ex.en: I sprained my ankle while running for the bus.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "sprain" (Hành động / quá trình (sprain): To injure a joint by twisting it too far.) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Athletes who sprain a joint should allow sufficient recovery time before returning to competitive sport.

en: an aromatic herb, or a sweet flavored with it
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("mint"): an aromatic herb, or a sweet flavored with it

ex.en: I added fresh mint to the lemon water.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "mint" (Từ vựng IELTS ("mint"): an aromatic herb, or a sweet flavored with it) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Growing herbs such as mint in urban gardens can provide fresh ingredients and encourage interest in food production.

en: A handled container for carrying liquids, or the amount it holds.
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("pail"): A handled container for carrying liquids, or the amount it holds.

ex.en: She carried a pail of water into the garden.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "pail" (Từ vựng IELTS ("pail"): A handled container for carrying liquids, or the amount it holds.) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: In villages without reliable plumbing, residents may carry drinking water home in a pail.

en: a government department responsible for a particular area
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("ministry"): a government department responsible for a particular area

ex.en: My aunt works at the ministry near the station.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "ministry" (Từ vựng IELTS ("ministry"): a government department responsible for a particular area) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: The education ministry should consult teachers before introducing major changes to the national school curriculum.

en: To show respect through a formal gesture, especially in the military.
vi: Hành động / quá trình (salute): To show respect through a formal gesture, especially in the military.

ex.en: The officer raised her hand to salute the captain.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "salute" (Hành động / quá trình (salute): To show respect through a formal gesture, especially in the military.) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Public ceremonies can salute the contributions of volunteers while encouraging more citizens to participate in community projects.

en: Extremely unpleasant, especially in smell or taste.
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("foul"): Extremely unpleasant, especially in smell or taste.

ex.en: A foul smell drifted from the forgotten rubbish bin.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "foul" (Từ vựng IELTS ("foul"): Extremely unpleasant, especially in smell or taste.) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Untreated industrial waste can foul rivers, threatening aquatic wildlife and the health of nearby communities.

en: extremely large in size or amount
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("gigantic"): extremely large in size or amount

ex.en: A gigantic pumpkin filled the entire kitchen table.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "gigantic" (Từ vựng IELTS ("gigantic"): extremely large in size or amount) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Building gigantic dams can generate renewable electricity, but it may also destroy habitats and displace local communities.

en: the regular rise and fall of the sea
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("tide"): the regular rise and fall of the sea

ex.en: At low tide, we walked across the exposed sand.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "tide" (Từ vựng IELTS ("tide"): the regular rise and fall of the sea) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Coastal planners must consider how rising sea levels and high tides could threaten homes and transport infrastructure.

en: extremely important or necessary
vi: Sống còn, thiết yếu

ex.en: A warm coat is vital on these freezing mornings.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "vital" (Sống còn, thiết yếu) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Reliable public transport plays a vital role in reducing urban congestion and improving access to employment.

en: not paid by the date when payment was required
vi: Quá hạn thanh toán

ex.en: I finally paid the past-due bill this morning.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "past-due" (Quá hạn thanh toán) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Financial counselling can help households manage past-due payments and avoid falling further into debt.

en: Having a rounded shape that is longer than it is wide.
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("oval"): Having a rounded shape that is longer than it is wide.

ex.en: She served the roast vegetables on an oval plate.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "oval" (Từ vựng IELTS ("oval"): Having a rounded shape that is longer than it is wide.) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: The proposed park includes an oval pond surrounded by native plants to provide habitats for local wildlife.

en: to make a disease disappear or someone healthy again
vi: Hành động / quá trình (cure): to make a disease disappear or someone healthy again

ex.en: The doctor said these tablets could cure the infection.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "cure" (Hành động / quá trình (cure): to make a disease disappear or someone healthy again) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Although medical research has advanced considerably, scientists have not yet found a cure for every disease.

en: A small gun designed to be held in one hand.
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("pistol"): A small gun designed to be held in one hand.

ex.en: The old pistol was displayed behind thick museum glass.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "pistol" (Từ vựng IELTS ("pistol"): A small gun designed to be held in one hand.) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Strict pistol storage requirements can reduce accidental injuries and improve safety in local communities.

en: Without paid employment, especially when wanting to work.
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("jobless"): Without paid employment, especially when wanting to work.

ex.en: She was jobless for months after the factory closed.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "jobless" (Từ vựng IELTS ("jobless"): Without paid employment, especially when wanting to work.) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Governments should offer affordable retraining programmes to help jobless workers adapt to changes in the labour market.

en: The work or study of recording and reporting financial transactions.
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("accounting"): The work or study of recording and reporting financial transactions.

ex.en: My sister studies accounting and helps with our shop's finances.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "accounting" (Từ vựng IELTS ("accounting"): The work or study of recording and reporting financial transactions.) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Accurate accounting enables businesses to monitor costs, meet legal requirements, and make informed financial decisions.

en: Much better or more impressive than usual.
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("extraordinary"): Much better or more impressive than usual.

ex.en: My grandmother has an extraordinary memory for people's birthdays.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "extraordinary" (Từ vựng IELTS ("extraordinary"): Much better or more impressive than usual.) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Recent advances in medical technology demonstrate the extraordinary potential of cooperation between scientists and engineers.

en: To catch up with and move ahead of someone.
vi: Hành động / quá trình (overtake): To catch up with and move ahead of someone.

ex.en: We waited for a safe gap to overtake the tractor.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "overtake" (Hành động / quá trình (overtake): To catch up with and move ahead of someone.) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Renewable energy could overtake fossil fuels as the main source of electricity in some countries.

en: To a limited degree; rather, but not very.
vi: Hành động / quá trình (somewhat): To a limited degree; rather, but not very.

ex.en: I felt somewhat nervous before my first driving lesson.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "somewhat" (Hành động / quá trình (somewhat): To a limited degree; rather, but not very.) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Although online learning offers flexibility, its effectiveness remains somewhat dependent on students' motivation and access to technology.

en: More powerful, influential, or noticeable than others.
vi: Chiếm ưu thế, thống trị

ex.en: Blue is the dominant colour in our living room.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "dominant" (Chiếm ưu thế, thống trị) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Private cars remain the dominant form of transport in cities with limited investment in public transport.

en: The light that reaches Earth from the moon.
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("moonlight"): The light that reaches Earth from the moon.

ex.en: Moonlight shone through the curtains onto my pillow.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "moonlight" (Từ vựng IELTS ("moonlight"): The light that reaches Earth from the moon.) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Artificial lighting can obscure natural moonlight, potentially affecting the behaviour of animals that are active at night.

en: To give someone the right to have or do something.
vi: Hành động / quá trình (entitle): To give someone the right to have or do something.

ex.en: This ticket entitles you to a free lunch.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "entitle" (Hành động / quá trình (entitle): To give someone the right to have or do something.) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Employment laws should entitle all workers to paid leave, regardless of the size of their organisation.

en: To slide accidentally, losing balance or leaving a position.
vi: Hành động / quá trình (slip): To slide accidentally, losing balance or leaving a position.

ex.en: I slipped on the wet floor but stayed upright.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "slip" (Hành động / quá trình (slip): To slide accidentally, losing balance or leaving a position.) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Hospitals should keep floors dry to reduce the risk of patients slipping and injuring themselves.

en: To become stronger or more complete, or make something so
vi: Hành động / quá trình (deepen): To become stronger or more complete, or make something so

ex.en: Sharing stories can deepen your friendship with someone.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "deepen" (Hành động / quá trình (deepen): To become stronger or more complete, or make something so) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: International exchange programmes can deepen students' understanding of other cultures and encourage greater respect for different perspectives.

en: Having no end or limit
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("infinite"): Having no end or limit

ex.en: My grandmother seems to have infinite patience with children.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "infinite" (Từ vựng IELTS ("infinite"): Having no end or limit) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Economic policies should not assume that the planet provides an infinite supply of natural resources.

en: A particular version of a book or other published work.
vi: Ấn bản, phiên bản xuất bản

ex.en: I bought the latest edition of this gardening guide.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "edition" (Ấn bản, phiên bản xuất bản) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: The revised edition of the textbook includes recent research on renewable energy and sustainable urban development.

en: To try very hard to do something difficult.
vi: Hành động / quá trình (struggle): To try very hard to do something difficult.

ex.en: I struggled to carry the heavy bags up the stairs.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "struggle" (Hành động / quá trình (struggle): To try very hard to do something difficult.) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Many young adults struggle to find affordable housing in cities where wages have not kept pace with rents.

en: Relating to a particular area within a country or world.
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("regional"): Relating to a particular area within a country or world.

ex.en: The market sells regional cheeses made in nearby villages.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "regional" (Từ vựng IELTS ("regional"): Relating to a particular area within a country or world.) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Regional differences in employment opportunities often encourage young adults to move from rural communities to larger cities.

en: able to be trusted to do what is needed
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("dependable"): able to be trusted to do what is needed

ex.en: My old bicycle is still dependable in wet weather.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "dependable" (Từ vựng IELTS ("dependable"): able to be trusted to do what is needed) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Dependable public transport enables workers to reach their workplaces consistently and reduces reliance on private cars.

en: not completely correct or exact
vi: Không chính xác, sai lệch số liệu

ex.en: The map was inaccurate, so we missed the turning.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "inaccurate" (Không chính xác, sai lệch số liệu) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Inaccurate information online can undermine public trust and lead people to make poorly informed decisions.

en: material made by weaving or knitting fibres
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("fabric"): material made by weaving or knitting fibres

ex.en: This soft fabric will make a comfortable summer dress.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "fabric" (Từ vựng IELTS ("fabric"): material made by weaving or knitting fibres) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Community centres strengthen the social fabric by bringing together residents from different cultural and economic backgrounds.

en: in a way that requires immediate action or attention
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("urgently"): in a way that requires immediate action or attention

ex.en: We urgently need a plumber to fix this leak.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "urgently" (Từ vựng IELTS ("urgently"): in a way that requires immediate action or attention) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Governments must urgently address water shortages through improved infrastructure and policies that encourage responsible consumption.

en: spoken rather than written
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("oral"): spoken rather than written

ex.en: Our teacher gave us oral feedback after each presentation.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "oral" (Từ vựng IELTS ("oral"): spoken rather than written) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Oral traditions preserve cultural knowledge in communities where historical events have rarely been recorded in writing.

en: very pleasant, enjoyable, or charming
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("delightful"): very pleasant, enjoyable, or charming

ex.en: We found a delightful little café beside the river.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "delightful" (Từ vựng IELTS ("delightful"): very pleasant, enjoyable, or charming) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Well-designed public gardens offer delightful spaces where residents can relax and develop stronger connections with their neighbourhood.

en: A long, narrow piece or area of something.
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("strip"): A long, narrow piece or area of something.

ex.en: Cut the paper into strips for our craft project.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "strip" (Từ vựng IELTS ("strip"): A long, narrow piece or area of something.) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Planting strips of wildflowers beside farmland can provide habitats for insects and support local biodiversity.

en: Based on personal feelings or opinions rather than independent facts
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("subjective"): Based on personal feelings or opinions rather than independent facts

ex.en: Taste is subjective, so choose whichever colour you prefer.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "subjective" (Từ vựng IELTS ("subjective"): Based on personal feelings or opinions rather than independent facts) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Although student feedback is valuable, subjective opinions should not be the sole basis for evaluating teaching quality.

en: the state of being impossible, or something that cannot happen
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("impossibility"): the state of being impossible, or something that cannot happen

ex.en: Carrying this sofa upstairs alone is an impossibility.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "impossibility" (Từ vựng IELTS ("impossibility"): the state of being impossible, or something that cannot happen) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: The impossibility of predicting every natural disaster highlights the importance of resilient infrastructure and emergency planning.

en: Not being used or doing any work.
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("idle"): Not being used or doing any work.

ex.en: The sewing machine has sat idle since last winter.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "idle" (Từ vựng IELTS ("idle"): Not being used or doing any work.) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Leaving delivery vehicles idling outside schools contributes to air pollution and exposes children to unnecessary health risks.

en: An established organisation serving an educational, financial, or public purpose.
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("institution"): An established organisation serving an educational, financial, or public purpose.

ex.en: My sister works at a respected institution near home.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "institution" (Từ vựng IELTS ("institution"): An established organisation serving an educational, financial, or public purpose.) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Every educational institution should provide accessible facilities and appropriate support for students with disabilities.

en: A wide, open container for water or washing.
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("basin"): A wide, open container for water or washing.

en: The activity of buying and selling goods and services.

ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "commerce" (Từ vựng IELTS ("commerce"): The activity of buying and selling goods and services.) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "appoint" (Hành động / quá trình (appoint): to officially choose someone for a job or responsibility) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

en: To fail to notice or consider something.

en: An organised list of items, often with descriptions or pictures

ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "catalogue" (Từ vựng IELTS ("catalogue"): An organised list of items, often with descriptions or pictures) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

en: Behaving immaturely in a way unsuitable for an adult.

ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "childish" (Từ vựng IELTS ("childish"): Behaving immaturely in a way unsuitable for an adult.) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

en: a row of closely planted bushes forming a boundary
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("hedge"): a row of closely planted bushes forming a boundary

ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "hedge" (Từ vựng IELTS ("hedge"): a row of closely planted bushes forming a boundary) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

en: Someone who steals from people's pockets or bags in public.
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("pickpocket"): Someone who steals from people's pockets or bags in public.

ex.en: A pickpocket took her wallet on the crowded bus.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "pickpocket" (Từ vựng IELTS ("pickpocket"): Someone who steals from people's pockets or bags in public.) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

en: the areas around the outer edge of a town or city

en: Making someone feel worried, upset, or uncomfortable.

ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "disturbing" (Từ vựng IELTS ("disturbing"): Making someone feel worried, upset, or uncomfortable.) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

en: A body part that performs a particular function.
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("organ"): A body part that performs a particular function.

ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "organ" (Từ vựng IELTS ("organ"): A body part that performs a particular function.) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

en: a long orchestral composition, usually divided into several movements

ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "symphony" (Bản giao hưởng) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

en: A fault that makes something imperfect or unable to work properly.

en: A difference or change in amount, level, form, or quality.

en: Great respect, or something that brings pride and privilege.

en: Say that something is not true or did not happen.

ex.en: No child should be denied access to education because their family cannot afford school fees.

en: a close connection between people or groups
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("bond"): a close connection between people or groups

ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "bond" (Từ vựng IELTS ("bond"): a close connection between people or groups) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

en: All the time, or repeatedly with very little interruption.

en: A judgement about something based on careful examination.

ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "assessment" (Từ vựng IELTS ("assessment"): A judgement about something based on careful examination.) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

en: a curved shape or route that returns to its starting point

en: loss of respect caused by unacceptable behaviour

ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "disgrace" (Từ vựng IELTS ("disgrace"): loss of respect caused by unacceptable behaviour) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

en: To take legal action against someone, usually seeking compensation.

en: to organize and carry out an activity

en: Recently, especially when describing something just done or begun.

en: Relating to the sea or organisms living in it

en: The act of identifying someone or something encountered before.

en: Added to what already exists or is available.

en: working together or helping by doing what is requested

ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "cooperating" (Từ vựng IELTS ("cooperating"): working together or helping by doing what is requested) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

en: an amount of a drug taken that exceeds safe limits

ex.en: Clear packaging and professional advice can reduce the risk of accidental overdose among patients taking several medicines.

en: Not too expensive for someone to pay for.

en: the way parts of a space or page are arranged

ex.en: Solar panels convert sunlight into electricity, allowing households to reduce their dependence on fossil fuels.

en: the business or process of transporting goods
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("shipping"): the business or process of transporting goods

ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "shipping" (Từ vựng IELTS ("shipping"): the business or process of transporting goods) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

en: An insect with long back legs used for jumping.

ex.en: Grasshoppers provide food for many birds and play an important role in maintaining healthy grassland ecosystems.

en: Reach the end of an officially allowed or valid period.

en: a shaped container in which a material sets into shape

ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "mold" (Từ vựng IELTS ("mold"): a shaped container in which a material sets into shape) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

en: A large area of sea partly surrounded by land.

col: the gulf between rich and poor

en: Lasting forever, without an end.

ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "marble" (Đá cẩm thạch) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Although marble enhances the appearance of public buildings, extracting it can damage surrounding landscapes and habitats.

en: The courage to face danger, pain, or difficult situations.
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("bravery"): The courage to face danger, pain, or difficult situations.

ex.en: The little girl showed bravery during her first injection.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "bravery" (Từ vựng IELTS ("bravery"): The courage to face danger, pain, or difficult situations.) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Emergency workers demonstrate remarkable bravery when they enter dangerous areas to rescue people after natural disasters.

en: One of the parts that together form a whole.
vi: Thành phần cấu tạo, linh kiện

ex.en: The technician replaced a broken component inside my laptop.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "component" (Thành phần cấu tạo, linh kiện) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Reliable public transport is a key component of urban planning that aims to reduce traffic congestion.

en: The day or evening before a special day or event.
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("Eve"): The day or evening before a special day or event.

ex.en: We cooked a special dinner together on New Year's Eve.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "Eve" (Từ vựng IELTS ("Eve"): The day or evening before a special day or event.) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: On New Year's Eve, cities often extend public transport services to help large crowds travel home safely.

en: in the past, but not now
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("formerly"): in the past, but not now

ex.en: This bright café was formerly a small bicycle shop.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "formerly" (Từ vựng IELTS ("formerly"): in the past, but not now) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Buildings formerly used for manufacturing can be converted into affordable housing while preserving their distinctive architectural features.

en: to push roughly or put something somewhere carelessly
vi: Hành động / quá trình (shove): to push roughly or put something somewhere carelessly

ex.en: I shoved my gloves into my bag and hurried outside.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "shove" (Hành động / quá trình (shove): to push roughly or put something somewhere carelessly) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Passengers may shove one another when overcrowded stations lack effective systems for managing queues during peak hours.

en: the art and process of making objects from fired clay
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("ceramics"): the art and process of making objects from fired clay

ex.en: I started learning ceramics at a local studio.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "ceramics" (Từ vựng IELTS ("ceramics"): the art and process of making objects from fired clay) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Traditional ceramics can attract tourists while providing a reliable source of income for local craftspeople.

en: the protection of wildlife and natural environments
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("conservation"): the protection of wildlife and natural environments

ex.en: Our class joined a conservation project to protect local frogs.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "conservation" (Từ vựng IELTS ("conservation"): the protection of wildlife and natural environments) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Successful wildlife conservation requires cooperation between local communities, researchers, and governments over many years.

en: To leave your country to live permanently in another
vi: Di cư sang định cư ở nước khác

ex.en: Her grandparents emigrated to Canada when they were young.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "emigrate" (Di cư sang định cư ở nước khác) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Skilled workers may emigrate when their home countries offer limited opportunities for professional development.

en: The ability to notice sounds through your ears.
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("hearing"): The ability to notice sounds through your ears.

ex.en: My grandfather's hearing improved after he received a hearing aid.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "hearing" (Từ vựng IELTS ("hearing"): The ability to notice sounds through your ears.) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: A public hearing allows residents to express concerns before major construction projects receive official approval.

en: To combine separate parts so they work together effectively.
vi: Hội nhập, tích hợp

ex.en: This app integrates my calendar with my shopping list.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "integrate" (Hội nhập, tích hợp) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Schools should integrate digital tools into classroom activities while ensuring that all students have equal access.

en: Having a smoothly bending shape rather than a straight one.
vi: Uốn cong, có hình vòng cung

ex.en: A curved path leads from our gate to the pond.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "curved" (Uốn cong, có hình vòng cung) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Curved building designs can create distinctive urban landmarks, although they may require more complex construction techniques.

en: A movable panel that covers and protects a window
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("shutter"): A movable panel that covers and protects a window

ex.en: I closed the wooden shutters before the storm arrived.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "shutter" (Từ vựng IELTS ("shutter"): A movable panel that covers and protects a window) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Photographers use a fast shutter speed to capture moving wildlife clearly without disturbing its natural behaviour.

en: The work of checking and grading students' answers.
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("marking"): The work of checking and grading students' answers.

ex.en: The teacher finished her marking before cooking dinner.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "marking" (Từ vựng IELTS ("marking"): The work of checking and grading students' answers.) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Clear marking guidelines help ensure that students receive fair grades regardless of who assesses their work.

en: Permission to enter a place or join an institution
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("admission"): Permission to enter a place or join an institution

ex.en: Admission to the museum is free on Sundays.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "admission" (Từ vựng IELTS ("admission"): Permission to enter a place or join an institution) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: University admission should reflect academic potential rather than simply rewarding access to expensive private education.

en: Available only to a particular person or group.
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("exclusive"): Available only to a particular person or group.

ex.en: Guests have exclusive use of the pool this afternoon.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "exclusive" (Từ vựng IELTS ("exclusive"): Available only to a particular person or group.) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Giving one company exclusive rights to public data may restrict competition and discourage innovation.

en: A person's worth and right to be treated with respect.
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("dignity"): A person's worth and right to be treated with respect.

ex.en: The nurse protected his dignity by closing the curtain.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "dignity" (Từ vựng IELTS ("dignity"): A person's worth and right to be treated with respect.) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Care services should preserve the dignity of older people by respecting their privacy and personal choices.

en: Specific methods used to achieve a goal or gain an advantage.
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("tactics"): Specific methods used to achieve a goal or gain an advantage.

ex.en: Our coach changed tactics halfway through the football match.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "tactics" (Từ vựng IELTS ("tactics"): Specific methods used to achieve a goal or gain an advantage.) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Companies increasingly use digital marketing tactics to attract younger consumers and compete in crowded markets.

en: to complain in an annoyed, often quiet way
vi: Hành động / quá trình (grumble): to complain in an annoyed, often quiet way

ex.en: My brother grumbled about washing the dishes again.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "grumble" (Hành động / quá trình (grumble): to complain in an annoyed, often quiet way) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Although commuters often grumble about delays, many still prefer public transport because it reduces travel costs.

en: The soft tissue between the skin and bones.
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("flesh"): The soft tissue between the skin and bones.

ex.en: The ripe peach had sweet flesh and a small stone.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "flesh" (Từ vựng IELTS ("flesh"): The soft tissue between the skin and bones.) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Fruits with brightly coloured flesh often contain nutrients that contribute to a healthy, balanced diet.

en: An instrument that makes very small objects appear much larger.
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("microscope"): An instrument that makes very small objects appear much larger.

ex.en: We examined a drop of pond water under the microscope.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "microscope" (Từ vựng IELTS ("microscope"): An instrument that makes very small objects appear much larger.) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Using a microscope allows students to observe cell structures that are invisible to the naked eye.

en: No longer worried because something unpleasant has ended or been avoided
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("relieved"): No longer worried because something unpleasant has ended or been avoided

ex.en: I felt relieved when I finally found my keys.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "relieved" (Từ vựng IELTS ("relieved"): No longer worried because something unpleasant has ended or been avoided) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Residents were relieved to hear that the local hospital would remain open despite proposed budget cuts.

en: Providing basic information or presenting something for the first time.
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("introductory"): Providing basic information or presenting something for the first time.

ex.en: I joined an introductory pottery class last weekend.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "introductory" (Từ vựng IELTS ("introductory"): Providing basic information or presenting something for the first time.) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Universities should offer introductory courses in data analysis to students from all academic disciplines.

en: Continue an activity or move to its next stage.
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("proceed"): Continue an activity or move to its next stage.

ex.en: We can proceed with dinner once everyone arrives.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "proceed" (Từ vựng IELTS ("proceed"): Continue an activity or move to its next stage.) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Local authorities should consult residents before they proceed with major changes to public transport.

en: To think something is likely true without being certain.
vi: Hành động / quá trình (suspect): To think something is likely true without being certain.

ex.en: I suspect the cat knocked the cup off the table.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "suspect" (Hành động / quá trình (suspect): To think something is likely true without being certain.) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Researchers suspect that prolonged screen use may affect sleep quality, although further evidence is needed.

en: most important among several things
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("principal"): most important among several things

ex.en: Our principal reason for moving was the noisy traffic.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "principal" (Từ vựng IELTS ("principal"): most important among several things) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: The principal challenge facing urban planners is providing affordable housing without reducing access to green spaces.

en: Disagree with something and try to prevent or change it.
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("oppose"): Disagree with something and try to prevent or change it.

ex.en: Our neighbours oppose building a road through the park.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "oppose" (Từ vựng IELTS ("oppose"): Disagree with something and try to prevent or change it.) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Many residents oppose airport expansion because they fear increased noise and damage to local wildlife habitats.

en: In the same way, or also.
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("likewise"): In the same way, or also.

ex.en: I folded my umbrella, and my sister did likewise.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "likewise" (Từ vựng IELTS ("likewise"): In the same way, or also.) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Public libraries provide free internet access; likewise, community centres help residents develop essential digital skills.

en: Described a certain way, though that description may be doubtful.
vi: Cái gọi là (thường mang hàm ý nghi ngờ)

ex.en: This so-called waterproof jacket let the rain straight through.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "so-called" (Cái gọi là (thường mang hàm ý nghi ngờ)) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Consumers should examine whether so-called green products actually reduce environmental harm throughout their life cycle.

en: Relating to pictures, drawings, or visual design.
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("graphic"): Relating to pictures, drawings, or visual design.

ex.en: My cousin studies graphic design and makes colourful posters.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "graphic" (Từ vựng IELTS ("graphic"): Relating to pictures, drawings, or visual design.) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Effective graphic design can make complex health information easier for the general public to understand.

en: A device orbiting Earth or another body, collecting or transmitting information.
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("satellite"): A device orbiting Earth or another body, collecting or transmitting information.

ex.en: The satellite sent back clear pictures of the storm.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "satellite" (Từ vựng IELTS ("satellite"): A device orbiting Earth or another body, collecting or transmitting information.) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Satellite observations allow scientists to monitor changes in forest cover across remote regions over time.

en: to stop resisting and accept another side's control
vi: Hành động / quá trình (surrender): to stop resisting and accept another side's control

ex.en: The soldiers surrendered and walked forward with empty hands.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "surrender" (Hành động / quá trình (surrender): to stop resisting and accept another side's control) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Users should not have to surrender control of their personal information to access essential online services.

en: Careful examination of something to understand its parts or meaning
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("analysis"): Careful examination of something to understand its parts or meaning

ex.en: A soil analysis showed why my plants were struggling.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "analysis" (Từ vựng IELTS ("analysis"): Careful examination of something to understand its parts or meaning) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Careful analysis of travel patterns can help planners design more efficient public transport networks.

en: Almost not, or only just
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("scarcely"): Almost not, or only just

ex.en: We could scarcely hear each other above the music.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "scarcely" (Từ vựng IELTS ("scarcely"): Almost not, or only just) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Some rural communities have scarcely enough medical staff to provide basic healthcare for their growing populations.

en: Carefully judge the quality, value or effectiveness of something
vi: Đánh giá, định giá

ex.en: We evaluated three cameras before choosing one for our trip.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "evaluate" (Đánh giá, định giá) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Governments should evaluate the long-term environmental effects of major construction projects before approving them.

en: a seat without a back or arms
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("stool"): a seat without a back or arms

ex.en: She pulled up a stool beside the kitchen counter.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "stool" (Từ vựng IELTS ("stool"): a seat without a back or arms) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Doctors may examine a stool sample to identify infections that cannot be diagnosed through symptoms alone.

en: To move around an area regularly to maintain safety.
vi: Hành động / quá trình (patrol): To move around an area regularly to maintain safety.

ex.en: Two guards patrol the park after dark each evening.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "patrol" (Hành động / quá trình (patrol): To move around an area regularly to maintain safety.) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Rangers patrol protected forests to prevent illegal logging and monitor threats to endangered wildlife.

en: a speech sound involving blocked airflow, or its written symbol
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("consonant"): a speech sound involving blocked airflow, or its written symbol

ex.en: Try saying the final consonant slowly and clearly.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "consonant" (Từ vựng IELTS ("consonant"): a speech sound involving blocked airflow, or its written symbol) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Learners may struggle to pronounce consonant clusters that do not occur in their first language.

en: a long piece of cloth displaying a message or design
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("banner"): a long piece of cloth displaying a message or design

ex.en: We hung a colourful banner above the garden gate.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "banner" (Từ vựng IELTS ("banner"): a long piece of cloth displaying a message or design) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Many news websites rely on banner advertising to provide free access to their articles.

en: Happening or appearing before the thing being discussed.
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("preceding"): Happening or appearing before the thing being discussed.

ex.en: I slept badly on the night preceding my interview.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "preceding" (Từ vựng IELTS ("preceding"): Happening or appearing before the thing being discussed.) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: The survey revealed that household energy consumption had fallen significantly compared with the preceding year.

en: An assurance or message that an arrangement is definite.
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("confirmation"): An assurance or message that an arrangement is definite.

ex.en: The hotel sent confirmation of our booking this morning.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "confirmation" (Từ vựng IELTS ("confirmation"): An assurance or message that an arrangement is definite.) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Independent confirmation of research findings is essential before governments use them to guide public health policy.

en: Based on clear reasoning, with ideas that fit together sensibly.
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("logical"): Based on clear reasoning, with ideas that fit together sensibly.

ex.en: Taking the bus seemed logical because parking was expensive.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "logical" (Từ vựng IELTS ("logical"): Based on clear reasoning, with ideas that fit together sensibly.) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Students should learn to construct logical arguments rather than simply memorise facts for examinations.

en: An effort to do something, especially something difficult.
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("attempt"): An effort to do something, especially something difficult.

ex.en: My first attempt at baking bread was surprisingly successful.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "attempt" (Từ vựng IELTS ("attempt"): An effort to do something, especially something difficult.) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Many cities are attempting to reduce air pollution by improving public transport and expanding cycling networks.

en: The part of a cooker or heater that produces heat
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("burner"): The part of a cooker or heater that produces heat

ex.en: She turned off the burner after the soup boiled.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "burner" (Từ vựng IELTS ("burner"): The part of a cooker or heater that produces heat) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Replacing inefficient gas burners with cleaner cooking technology can reduce indoor air pollution and improve health.

col: put something on the back burner

en: The sloping surface of a hill.
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("hillside"): The sloping surface of a hill.

ex.en: Small white houses dotted the hillside above the village.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "hillside" (Từ vựng IELTS ("hillside"): The sloping surface of a hill.) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Planting native trees on a bare hillside can reduce soil erosion and provide habitats for wildlife.

en: the ability to make sensible decisions after considering information
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("judgement"): the ability to make sensible decisions after considering information

ex.en: I trust your judgement when choosing a reliable bicycle.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "judgement" (Từ vựng IELTS ("judgement"): the ability to make sensible decisions after considering information) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Schools should teach students to exercise independent judgement when evaluating information from unfamiliar online sources.

en: Contrary to accepted principles of right and wrong.
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("immoral"): Contrary to accepted principles of right and wrong.

ex.en: She thought keeping the lost wallet would be immoral.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "immoral" (Từ vựng IELTS ("immoral"): Contrary to accepted principles of right and wrong.) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Many consumers consider it immoral for companies to exploit vulnerable workers in pursuit of higher profits.

en: All the actors appearing in a film or play.
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("cast"): All the actors appearing in a film or play.

ex.en: The entire cast came outside to greet the audience.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "cast" (Từ vựng IELTS ("cast"): All the actors appearing in a film or play.) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Directors who cast actors from diverse backgrounds can help challenge stereotypes and broaden audiences' understanding of society.

en: a device that slows or stops a moving vehicle
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("brake"): a device that slows or stops a moving vehicle

ex.en: I squeezed the brakes as my bicycle reached the corner.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "brake" (Từ vựng IELTS ("brake"): a device that slows or stops a moving vehicle) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Drivers should brake gently on wet roads to reduce the risk of losing control.

en: officially recommend a medicine or treatment as a medical professional
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("prescribe"): officially recommend a medicine or treatment as a medical professional

ex.en: The doctor prescribed eye drops for my sore eyes.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "prescribe" (Từ vựng IELTS ("prescribe"): officially recommend a medicine or treatment as a medical professional) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Doctors should prescribe antibiotics only when necessary to reduce the risk of bacteria developing resistance.

en: someone who rents out property or land to others
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("landlord"): someone who rents out property or land to others

ex.en: Our landlord came over to fix the leaking tap.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "landlord" (Từ vựng IELTS ("landlord"): someone who rents out property or land to others) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Local authorities should require landlords to maintain safe living conditions for all their tenants.

en: not strong, clear or easy to notice
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("faint"): not strong, clear or easy to notice

ex.en: A faint light shone through the bedroom curtains.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "faint" (Từ vựng IELTS ("faint"): not strong, clear or easy to notice) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Astronomers use powerful telescopes to detect faint objects that cannot be seen with the naked eye.

en: Extremely foolish, unreasonable, or dangerous.
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("insane"): Extremely foolish, unreasonable, or dangerous.

ex.en: Driving through that storm would be an insane risk.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "insane" (Từ vựng IELTS ("insane"): Extremely foolish, unreasonable, or dangerous.) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Critics described the proposal as insane because its enormous costs would outweigh any potential benefits.

en: money spent or needed for a particular purpose
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("expense"): money spent or needed for a particular purpose

ex.en: Rent is our biggest expense every single month.

en: A glass or plastic device that produces electric light.
