en: to risk money on an uncertain result hoping to win more
vi: Hành động / quá trình (gamble): to risk money on an uncertain result hoping to win more

ex.en: He refuses to gamble because he values his savings.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "gamble" (Hành động / quá trình (gamble): to risk money on an uncertain result hoping to win more) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Relying entirely on tourism is a gamble for regions vulnerable to extreme weather and changing travel patterns.

en: To live in a particular place or environment
vi: Hành động / quá trình (inhabit): To live in a particular place or environment

ex.en: Tiny crabs inhabit the rock pools near our house.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "inhabit" (Hành động / quá trình (inhabit): To live in a particular place or environment) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Many species that inhabit tropical forests face increasing pressure as agricultural expansion reduces the area of suitable habitat.

en: to practise a performance or activity before doing it publicly
vi: Hành động / quá trình (rehearse): to practise a performance or activity before doing it publicly

ex.en: We rehearsed our dance in the empty school hall.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "rehearse" (Hành động / quá trình (rehearse): to practise a performance or activity before doing it publicly) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Students who rehearse their presentations with classmates often develop greater confidence and communicate their ideas more clearly.

en: the outer edge of a place or group
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("fringe"): the outer edge of a place or group

ex.en: Their cottage stands on the fringe of the forest.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "fringe" (Từ vựng IELTS ("fringe"): the outer edge of a place or group) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Affordable housing on the urban fringe often leaves residents dependent on cars for their daily journeys.

en: Behaviour or situations that are extremely foolish, wild, or chaotic
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("craziness"): Behaviour or situations that are extremely foolish, wild, or chaotic

ex.en: We needed a quiet walk after the craziness of moving.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "craziness" (Từ vựng IELTS ("craziness"): Behaviour or situations that are extremely foolish, wild, or chaotic) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: The apparent craziness of paying enormous prices for fashionable goods reflects the powerful influence of advertising.

en: To represent someone or something in words or images
vi: Hành động / quá trình (portray): To represent someone or something in words or images

ex.en: Her paintings portray village life in warm colours.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "portray" (Hành động / quá trình (portray): To represent someone or something in words or images) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: News reports often portray urban life as stressful, overlooking the social and cultural opportunities cities provide.

en: A bank employee who handles customers' money
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("teller"): A bank employee who handles customers' money

ex.en: The teller counted the cash and handed me a receipt.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "teller" (Từ vựng IELTS ("teller"): A bank employee who handles customers' money) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Although online banking is convenient, bank tellers remain important for customers who need personal assistance.

en: legally unable to pay the debts you owe
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("bankrupt"): legally unable to pay the debts you owe

ex.en: The little furniture shop went bankrupt last winter.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "bankrupt" (Từ vựng IELTS ("bankrupt"): legally unable to pay the debts you owe) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Small businesses may go bankrupt if rising energy costs are combined with a prolonged decline in consumer demand.

en: bad luck or an unlucky event that causes difficulty
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("misfortune"): bad luck or an unlucky event that causes difficulty

ex.en: We had the misfortune to miss the last train.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "misfortune" (Từ vựng IELTS ("misfortune"): bad luck or an unlucky event that causes difficulty) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Strong community networks can help families recover from financial misfortune without becoming isolated from society.

en: having an empty space inside
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("hollow"): having an empty space inside

ex.en: We found a squirrel hiding inside a hollow tree.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "hollow" (Từ vựng IELTS ("hollow"): having an empty space inside) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Government promises to protect endangered species will remain hollow unless they are supported by adequate funding and effective enforcement.

en: Having faults or lacking something needed to be complete.
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("imperfect"): Having faults or lacking something needed to be complete.

ex.en: This handmade bowl is imperfect, but I love its shape.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "imperfect" (Từ vựng IELTS ("imperfect"): Having faults or lacking something needed to be complete.) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Although the current recycling system is imperfect, it still reduces the amount of waste sent to landfill.

en: Happening through another person, action, or stage
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("indirect"): Happening through another person, action, or stage

ex.en: This plant grows best in bright but indirect sunlight.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "indirect" (Từ vựng IELTS ("indirect"): Happening through another person, action, or stage) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Tourism provides indirect benefits to local farmers by increasing demand for fresh food in restaurants.

en: someone chosen to speak or act for other people
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("representative"): someone chosen to speak or act for other people

ex.en: Our class representative asked for more books in the library.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "representative" (Từ vựng IELTS ("representative"): someone chosen to speak or act for other people) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Researchers need a representative sample to draw reliable conclusions about the wider population.

en: In a way that appears true but may not be.
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("seemingly"): In a way that appears true but may not be.

ex.en: The seemingly empty box had a kitten inside.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "seemingly" (Từ vựng IELTS ("seemingly"): In a way that appears true but may not be.) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Seemingly minor changes in daily travel habits can significantly reduce a city's overall carbon emissions.

en: The particular words chosen to express something.
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("wording"): The particular words chosen to express something.

ex.en: The wording of your message sounds a little formal.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "wording" (Từ vựng IELTS ("wording"): The particular words chosen to express something.) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Careful wording in public health announcements can prevent confusion and encourage people to follow advice.

en: The way a surface or substance feels or looks.
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("texture"): The way a surface or substance feels or looks.

ex.en: This blanket has a soft texture that feels lovely.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "texture" (Từ vựng IELTS ("texture"): The way a surface or substance feels or looks.) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: The texture of recycled materials can influence whether consumers find sustainable products attractive.

en: Happening or existing at the beginning
vi: Ban đầu, khởi đầu

ex.en: My initial excitement faded when I saw the price.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "initial" (Ban đầu, khởi đầu) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Although the initial cost of solar panels is high, households may save money over the longer term.

en: Nutrients such as sugars and starches that provide the body energy
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("carbohydrates"): Nutrients such as sugars and starches that provide the body energy

ex.en: Rice and potatoes provide carbohydrates that fuel your daily activities.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "carbohydrates" (Từ vựng IELTS ("carbohydrates"): Nutrients such as sugars and starches that provide the body energy) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: A balanced diet includes carbohydrates, proteins, and fats in proportions suited to individual nutritional needs.

en: The outside surface or appearance of something.
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("exterior"): The outside surface or appearance of something.

ex.en: They painted the exterior of their house pale blue.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "exterior" (Từ vựng IELTS ("exterior"): The outside surface or appearance of something.) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Improving a building's exterior can protect it from weather damage while preserving its historical character.

en: able to produce original ideas, or showing this ability
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("imaginative"): able to produce original ideas, or showing this ability

ex.en: My imaginative niece turned empty boxes into a spaceship.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "imaginative" (Từ vựng IELTS ("imaginative"): able to produce original ideas, or showing this ability) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Schools should encourage imaginative thinking rather than require students to memorise every detail of a textbook.

en: A return to health or a normal condition.
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("recovery"): A return to health or a normal condition.

ex.en: Her recovery was slow, but she could walk again.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "recovery" (Từ vựng IELTS ("recovery"): A return to health or a normal condition.) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Economic recovery depends partly on restoring consumer confidence and supporting small businesses through difficult periods.

en: in or to another place
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("elsewhere"): in or to another place

ex.en: This café is full, so let's eat elsewhere.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "elsewhere" (Từ vựng IELTS ("elsewhere"): in or to another place) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: When local housing becomes unaffordable, young workers often move elsewhere in search of better living conditions.

en: Physical injury or damage to someone's wellbeing or something's condition.
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("harm"): Physical injury or damage to someone's wellbeing or something's condition.

ex.en: Too much sunlight can harm the leaves of this plant.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "harm" (Từ vựng IELTS ("harm"): Physical injury or damage to someone's wellbeing or something's condition.) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Stricter controls on industrial waste could reduce the harm caused to rivers and protect local wildlife.

en: Birds such as chickens kept for their meat or eggs.
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("poultry"): Birds such as chickens kept for their meat or eggs.

ex.en: My aunt keeps poultry in a spacious backyard enclosure.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "poultry" (Từ vựng IELTS ("poultry"): Birds such as chickens kept for their meat or eggs.) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Higher welfare standards for poultry can improve animal health, although they may increase production costs.

en: strange or unusual, sometimes in an unpleasant way
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("peculiar"): strange or unusual, sometimes in an unpleasant way

ex.en: A peculiar smell came from the cupboard under the stairs.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "peculiar" (Từ vựng IELTS ("peculiar"): strange or unusual, sometimes in an unpleasant way) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Some environmental challenges are peculiar to coastal cities, including saltwater intrusion and damage caused by storm surges.

en: Bend or rest against something in a sloping position.
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("lean"): Bend or rest against something in a sloping position.

ex.en: She leaned against the wall and untied her shoes.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "lean" (Từ vựng IELTS ("lean"): Bend or rest against something in a sloping position.) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Lean production methods can help manufacturers reduce waste while maintaining the quality of their products.

en: A state of extreme physical or mental tiredness.
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("exhaustion"): A state of extreme physical or mental tiredness.

ex.en: After the long hike, he fell asleep from exhaustion.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "exhaustion" (Từ vựng IELTS ("exhaustion"): A state of extreme physical or mental tiredness.) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Persistent exhaustion among healthcare workers can reduce the quality of patient care and increase staff turnover.

en: a short official announcement or report of recent news
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("bulletin"): a short official announcement or report of recent news

ex.en: We heard the weather bulletin during breakfast today.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "bulletin" (Từ vựng IELTS ("bulletin"): a short official announcement or report of recent news) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Local authorities should issue regular bulletins during severe weather so that residents can make informed safety decisions.

en: The amount of work someone must complete within a particular period.
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("workload"): The amount of work someone must complete within a particular period.

ex.en: My workload doubled when two colleagues went on holiday.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "workload" (Từ vựng IELTS ("workload"): The amount of work someone must complete within a particular period.) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Employers should monitor staff workload carefully to prevent stress and maintain the quality of their services.

en: A quality that is typical of a person or thing.
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("characteristic"): A quality that is typical of a person or thing.

ex.en: One striking characteristic of this cat is its curly fur.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "characteristic" (Từ vựng IELTS ("characteristic"): A quality that is typical of a person or thing.) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: The ability to adapt quickly is an important characteristic of successful businesses in a changing economy.

en: A business that arranges services for people or other businesses.
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("agency"): A business that arranges services for people or other businesses.

ex.en: The travel agency booked our flights and hotel.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "agency" (Từ vựng IELTS ("agency"): A business that arranges services for people or other businesses.) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: A national environmental agency should monitor industrial pollution and ensure that factories comply with safety regulations.

en: Only if a particular condition is met.
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("provided"): Only if a particular condition is met.

ex.en: You can borrow my bike provided you return it tonight.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "provided" (Từ vựng IELTS ("provided"): Only if a particular condition is met.) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Remote working can improve employee satisfaction, provided that organisations offer adequate technical support and clear communication channels.

en: a business selling large quantities of goods mainly to retailers
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("wholesaler"): a business selling large quantities of goods mainly to retailers

ex.en: Our local wholesaler delivers fresh fruit to shops every morning.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "wholesaler" (Từ vựng IELTS ("wholesaler"): a business selling large quantities of goods mainly to retailers) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Small retailers often depend on a wholesaler to obtain goods at competitive prices.

en: To a certain degree compared with something else.
vi: Hành động / quá trình (relatively): To a certain degree compared with something else.

ex.en: The kitchen is relatively small, but it feels bright.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "relatively" (Hành động / quá trình (relatively): To a certain degree compared with something else.) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Cycling is a relatively inexpensive form of transport that can reduce congestion in crowded cities.

en: A stay in a local family's home while visiting another place
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("homestay"): A stay in a local family's home while visiting another place

ex.en: During my homestay, I cooked dinner with the family.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "homestay" (Từ vựng IELTS ("homestay"): A stay in a local family's home while visiting another place) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: A homestay can help international students practise everyday language skills and understand local customs.

en: To move up and down repeatedly, or make something move.
vi: Hành động / quá trình (flap): To move up and down repeatedly, or make something move.

ex.en: The ducks flapped their wings and splashed across the pond.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "flap" (Hành động / quá trình (flap): To move up and down repeatedly, or make something move.) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Observing how birds flap their wings can help engineers develop more efficient designs for small flying robots.

en: a list of people or organisations with their contact details
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("directory"): a list of people or organisations with their contact details

ex.en: I found a nearby plumber in the local directory.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "directory" (Từ vựng IELTS ("directory"): a list of people or organisations with their contact details) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: An online directory of community services can help new residents locate essential support more easily.

en: A part pushed with the foot to operate something.
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("pedal"): A part pushed with the foot to operate something.

ex.en: My foot slipped off the pedal in the rain.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "pedal" (Từ vựng IELTS ("pedal"): A part pushed with the foot to operate something.) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: More residents would pedal to work if cities provided safer cycling routes and secure bicycle parking.

en: only, and nothing more or more important
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("merely"): only, and nothing more or more important

ex.en: I wasn't complaining; I was merely asking a question.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "merely" (Từ vựng IELTS ("merely"): only, and nothing more or more important) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Building more roads merely shifts traffic problems elsewhere unless governments also invest in reliable public transport.

en: To officially leave a job or position.
vi: Hành động / quá trình (resign): To officially leave a job or position.

ex.en: She decided to resign and open a small bakery.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "resign" (Hành động / quá trình (resign): To officially leave a job or position.) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Employees may resign when excessive workloads and limited career opportunities make their positions increasingly difficult to sustain.

en: a large heavy gun that fires powerful projectiles
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("cannon"): a large heavy gun that fires powerful projectiles

ex.en: An old cannon stood beside the castle entrance.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "cannon" (Từ vựng IELTS ("cannon"): a large heavy gun that fires powerful projectiles) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: The introduction of cannon changed military architecture, encouraging the construction of thicker walls and lower defensive structures.

en: The act of refusing to accept someone or something.
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("rejection"): The act of refusing to accept someone or something.

ex.en: After another rejection, she revised her job application.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "rejection" (Từ vựng IELTS ("rejection"): The act of refusing to accept someone or something.) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Repeated rejection in the labour market can damage young people's confidence and discourage further job applications.

en: An activity involving skill in making things by hand
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("craft"): An activity involving skill in making things by hand

ex.en: My neighbour teaches the craft of weaving willow baskets.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "craft" (Từ vựng IELTS ("craft"): An activity involving skill in making things by hand) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Traditional craft workshops can preserve cultural knowledge while creating employment opportunities in rural communities.

en: A noticeable smell, especially a pleasant one.
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("scent"): A noticeable smell, especially a pleasant one.

ex.en: The scent of fresh bread filled the kitchen.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "scent" (Từ vựng IELTS ("scent"): A noticeable smell, especially a pleasant one.) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: The scent of flowers can attract pollinators, helping many plant species reproduce and maintain healthy ecosystems.

en: showing strong moral qualities and concern for others
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("noble"): showing strong moral qualities and concern for others

ex.en: Helping strangers without expecting rewards is a noble act.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "noble" (Từ vựng IELTS ("noble"): showing strong moral qualities and concern for others) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Although reducing poverty is a noble goal, effective policies require sustained funding and careful evaluation.

en: unfair treatment based on someone's identity or personal characteristics
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("discrimination"): unfair treatment based on someone's identity or personal characteristics

ex.en: She reported age discrimination after losing a job opportunity.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "discrimination" (Từ vựng IELTS ("discrimination"): unfair treatment based on someone's identity or personal characteristics) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Stronger laws against discrimination can help ensure that all citizens have equal access to employment.

en: a medieval soldier of high rank who fought on horseback
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("knight"): a medieval soldier of high rank who fought on horseback

ex.en: The painting shows a knight riding towards a castle.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "knight" (Từ vựng IELTS ("knight"): a medieval soldier of high rank who fought on horseback) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Museum displays about the medieval knight can help students understand how warfare shaped European society.

en: the region including Australia, New Zealand, and many Pacific islands
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("Oceania"): the region including Australia, New Zealand, and many Pacific islands

ex.en: Our neighbour travelled around Oceania with a small backpack.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "Oceania" (Từ vựng IELTS ("Oceania"): the region including Australia, New Zealand, and many Pacific islands) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Many island communities in Oceania face growing risks from rising sea levels and increasingly severe storms.

en: Materials used to wrap and protect products.
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("packaging"): Materials used to wrap and protect products.

ex.en: This toy comes with far too much plastic packaging.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "packaging" (Từ vựng IELTS ("packaging"): Materials used to wrap and protect products.) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Manufacturers should reduce unnecessary packaging to conserve resources and limit the amount of household waste.

en: To suggest something without stating it directly.
vi: Ngụ ý, hàm ý

ex.en: Are you trying to imply that my cooking is bad?
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "imply" (Ngụ ý, hàm ý) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Higher spending on education does not necessarily imply better outcomes unless resources are allocated effectively.

en: A fungus used to make bread rise and produce alcohol.
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("yeast"): A fungus used to make bread rise and produce alcohol.

ex.en: Add the yeast once the water feels slightly warm.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "yeast" (Từ vựng IELTS ("yeast"): A fungus used to make bread rise and produce alcohol.) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Scientists use yeast to study basic cellular processes because it grows quickly under controlled laboratory conditions.

en: Something that briefly stops an activity, conversation, or continuous process.
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("interruption"): Something that briefly stops an activity, conversation, or continuous process.

ex.en: Sorry for the interruption, but your taxi is here.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "interruption" (Từ vựng IELTS ("interruption"): Something that briefly stops an activity, conversation, or continuous process.) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Frequent interruptions in open offices can reduce concentration and make complex tasks take longer to complete.

en: a person who studies how language works
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("linguist"): a person who studies how language works

ex.en: The linguist recorded my grandmother telling an old story.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "linguist" (Từ vựng IELTS ("linguist"): a person who studies how language works) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Linguists can support endangered languages by documenting local speech and helping communities develop teaching materials.

en: Relating to the region around the North Pole.

en: Genuine or traditional, rather than copied or invented

en: A particular way of considering a situation or issue.

ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "vacuum" (Từ vựng IELTS ("vacuum"): A space without air, or a gap left by something missing.) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

en: Worried about someone or something.

ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "concerned" (Từ vựng IELTS ("concerned"): Worried about someone or something.) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Residents are increasingly concerned about air pollution and want local authorities to improve public transport.

col: as far as I am concerned

en: In a way that expresses what you genuinely feel.

en: A scientist who studies matter, energy, and their interactions.

ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "physicist" (Từ vựng IELTS ("physicist"): A scientist who studies matter, energy, and their interactions.) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Physicists contribute to medical progress by developing imaging technologies that help doctors examine the human body.

en: Someone who watches an event, especially a sporting event.

en: Movement around a central point or axis

ex.en: Crop rotation helps farmers maintain soil fertility and reduce their reliance on chemical pesticides.

en: Worry or nervousness about something uncertain or threatening.

en: Better or more suitable than another option.

en: To state exactly what is required or meant.

en: a small pin or post used to hang or secure things

en: A building material made from cement, water, sand, and stones.

en: Feeling, expressing, or causing great happiness.

en: Created by computers or experienced through an online connection.

en: The way someone deals with a situation, task, or person.

ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "handling" (Từ vựng IELTS ("handling"): The way someone deals with a situation, task, or person.) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

en: a condition caused by harmful organisms entering the body

ex.en: Improved sanitation can reduce the risk of infection, particularly in communities with limited access to clean water.

en: to work together to achieve a shared aim

en: Being male, female, or another identity, especially socially and culturally.

ex.en: Our guide gave us a briefing before the hike.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "briefing" (Từ vựng IELTS ("briefing"): a meeting or explanation giving essential information or instructions) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: A clear safety briefing helps construction workers understand potential hazards before they begin unfamiliar tasks.

en: Containing many things packed closely together
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("dense"): Containing many things packed closely together

ex.en: Dense fog hid the bridge from our kitchen window.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "dense" (Từ vựng IELTS ("dense"): Containing many things packed closely together) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Dense urban development can reduce travel distances, but it requires careful planning to preserve green spaces.

en: Worth having or doing because it offers benefits.
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("desirable"): Worth having or doing because it offers benefits.

ex.en: A balcony makes this small flat much more desirable.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "desirable" (Từ vựng IELTS ("desirable"): Worth having or doing because it offers benefits.) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Although economic growth is desirable, governments should also consider its effects on public health and the environment.

en: Unable to protect yourself or change a difficult situation
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("helpless"): Unable to protect yourself or change a difficult situation

ex.en: I felt helpless when the lift suddenly stopped moving.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "helpless" (Từ vựng IELTS ("helpless"): Unable to protect yourself or change a difficult situation) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Without accessible support services, elderly people may feel helpless when trying to manage increasingly complex digital systems.

en: Certain to happen and impossible to prevent
vi: Tất yếu, không thể tránh khỏi

ex.en: With traffic this heavy, a delay seems inevitable.
ex.vi: Tự động hóa dẫn đến sự thay đổi cơ cấu việc làm là điều tất yếu trong kỷ nguyên số.

ex.en: Some job losses may be inevitable as factories introduce machines that perform routine tasks more efficiently.
ex.vi: Xung đột lợi ích giữa phát triển công nghiệp và bảo tồn thiên nhiên không phải lúc nào cũng là điều không thể tránh khỏi.

col: inevitable consequence — hệ quả tất yếu
seem inevitable — dường như không thể tránh khỏi
tip: Cụm "an inevitable consequence of..." giúp lập luận nguyên nhân - kết quả rất thuyết phục.

en: To become lighter or make something lighter or more colourful.
vi: Hành động / quá trình (brighten): To become lighter or make something lighter or more colourful.

ex.en: These yellow curtains really brighten our small kitchen.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "brighten" (Hành động / quá trình (brighten): To become lighter or make something lighter or more colourful.) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Planting colourful flowers can brighten neglected public spaces and encourage residents to take greater pride in their neighbourhood.

en: a social group sharing ancestry, traditions, and community ties
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("tribe"): a social group sharing ancestry, traditions, and community ties

ex.en: The guide belongs to a tribe from this valley.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "tribe" (Từ vựng IELTS ("tribe"): a social group sharing ancestry, traditions, and community ties) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Development projects should respect the land rights and cultural traditions of local tribes.

en: Draw attention to something important or especially noticeable.
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("highlight"): Draw attention to something important or especially noticeable.

ex.en: The boat ride was the highlight of our holiday.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "highlight" (Từ vựng IELTS ("highlight"): Draw attention to something important or especially noticeable.) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Recent studies highlight the importance of accessible green spaces for the physical and mental health of urban residents.

en: Willing to take risks or act with confidence.
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("bold"): Willing to take risks or act with confidence.

ex.en: She made a bold decision to open her own bakery.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "bold" (Từ vựng IELTS ("bold"): Willing to take risks or act with confidence.) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Governments need bold policies to address housing shortages while protecting green spaces and supporting affordable development.

en: The likelihood that something will happen.
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("odds"): The likelihood that something will happen.

ex.en: The odds of finding my keys here are low.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "odds" (Từ vựng IELTS ("odds"): The likelihood that something will happen.) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Access to affordable healthcare can improve the odds of recovery for patients with chronic illnesses.

en: the act of working together towards a shared goal
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("cooperation"): the act of working together towards a shared goal

ex.en: Cleaning the shared kitchen requires cooperation from everyone.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "cooperation" (Từ vựng IELTS ("cooperation"): the act of working together towards a shared goal) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: International cooperation is essential for addressing environmental problems that extend beyond the borders of individual countries.

en: a small part or amount of something
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("fraction"): a small part or amount of something

ex.en: This jacket costs a fraction of the original price.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "fraction" (Từ vựng IELTS ("fraction"): a small part or amount of something) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Only a small fraction of household waste is recycled in some rapidly growing cities.

en: the ability to change or adapt to different needs
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("flexibility"): the ability to change or adapt to different needs

ex.en: This job gives me flexibility to collect my daughter.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "flexibility" (Từ vựng IELTS ("flexibility"): the ability to change or adapt to different needs) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Greater flexibility in working hours can help employees balance professional responsibilities with family commitments.

en: A flexible strip attached to a handle, used for striking.
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("whip"): A flexible strip attached to a handle, used for striking.

ex.en: An old leather whip hung beside the stable door.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "whip" (Từ vựng IELTS ("whip"): A flexible strip attached to a handle, used for striking.) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: During practical lessons, culinary students learn to whip cream and prepare healthier alternatives to commercial desserts.

en: express disapproval of someone or something
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("criticize"): express disapproval of someone or something

ex.en: Please don't criticize my cooking before you taste it.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "criticize" (Từ vựng IELTS ("criticize"): express disapproval of someone or something) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Many residents criticize the council for prioritizing road construction over improvements to public transport.

en: The act or state of finishing something.
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("completion"): The act or state of finishing something.

ex.en: Our kitchen renovation is finally nearing completion this week.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "completion" (Từ vựng IELTS ("completion"): The act or state of finishing something.) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: The completion of the new railway is expected to improve access to employment in rural communities.

en: words or ideas that are absurd or have no meaning
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("nonsense"): words or ideas that are absurd or have no meaning

ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "nonsense" (Từ vựng IELTS ("nonsense"): words or ideas that are absurd or have no meaning) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Schools should teach students to distinguish reliable evidence from nonsense circulated through social media platforms.

en: A school providing training in a particular subject or skill.
vi: Học viện đào tạo chuyên sâu

ex.en: She attends a dance academy near the station.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "academy" (Học viện đào tạo chuyên sâu) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: A well-funded arts academy can provide talented young people with training they could not otherwise afford.

en: To judge an approximate amount, value, or size.
vi: Hành động / quá trình (estimate): To judge an approximate amount, value, or size.

ex.en: We estimate the repairs will take about three days.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "estimate" (Hành động / quá trình (estimate): To judge an approximate amount, value, or size.) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Researchers estimate that improved public transport could significantly reduce the number of cars entering city centres.

en: Someone who judges and discusses artistic works professionally.
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("critic"): Someone who judges and discusses artistic works professionally.

ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "critic" (Từ vựng IELTS ("critic"): Someone who judges and discusses artistic works professionally.) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Critics of urban expansion argue that new developments often destroy valuable habitats and increase car dependence.

en: important or unusual enough to deserve attention
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("notable"): important or unusual enough to deserve attention

ex.en: Her balcony is notable for its bright yellow flowers.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "notable" (Từ vựng IELTS ("notable"): important or unusual enough to deserve attention) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: The city has achieved a notable reduction in air pollution since introducing stricter vehicle standards.

en: a yellow chemical element used in industry and agriculture
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("sulphur"): a yellow chemical element used in industry and agriculture

ex.en: The guide showed us yellow sulphur near the volcano.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "sulphur" (Từ vựng IELTS ("sulphur"): a yellow chemical element used in industry and agriculture) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Burning fuels containing sulphur releases gases that contribute to acid rain and damage natural ecosystems.

en: Accept responsibility for a task and begin doing it
vi: Đảm nhận, thực hiện (nhiệm vụ, nghiên cứu)

ex.en: We undertook the repairs ourselves to save money.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "undertake" (Đảm nhận, thực hiện (nhiệm vụ, nghiên cứu)) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Universities should undertake further research before recommending major changes to national education policy.

en: to emerge from an egg, or cause this to happen
vi: Hành động / quá trình (hatch): to emerge from an egg, or cause this to happen

ex.en: We watched three chicks hatch on the farm yesterday.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "hatch" (Hành động / quá trình (hatch): to emerge from an egg, or cause this to happen) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Rising temperatures can affect when turtle eggs hatch, potentially reducing the survival chances of young turtles.

en: A small citrus fruit with green skin and sour juice.
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("lime"): A small citrus fruit with green skin and sour juice.

ex.en: She squeezed a lime over the warm rice.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "lime" (Từ vựng IELTS ("lime"): A small citrus fruit with green skin and sour juice.) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Farmers may apply lime to acidic soils to improve growing conditions and increase crop productivity.

en: in or to a foreign country
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("overseas"): in or to a foreign country

ex.en: My cousin moved overseas and calls us every weekend.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "overseas" (Từ vựng IELTS ("overseas"): in or to a foreign country) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Studying overseas can broaden students' perspectives, although adapting to a different culture often takes time.

en: To move to another country to live there permanently.
vi: Hành động / quá trình (immigrate): To move to another country to live there permanently.

ex.en: Her grandparents immigrated to Canada and opened a bakery.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "immigrate" (Hành động / quá trình (immigrate): To move to another country to live there permanently.) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: People who immigrate often contribute valuable skills to their host countries while adapting to unfamiliar social customs.

en: to make the short, loud sound of a dog
vi: Hành động / quá trình (bark): to make the short, loud sound of a dog

ex.en: Our dog barks whenever someone knocks on the door.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "bark" (Hành động / quá trình (bark): to make the short, loud sound of a dog) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: The bark of mature trees provides shelter for insects and helps protect the trunk from damage.

en: The clearing of forests by cutting down trees.
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("deforestation"): The clearing of forests by cutting down trees.

ex.en: Deforestation has left the hillside bare and dusty.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "deforestation" (Từ vựng IELTS ("deforestation"): The clearing of forests by cutting down trees.) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Reducing deforestation can protect wildlife habitats and help limit the effects of climate change.

en: Someone employed to help people in a public place.
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("attendant"): Someone employed to help people in a public place.

ex.en: The flight attendant brought an extra blanket for my daughter.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "attendant" (Từ vựng IELTS ("attendant"): Someone employed to help people in a public place.) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Cities must consider population growth and its attendant pressures when planning new public transport networks.

en: deep sadness caused by loss or disappointment
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("sorrow"): deep sadness caused by loss or disappointment

ex.en: She felt deep sorrow when her closest friend moved away.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "sorrow" (Từ vựng IELTS ("sorrow"): deep sadness caused by loss or disappointment) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Community support can help people cope with sorrow after the loss of a loved one.

en: A short journey made for pleasure, often with a group.
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("excursion"): A short journey made for pleasure, often with a group.

ex.en: We packed sandwiches for our excursion to the lake.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "excursion" (Từ vựng IELTS ("excursion"): A short journey made for pleasure, often with a group.) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: School excursions to nature reserves can deepen students' understanding of local wildlife and conservation.

en: to prevent a device or feature from working
vi: Hành động / quá trình (disable): to prevent a device or feature from working

ex.en: I disabled notifications so my phone stayed quiet during dinner.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "disable" (Hành động / quá trình (disable): to prevent a device or feature from working) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Users should be able to disable location tracking without losing access to essential digital services.

en: to remember something from the past
vi: Hành động / quá trình (recall): to remember something from the past

ex.en: I still recall the smell of my grandmother's kitchen.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "recall" (Hành động / quá trình (recall): to remember something from the past) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Manufacturers should recall faulty products promptly to protect consumers and maintain public trust in safety standards.

en: Extremely beautiful, grand, or impressive.
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("magnificent"): Extremely beautiful, grand, or impressive.

ex.en: The balcony offers a magnificent view of snowy mountains.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "magnificent" (Từ vựng IELTS ("magnificent"): Extremely beautiful, grand, or impressive.) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Preserving magnificent historic buildings can strengthen local identity and attract visitors from other regions.

en: A feeling of gratitude for someone's help or kindness.
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("appreciation"): A feeling of gratitude for someone's help or kindness.

ex.en: We baked our neighbour a cake to show our appreciation.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "appreciation" (Từ vựng IELTS ("appreciation"): A feeling of gratitude for someone's help or kindness.) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Arts education can develop students' appreciation of cultural traditions that differ from their own.

en: a heavy load, difficult duty, or source of worry
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("burden"): a heavy load, difficult duty, or source of worry

ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "burden" (Từ vựng IELTS ("burden"): a heavy load, difficult duty, or source of worry) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Affordable childcare can reduce the financial burden on families and help parents return to work.

en: to the degree needed for a particular purpose
vi: Hành động / quá trình (sufficiently): to the degree needed for a particular purpose

ex.en: The soup had cooled sufficiently for us to eat.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "sufficiently" (Hành động / quá trình (sufficiently): to the degree needed for a particular purpose) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Public transport must be sufficiently reliable to persuade commuters to leave their cars at home.

en: To shake rapidly with small movements, or cause this movement.
vi: Hành động / quá trình (vibrate): To shake rapidly with small movements, or cause this movement.

ex.en: My phone vibrated against the keys in my pocket.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "vibrate" (Hành động / quá trình (vibrate): To shake rapidly with small movements, or cause this movement.) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Heavy traffic can cause nearby buildings to vibrate, affecting residents' comfort and potentially damaging older structures.

en: an edible oval nut, or the tree that produces it
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("almond"): an edible oval nut, or the tree that produces it

ex.en: She sprinkled chopped almonds over her bowl of porridge.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "almond" (Từ vựng IELTS ("almond"): an edible oval nut, or the tree that produces it) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Almond production requires substantial irrigation in some regions, raising concerns about the sustainability of local water supplies.

en: A boy or young man, especially in informal British English.
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("lad"): A boy or young man, especially in informal British English.

ex.en: A friendly lad helped us carry the bags.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "lad" (Từ vựng IELTS ("lad"): A boy or young man, especially in informal British English.) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: As a young lad, the novelist experienced rural poverty, which later became a central theme in his work.

en: a condition that disrupts normal physical or mental functioning
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("disorder"): a condition that disrupts normal physical or mental functioning

ex.en: A sleep disorder kept him awake most nights.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "disorder" (Từ vựng IELTS ("disorder"): a condition that disrupts normal physical or mental functioning) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Early treatment of anxiety disorders can improve students' wellbeing and help them participate more fully in education.

en: to move to another region, seasonally or to live there
vi: Hành động / quá trình (migrate): to move to another region, seasonally or to live there

ex.en: These birds migrate south when the weather turns cold.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "migrate" (Hành động / quá trình (migrate): to move to another region, seasonally or to live there) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Many young adults migrate to urban areas because employment opportunities are often limited in rural communities.

en: relating to collective ownership and more equal distribution of wealth
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("socialist"): relating to collective ownership and more equal distribution of wealth

ex.en: Our reading group discussed socialist ideas over tea.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "socialist" (Từ vựng IELTS ("socialist"): relating to collective ownership and more equal distribution of wealth) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Socialist policies often seek to reduce economic inequality through public ownership and the redistribution of wealth.

en: A large sea animal with a hard shell and claws.
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("lobster"): A large sea animal with a hard shell and claws.

ex.en: We watched a lobster crawl across the rocky seabed.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "lobster" (Từ vựng IELTS ("lobster"): A large sea animal with a hard shell and claws.) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Restrictions on lobster fishing can protect marine ecosystems while supporting the long-term livelihoods of coastal communities.

en: A particular part of an economy or area of activity.
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("sector"): A particular part of an economy or area of activity.

ex.en: My sister works in the banking sector now.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "sector" (Từ vựng IELTS ("sector"): A particular part of an economy or area of activity.) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Investment in the renewable energy sector can create jobs while reducing dependence on imported fossil fuels.

en: the act or ceremony of placing a dead body underground
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("burial"): the act or ceremony of placing a dead body underground

ex.en: The family gathered quietly for the burial yesterday.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "burial" (Từ vựng IELTS ("burial"): the act or ceremony of placing a dead body underground) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Ancient burial sites provide valuable evidence about the beliefs and social structures of past communities.

en: A comfortable level of heat.
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("warmth"): A comfortable level of heat.

ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "warmth" (Từ vựng IELTS ("warmth"): A comfortable level of heat.) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: The warmth of community relationships can help older residents feel supported and reduce their sense of isolation.

en: a unit used to measure power
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("watt"): a unit used to measure power

ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "watt" (Từ vựng IELTS ("watt"): a unit used to measure power) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Comparing the watts required by different appliances helps consumers choose models that use less electricity.

en: limited in amount, range, or freedom
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("restricted"): limited in amount, range, or freedom

ex.en: Parking is restricted here during the busy morning hours.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "restricted" (Từ vựng IELTS ("restricted"): limited in amount, range, or freedom) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Restricted access to affordable healthcare can worsen existing inequalities between wealthy communities and disadvantaged rural populations.

en: Something that takes your attention away from your main activity

ex.en: The television is a distraction when I do homework.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "distraction" (Từ vựng IELTS ("distraction"): Something that takes your attention away from your main activity) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Reducing digital distractions in classrooms may help students concentrate and engage more deeply with challenging material.

en: A small change made to improve something.
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("adjustment"): A small change made to improve something.

ex.en: A small adjustment to the seat made cycling easier.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "adjustment" (Từ vựng IELTS ("adjustment"): A small change made to improve something.) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Moving to a new country often requires considerable adjustment to unfamiliar social customs and daily routines.

en: Stealing from a person or place using force or threats.

ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "pessimistic" (Từ vựng IELTS ("pessimistic"): Expecting bad results or focusing on possible problems.) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: I finished my coursework before meeting friends for lunch.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "coursework" (Từ vựng IELTS ("coursework"): Work completed during a course, often contributing to final assessment.) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Assessing students through coursework can provide a broader picture of their abilities than relying solely on examinations.

en: extremely important to the success or outcome of something

ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "crucial" (Then chốt, cực kỳ quan trọng) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "demolish" (Hành động / quá trình (demolish): To completely destroy a building or other structure.) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Cities should consider restoring historic buildings rather than demolishing them to make space for new developments.

en: An expert paid to provide specialist advice.
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("consultant"): An expert paid to provide specialist advice.

ex.en: We hired a consultant to help improve our small business.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "consultant" (Từ vựng IELTS ("consultant"): An expert paid to provide specialist advice.) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: An environmental consultant can help companies reduce waste while ensuring that their operations comply with national regulations.

en: to control equipment, or to work as a machine
vi: Hành động / quá trình (operate): to control equipment, or to work as a machine

ex.en: Can you show me how to operate this printer?
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "operate" (Hành động / quá trình (operate): to control equipment, or to work as a machine) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

en: a person or animal that spends time with someone
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("companion"): a person or animal that spends time with someone

ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "companion" (Từ vựng IELTS ("companion"): a person or animal that spends time with someone) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

en: Feeling or showing extreme anger.

en: to make a hole through something with a sharp object

ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "pierce" (Hành động / quá trình (pierce): to make a hole through something with a sharp object) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Powerful artificial lights pierce the darkness around coastal developments, potentially disturbing the behaviour of nesting birds.

en: a step taken when walking, or the sound it makes

ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "footstep" (Từ vựng IELTS ("footstep"): a step taken when walking, or the sound it makes) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

en: Heavy earth that can be shaped when wet and baked hard.

en: To make something longer, larger, or wider in scope

ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "extend" (Hành động / quá trình (extend): To make something longer, larger, or wider in scope) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "pest" (Từ vựng IELTS ("pest"): An insect or animal that damages crops, food, or property.) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

en: Arrange financial protection against loss, damage, illness, or injury.

ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "insure" (Từ vựng IELTS ("insure"): Arrange financial protection against loss, damage, illness, or injury.) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

en: A ship or vehicle that has been badly damaged.

en: To discover or establish something through examination.

ex.en: Researchers must determine whether smaller classes improve learning outcomes before governments invest heavily in additional teaching staff.

en: The final result of an action, event, or process.
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("outcome"): The final result of an action, event, or process.

ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "outcome" (Từ vựng IELTS ("outcome"): The final result of an action, event, or process.) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Early access to medical care can improve health outcomes for children in disadvantaged communities.

en: a group of large animals living or moving together
vi: Đàn gia súc lớn (bò, voi, ngựa)

ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "herd" (Đàn gia súc lớn (bò, voi, ngựa)) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Protecting migration routes allows herds of wild animals to reach essential sources of food and water.

en: A small device designed to perform a particular useful task
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("gadget"): A small device designed to perform a particular useful task

ex.en: This handy gadget removes apple cores in seconds.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "gadget" (Từ vựng IELTS ("gadget"): A small device designed to perform a particular useful task) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Although a new electronic gadget may offer convenience, frequent replacement contributes to growing amounts of electronic waste.

en: The state of being awake and aware of your surroundings
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("consciousness"): The state of being awake and aware of your surroundings

ex.en: He regained consciousness shortly after the ambulance arrived.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "consciousness" (Từ vựng IELTS ("consciousness"): The state of being awake and aware of your surroundings) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Environmental education can raise public consciousness of how everyday consumption affects natural resources and biodiversity.

en: Accepted rules of polite behaviour in particular social situations.
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("etiquette"): Accepted rules of polite behaviour in particular social situations.

ex.en: My aunt taught me basic table etiquette before dinner.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "etiquette" (Từ vựng IELTS ("etiquette"): Accepted rules of polite behaviour in particular social situations.) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Learning local etiquette can help international students avoid misunderstandings and build stronger relationships with their hosts.

en: to make a very loud, deep sound
vi: Hành động / quá trình (roar): to make a very loud, deep sound

ex.en: The lion roared, and its cubs huddled closer together.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "roar" (Hành động / quá trình (roar): to make a very loud, deep sound) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Aircraft engines roar above nearby homes, exposing residents to noise pollution that can affect sleep quality.

en: a thin thread forming part of a material or tissue
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("fibre"): a thin thread forming part of a material or tissue

ex.en: A loose fibre was sticking out of my scarf.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "fibre" (Từ vựng IELTS ("fibre"): a thin thread forming part of a material or tissue) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: A diet rich in fibre can support digestive health and help people feel full for longer.

en: Examining similarities or differences between two or more things.

ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "comparative" (Từ vựng IELTS ("comparative"): Examining similarities or differences between two or more things.) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

en: To bring back a previous condition, ability, or situation.

ex.en: Planting native trees can help restore damaged ecosystems and provide essential habitats for local wildlife.

en: the second of two people or things already mentioned
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("latter"): the second of two people or things already mentioned

ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "latter" (Từ vựng IELTS ("latter"): the second of two people or things already mentioned) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

en: goods carried by a ship, aircraft, or other large vehicle

en: very strong or extreme in degree

ex.en: Intense competition for university places can place considerable psychological pressure on students during their final school year.

en: Not responsible for a crime or wrongdoing.
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("innocent"): Not responsible for a crime or wrongdoing.

ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "innocent" (Từ vựng IELTS ("innocent"): Not responsible for a crime or wrongdoing.) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

en: to break down naturally, or cause something to do so

en: An amount recorded as money taken from a bank account.

en: The outer parts of a town or city; usually plural

ex.en: Building affordable housing on the outskirts can reduce costs but may increase residents' dependence on cars.

en: a paved outdoor area beside a house for sitting or eating
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("patio"): a paved outdoor area beside a house for sitting or eating

ex.en: We ate breakfast on the patio beside the roses.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "patio" (Từ vựng IELTS ("patio"): a paved outdoor area beside a house for sitting or eating) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: A shaded patio can provide residents with a comfortable outdoor space during the warmer months.

en: Someone whose job is recording a business's financial transactions.

ex.en: Our bookkeeper checks the receipts every Friday afternoon.

en: not restricted in amount, number, or extent
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("unlimited"): not restricted in amount, number, or extent

ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "unlimited" (Từ vựng IELTS ("unlimited"): not restricted in amount, number, or extent) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

en: To help someone do something.
vi: Hành động / quá trình (assist): To help someone do something.

ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "assist" (Hành động / quá trình (assist): To help someone do something.) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Local volunteers can assist older residents with online services, making essential information more accessible.

en: the main plant part supporting leaves, flowers, or fruit
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("stem"): the main plant part supporting leaves, flowers, or fruit

ex.en: She cut the rose stem before filling the vase.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "stem" (Từ vựng IELTS ("stem"): the main plant part supporting leaves, flowers, or fruit) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Many urban transport problems stem from poor planning rather than a simple shortage of road space.

en: To make something less complicated or easier to understand.
vi: Hành động / quá trình (simplify): To make something less complicated or easier to understand.

ex.en: Could you simplify these instructions before I start cooking?
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "simplify" (Hành động / quá trình (simplify): To make something less complicated or easier to understand.) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Governments should simplify application procedures so that small businesses can access financial support more easily.

en: the process of putting equipment or software in place for use
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("installation"): the process of putting equipment or software in place for use

ex.en: Installation of our new dishwasher took less than an hour.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "installation" (Từ vựng IELTS ("installation"): the process of putting equipment or software in place for use) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: The installation of solar panels on public buildings can lower energy costs and reduce carbon emissions.

en: an unfair preference for or against a person or group
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("bias"): an unfair preference for or against a person or group

ex.en: The referee showed clear bias towards the home team.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "bias" (Từ vựng IELTS ("bias"): an unfair preference for or against a person or group) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Researchers should select participants carefully to minimise bias and ensure that their findings represent the wider population.

en: To make a copy or create the same result again.
vi: Hành động / quá trình (reproduce): To make a copy or create the same result again.

ex.en: This printer reproduces every detail of my pencil drawings.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "reproduce" (Hành động / quá trình (reproduce): To make a copy or create the same result again.) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

en: The upper part of the leg, above the knee.

ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "thigh" (Từ vựng IELTS ("thigh"): The upper part of the leg, above the knee.) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Regular cycling strengthens the thigh muscles and can improve overall fitness without excessive joint strain.

en: The latest time by which something must be completed
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("deadline"): The latest time by which something must be completed

ex.en: I stayed up late to meet the application deadline.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "deadline" (Từ vựng IELTS ("deadline"): The latest time by which something must be completed) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Setting a realistic deadline allows researchers to maintain quality without delaying the publication of important findings.

en: a person owned by another and forced to work

ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "slave" (Từ vựng IELTS ("slave"): a person owned by another and forced to work) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Studying the experiences of slaves helps students understand the human consequences of historical systems of exploitation.

en: a condition involving persistent sadness and loss of interest

ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "depression" (Từ vựng IELTS ("depression"): a condition involving persistent sadness and loss of interest) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

en: to encourage something to develop or become more active
vi: Kích thích, khuấy động

ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "stimulate" (Kích thích, khuấy động) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Lower borrowing costs can stimulate economic growth by encouraging businesses to invest in new equipment.

en: Relating to a company or businesses in general.

ex.en: Greater corporate transparency allows consumers to assess whether businesses genuinely meet their environmental and social commitments.

en: a person or company that provides goods or services

ex.en: Businesses should assess each supplier carefully to ensure that materials are produced under fair working conditions.

en: Information discovered through research or an investigation.

ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "finding" (Từ vựng IELTS ("finding"): Information discovered through research or an investigation.) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: The findings indicate that affordable public transport can significantly improve access to employment in disadvantaged areas.

en: Belonging separately to each person or thing already mentioned.
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("respective"): Belonging separately to each person or thing already mentioned.

ex.en: Schools and families should understand their respective responsibilities in supporting children's emotional development and academic progress.

en: money saved or collected for a particular purpose
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("fund"): money saved or collected for a particular purpose

ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "fund" (Từ vựng IELTS ("fund"): money saved or collected for a particular purpose) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.
