ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "foam" (Từ vựng IELTS ("foam"): a mass of small bubbles on or in a liquid) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Manufacturers often use foam packaging to protect fragile goods, although some types are difficult to recycle.

en: to a very great degree or extent
vi: Hành động / quá trình (enormously): to a very great degree or extent

ex.en: Your help made this difficult move enormously easier.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "enormously" (Hành động / quá trình (enormously): to a very great degree or extent) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Affordable public transport can benefit low-income households enormously by reducing their daily travel costs.

en: a particular way of thinking about an issue
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("viewpoint"): a particular way of thinking about an issue

ex.en: Hearing your story helped me understand your viewpoint.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "viewpoint" (Từ vựng IELTS ("viewpoint"): a particular way of thinking about an issue) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Considering an issue from another person's viewpoint can help communities resolve disagreements more effectively.

en: Slightly wet, often in an unpleasant way.
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("damp"): Slightly wet, often in an unpleasant way.

ex.en: My socks are still damp from yesterday's walk.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "damp" (Từ vựng IELTS ("damp"): Slightly wet, often in an unpleasant way.) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Living in damp conditions can worsen respiratory problems, particularly among children and older people.

en: a territory governed by another country
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("colony"): a territory governed by another country

ex.en: The island was once a colony of a distant kingdom.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "colony" (Từ vựng IELTS ("colony"): a territory governed by another country) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Historical records reveal how trade policies shaped the economy of the colony over several decades.

en: Expressing information clearly in few words, without unnecessary detail.
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("concise"): Expressing information clearly in few words, without unnecessary detail.

ex.en: Her concise directions helped us find the station easily.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "concise" (Từ vựng IELTS ("concise"): Expressing information clearly in few words, without unnecessary detail.) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Clear and concise public health advice enables people to understand risks and make informed decisions quickly.

en: The act of being present at an event or place.
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("attendance"): The act of being present at an event or place.

ex.en: Our teacher checks attendance at the start of every lesson.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "attendance" (Từ vựng IELTS ("attendance"): The act of being present at an event or place.) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Regular school attendance is associated with stronger academic performance and better opportunities for social development.

en: Including many different kinds of people or things.
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("diverse"): Including many different kinds of people or things.

ex.en: Our garden attracts a diverse range of colourful birds.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "diverse" (Từ vựng IELTS ("diverse"): Including many different kinds of people or things.) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: A culturally diverse workforce can bring fresh perspectives and improve an organisation's ability to solve problems.

en: Doing or saying something again, often several times
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("repetition"): Doing or saying something again, often several times

ex.en: Through daily repetition, I finally remembered the whole song.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "repetition" (Từ vựng IELTS ("repetition"): Doing or saying something again, often several times) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Regular repetition can help language learners remember new vocabulary, especially when combined with meaningful practice.

en: A person, company, or country buying goods from abroad.
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("importer"): A person, company, or country buying goods from abroad.

ex.en: The importer showed us coffee beans from several countries.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "importer" (Từ vựng IELTS ("importer"): A person, company, or country buying goods from abroad.) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: A country that becomes a major food importer may face greater exposure to international price fluctuations.

en: The state of being in a particular place.
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("presence"): The state of being in a particular place.

ex.en: Her presence at the concert made her daughter smile.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "presence" (Từ vựng IELTS ("presence"): The state of being in a particular place.) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: The presence of green spaces in urban neighbourhoods can improve residents' physical and mental health.

en: Activities done for enjoyment and relaxation when not working.
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("recreation"): Activities done for enjoyment and relaxation when not working.

ex.en: I swim for recreation at the local leisure centre.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "recreation" (Từ vựng IELTS ("recreation"): Activities done for enjoyment and relaxation when not working.) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Access to green spaces encourages outdoor recreation and can improve both physical health and mental wellbeing.

en: a clear, deep understanding of a person or situation
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("insight"): a clear, deep understanding of a person or situation

ex.en: Helping at the bakery gave me insight into running a business.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "insight" (Từ vựng IELTS ("insight"): a clear, deep understanding of a person or situation) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Interviews with local residents provide valuable insight into how urban redevelopment affects community relationships and daily routines.

en: To mention a source or example supporting a statement.
vi: Hành động / quá trình (cite): To mention a source or example supporting a statement.

ex.en: Please cite the book you used for your project.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "cite" (Hành động / quá trình (cite): To mention a source or example supporting a statement.) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Researchers often cite access to green spaces as an important factor in improving urban residents' mental health.

en: The area of land beside a river.
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("riverside"): The area of land beside a river.

ex.en: We walked along the riverside after a late lunch.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "riverside" (Từ vựng IELTS ("riverside"): The area of land beside a river.) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Improving access to the riverside can create attractive public spaces and encourage residents to exercise outdoors.

en: A tiny piece that breaks off bread, cake, or biscuits
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("crumb"): A tiny piece that breaks off bread, cake, or biscuits

ex.en: A crumb fell from my toast onto the table.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "crumb" (Từ vựng IELTS ("crumb"): A tiny piece that breaks off bread, cake, or biscuits) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Even small food scraps, such as bread crumbs, can attract pests when waste is poorly managed.

en: rising or falling at a sharp angle
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("steep"): rising or falling at a sharp angle

ex.en: We pushed our bikes up the steep hill.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "steep" (Từ vựng IELTS ("steep"): rising or falling at a sharp angle) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: A steep rise in housing costs can force young workers to move away from major cities.

en: to prevent someone from having something they need or value
vi: Hành động / quá trình (deprive): to prevent someone from having something they need or value

ex.en: The noisy roadworks deprived us of sleep all week.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "deprive" (Hành động / quá trình (deprive): to prevent someone from having something they need or value) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Unequal access to technology can deprive disadvantaged students of valuable opportunities to develop essential digital skills.

en: an action, especially one that is notably good or bad
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("deed"): an action, especially one that is notably good or bad

ex.en: Helping our neighbour carry groceries was a kind deed.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "deed" (Từ vựng IELTS ("deed"): an action, especially one that is notably good or bad) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Recognising good deeds in schools can encourage students to take greater responsibility for their local communities.

en: to interrupt someone's activity, rest, or peace
vi: Hành động / quá trình (disturb): to interrupt someone's activity, rest, or peace

ex.en: Please close the door quietly so you don't disturb Dad.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "disturb" (Hành động / quá trình (disturb): to interrupt someone's activity, rest, or peace) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Construction noise can disturb nearby residents and reduce their quality of life over time.

en: To introduce a product or start an organised activity.
vi: Phóng, ra mắt, khởi động

ex.en: Our local bakery launched a new delivery service yesterday.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "launch" (Phóng, ra mắt, khởi động) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Schools should launch awareness campaigns to encourage healthier eating habits and reduce food waste among students.

en: making you feel embarrassed or uncomfortable
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("awkward"): making you feel embarrassed or uncomfortable

ex.en: There was an awkward silence after I forgot her name.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "awkward" (Từ vựng IELTS ("awkward"): making you feel embarrassed or uncomfortable) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Flexible working arrangements can help parents manage awkward schedules without sacrificing their career opportunities.

en: a hospital room or section for patients receiving similar care
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("ward"): a hospital room or section for patients receiving similar care

ex.en: A nurse brought fresh blankets into the children's ward.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "ward" (Từ vựng IELTS ("ward"): a hospital room or section for patients receiving similar care) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Expanding hospital wards alone will not improve healthcare unless sufficient trained staff are also available.

en: to increase or improve something
vi: Hành động / quá trình (boost): to increase or improve something

ex.en: A short walk can boost your energy after lunch.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "boost" (Hành động / quá trình (boost): to increase or improve something) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Investment in reliable public transport can boost local employment and improve access to essential services.

en: to show that something exists or is likely
vi: Chỉ ra, biểu thị

ex.en: These dark clouds indicate that rain is coming.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "indicate" (Chỉ ra, biểu thị) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Recent surveys indicate that affordable housing remains a major concern for young adults in urban areas.

en: far better than usual
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("exceptional"): far better than usual

ex.en: The young violinist gave an exceptional performance last night.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "exceptional" (Từ vựng IELTS ("exceptional"): far better than usual) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Students with exceptional ability may require additional challenges to remain engaged in classroom learning.

en: The distance from a surface to the bottom.
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("depth"): The distance from a surface to the bottom.

ex.en: Check the depth before you jump into the pool.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "depth" (Từ vựng IELTS ("depth"): The distance from a surface to the bottom.) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: University courses should encourage students to explore complex environmental issues in greater depth.

en: a small screen image representing a program, file, or function
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("icon"): a small screen image representing a program, file, or function

ex.en: Tap the camera icon to take a quick photo.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "icon" (Từ vựng IELTS ("icon"): a small screen image representing a program, file, or function) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: A familiar cultural icon can attract international visitors and strengthen a city's identity in tourism campaigns.

en: involving a chance of harm, failure, or loss
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("risky"): involving a chance of harm, failure, or loss

ex.en: It is risky to cycle home without lights.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "risky" (Từ vựng IELTS ("risky"): involving a chance of harm, failure, or loss) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Investing all public funds in a single industry is risky because economic conditions can change unexpectedly.

en: The act of keeping something safe from damage or loss.
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("preservation"): The act of keeping something safe from damage or loss.

ex.en: These old photographs need careful preservation to prevent further damage.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "preservation" (Từ vựng IELTS ("preservation"): The act of keeping something safe from damage or loss.) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: The preservation of historic buildings can strengthen local identity while attracting visitors and supporting small businesses.

en: To control the direction in which a vehicle moves.
vi: Hành động / quá trình (steer): To control the direction in which a vehicle moves.

ex.en: She carefully steered the boat away from the rocks.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "steer" (Hành động / quá trình (steer): To control the direction in which a vehicle moves.) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Governments can steer investment towards renewable energy by offering financial incentives and establishing clear environmental standards.

en: Related to business or intended to make money.
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("commercial"): Related to business or intended to make money.

ex.en: This street has homes above its commercial premises.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "commercial" (Từ vựng IELTS ("commercial"): Related to business or intended to make money.) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Commercial development can create jobs, but it should not come at the expense of public green spaces.

en: Someone injured or killed in an accident, conflict, or disaster.
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("casualty"): Someone injured or killed in an accident, conflict, or disaster.

ex.en: The ambulance took the casualty to a nearby hospital.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "casualty" (Từ vựng IELTS ("casualty"): Someone injured or killed in an accident, conflict, or disaster.) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Improved building standards can reduce the number of casualties when earthquakes strike densely populated urban areas.

en: a strong desire to learn or know about something
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("curiosity"): a strong desire to learn or know about something

ex.en: Curiosity led me to open the dusty wooden box.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "curiosity" (Từ vựng IELTS ("curiosity"): a strong desire to learn or know about something) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Schools should encourage children's curiosity by allowing them to investigate questions through practical experiments.

en: A strong metal made mainly from iron and some carbon
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("steel"): A strong metal made mainly from iron and some carbon

ex.en: The new bridge has a frame made of steel.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "steel" (Từ vựng IELTS ("steel"): A strong metal made mainly from iron and some carbon) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Recycling steel can reduce demand for raw materials and lower energy consumption in the construction industry.

en: To leave someone or something without intending to return.
vi: Từ bỏ, rời bỏ, hủy bỏ

ex.en: We had to abandon our car in the snow.
ex.vi: Họ buộc phải từ bỏ kế hoạch leo núi vì bão tuyết ập đến.

ex.en: Cities should not abandon ambitious recycling programmes simply because initial participation rates are lower than expected.
ex.vi: Nhiều ngôi làng truyền thống đã bị bỏ hoang khi thanh niên di cư lên thành phố lớn.

col: abandon a plan — từ bỏ kế hoạch
abandoned building — tòa nhà bỏ hoang
tip: Trong IELTS Reading thường gặp "abandon a project/policy/traditional lifestyle".

en: A male ruler of an empire.
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("emperor"): A male ruler of an empire.

ex.en: The museum displays a robe once worn by an emperor.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "emperor" (Từ vựng IELTS ("emperor"): A male ruler of an empire.) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: The emperor expanded trade routes, allowing goods and cultural practices to spread across the empire.

en: a brother or sister
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("sibling"): a brother or sister

ex.en: My younger sibling always borrows my favourite blue jacket.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "sibling" (Từ vựng IELTS ("sibling"): a brother or sister) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Children with siblings may develop negotiation skills early by sharing toys and resolving disagreements at home.

en: Unfamiliar or very different from what someone knows or accepts
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("alien"): Unfamiliar or very different from what someone knows or accepts

ex.en: The city's constant noise felt alien after our quiet village.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "alien" (Từ vựng IELTS ("alien"): Unfamiliar or very different from what someone knows or accepts) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Teaching methods that seem alien to international students may require careful explanation and additional support from university staff.

en: to mix substances or qualities together
vi: Hành động / quá trình (blend): to mix substances or qualities together

ex.en: Blend the bananas and milk until the mixture is smooth.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "blend" (Hành động / quá trình (blend): to mix substances or qualities together) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Successful urban developments blend modern facilities with traditional architecture to preserve a city's distinctive character.

en: a situation in which there is not enough of something
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("shortage"): a situation in which there is not enough of something

ex.en: A water shortage forced us to take shorter showers.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "shortage" (Từ vựng IELTS ("shortage"): a situation in which there is not enough of something) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: A shortage of affordable housing can force essential workers to live far from their workplaces.

en: A narrow-waisted flying insect that can sting.
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("wasp"): A narrow-waisted flying insect that can sting.

ex.en: A wasp landed on the edge of my glass.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "wasp" (Từ vựng IELTS ("wasp"): A narrow-waisted flying insect that can sting.) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Although wasps are often considered pests, many species help control insects that damage agricultural crops.

en: Sudden brain damage caused by interrupted blood flow or bleeding.
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("stroke"): Sudden brain damage caused by interrupted blood flow or bleeding.

ex.en: The cat purred while I stroked its soft fur.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "stroke" (Từ vựng IELTS ("stroke"): Sudden brain damage caused by interrupted blood flow or bleeding.) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Recognising the early symptoms of a stroke can help patients receive treatment before serious brain damage occurs.

en: A curved weapon with a string used to shoot arrows.
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("bow"): A curved weapon with a string used to shoot arrows.

ex.en: She tied a neat bow around the gift box.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "bow" (Từ vựng IELTS ("bow"): A curved weapon with a string used to shoot arrows.) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: In some cultures, people bow when greeting others, while elsewhere a handshake is more common.

en: not wanted or received with pleasure
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("unwelcome"): not wanted or received with pleasure

ex.en: The loud music was an unwelcome interruption during dinner.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "unwelcome" (Từ vựng IELTS ("unwelcome"): not wanted or received with pleasure) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: For many residents, rising rents are an unwelcome consequence of rapid development in urban areas.

en: A shellfish with a rough shell, sometimes producing pearls.
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("oyster"): A shellfish with a rough shell, sometimes producing pearls.

ex.en: The oyster shell felt rough against my fingers.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "oyster" (Từ vựng IELTS ("oyster"): A shellfish with a rough shell, sometimes producing pearls.) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Restoring oyster populations can improve coastal water quality because these shellfish filter particles from the surrounding water.

en: A place or equipment provided for a particular purpose.
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("facility"): A place or equipment provided for a particular purpose.

ex.en: The new sports facility has a bright indoor pool.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "facility" (Từ vựng IELTS ("facility"): A place or equipment provided for a particular purpose.) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Investing in local healthcare facilities can improve access to essential services for people in rural communities.

en: a person walking rather than travelling in a vehicle
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("pedestrian"): a person walking rather than travelling in a vehicle

ex.en: The driver stopped to let a pedestrian cross.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "pedestrian" (Từ vựng IELTS ("pedestrian"): a person walking rather than travelling in a vehicle) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Wider pavements and safer crossings can protect pedestrians and encourage residents to walk instead of driving.

en: An agreement in which each side accepts less than originally wanted.
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("compromise"): An agreement in which each side accepts less than originally wanted.

ex.en: We reached a compromise and shared the last biscuit.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "compromise" (Từ vựng IELTS ("compromise"): An agreement in which each side accepts less than originally wanted.) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Governments must find a compromise between expanding housing supply and protecting green spaces in densely populated cities.

en: to increase something as much as possible or use it fully
vi: Tối đa hóa

ex.en: We added shelves to maximize space in our tiny kitchen.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "maximize" (Tối đa hóa) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Cities should improve public transport to maximize access to employment while reducing dependence on private cars.

en: money paid for teaching at a school or university
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("tuition"): money paid for teaching at a school or university

ex.en: She works at weekends to help pay her tuition.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "tuition" (Từ vựng IELTS ("tuition"): money paid for teaching at a school or university) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Rising university tuition fees may discourage students from disadvantaged backgrounds from pursuing higher education.

en: A shaped piece used to cover floors, walls, or roofs.
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("tile"): A shaped piece used to cover floors, walls, or roofs.

ex.en: One blue tile has cracked beside the kitchen sink.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "tile" (Từ vựng IELTS ("tile"): A shaped piece used to cover floors, walls, or roofs.) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Using locally produced roof tiles can reduce transport emissions and support traditional industries in rural areas.

en: to squeeze something tightly, often between a finger and thumb
vi: Hành động / quá trình (pinch): to squeeze something tightly, often between a finger and thumb

ex.en: Pinch the pastry edges together to seal the pie.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "pinch" (Hành động / quá trình (pinch): to squeeze something tightly, often between a finger and thumb) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: As food prices rise, families on low incomes increasingly feel the pinch and reduce nonessential spending.

en: in a way that meets expectations or requirements
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("satisfactorily"): in a way that meets expectations or requirements

ex.en: The washing machine worked satisfactorily after the repair.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "satisfactorily" (Từ vựng IELTS ("satisfactorily"): in a way that meets expectations or requirements) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Public transport cannot function satisfactorily unless local authorities invest in regular maintenance and staff training.

en: able to spread between people, like an illness or emotion
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("catching"): able to spread between people, like an illness or emotion

ex.en: Her laughter was catching, and soon everyone was smiling.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "catching" (Từ vựng IELTS ("catching"): able to spread between people, like an illness or emotion) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Although enthusiasm can be catching, public health campaigns also need clear evidence to encourage lasting behavioural change.

en: to experience a process, change, or treatment
vi: Trải qua (quá trình, phẫu thuật, thay đổi)

ex.en: My uncle will undergo knee surgery early next week.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "undergo" (Trải qua (quá trình, phẫu thuật, thay đổi)) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Many coastal cities will undergo significant changes as rising sea levels force governments to reconsider urban planning.

en: A ship designed to carry large quantities of liquid
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("tanker"): A ship designed to carry large quantities of liquid

ex.en: We watched a huge tanker sail into the harbour.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "tanker" (Từ vựng IELTS ("tanker"): A ship designed to carry large quantities of liquid) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: An accident involving an oil tanker can cause lasting damage to coastal ecosystems.

en: Sudden pain caused by a muscle tightening involuntarily.
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("cramp"): Sudden pain caused by a muscle tightening involuntarily.

ex.en: A sudden cramp in my calf stopped me swimming.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "cramp" (Từ vựng IELTS ("cramp"): Sudden pain caused by a muscle tightening involuntarily.) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Excessively strict classroom rules may cramp students' creativity and discourage them from exploring unfamiliar ideas.

en: a reason for doing something
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("motive"): a reason for doing something

ex.en: Her motive for joining was simply to make friends.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "motive" (Từ vựng IELTS ("motive"): a reason for doing something) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Financial security is a major motive for many graduates who choose careers in established companies.

en: to give someone what they want or need
vi: Hành động / quá trình (satisfy): to give someone what they want or need

ex.en: A bowl of soup was enough to satisfy my hunger.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "satisfy" (Hành động / quá trình (satisfy): to give someone what they want or need) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: New housing developments must satisfy strict environmental standards before local authorities allow construction to begin.

en: A change that fixes an error, or the act of fixing it.
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("correction"): A change that fixes an error, or the act of fixing it.

ex.en: I made a correction before sending the email.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "correction" (Từ vựng IELTS ("correction"): A change that fixes an error, or the act of fixing it.) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Timely correction of factual errors helps news organizations maintain public trust and prevent misinformation from spreading.

en: to find or direct the way to a destination
vi: Hành động / quá trình (navigate): to find or direct the way to a destination

ex.en: We used a map to navigate the narrow streets.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "navigate" (Hành động / quá trình (navigate): to find or direct the way to a destination) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Clear website design helps users navigate public services and access essential information without unnecessary delays.

en: Evaluated the quality, value, extent, or importance of something.
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("assessed"): Evaluated the quality, value, extent, or importance of something.

ex.en: The mechanic assessed the damage before repairing my bicycle.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "assessed" (Từ vựng IELTS ("assessed"): Evaluated the quality, value, extent, or importance of something.) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Students should be assessed through varied tasks rather than judged solely on their performance in final examinations.

en: Relating to sight or things that can be seen.
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("visual"): Relating to sight or things that can be seen.

ex.en: The exhibition combines music with some stunning visual effects.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "visual" (Từ vựng IELTS ("visual"): Relating to sight or things that can be seen.) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Teachers can use visual aids to make complex scientific concepts easier for younger students to understand.

en: to catch someone or something and prevent escape
vi: Hành động / quá trình (capture): to catch someone or something and prevent escape

ex.en: Rescuers captured the injured bird and gently examined its wing.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "capture" (Hành động / quá trình (capture): to catch someone or something and prevent escape) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Wildlife researchers use remote cameras to capture animal behaviour without disturbing natural habitats.

en: a separate unit within a larger course of study
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("module"): a separate unit within a larger course of study

ex.en: We finished the photography module with an outdoor project.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "module" (Từ vựng IELTS ("module"): a separate unit within a larger course of study) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Universities increasingly offer a compulsory module on digital skills to prepare students for changing workplace demands.

en: A tendency to become angry, or an angry mood.
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("temper"): A tendency to become angry, or an angry mood.

ex.en: He lost his temper when the drawer jammed again.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "temper" (Từ vựng IELTS ("temper"): A tendency to become angry, or an angry mood.) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Governments should temper enthusiasm for new technologies with careful consideration of their potential social consequences.

en: Able to use two languages, or involving two languages.
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("bilingual"): Able to use two languages, or involving two languages.

ex.en: Our bilingual neighbour speaks both English and Chinese fluently.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "bilingual" (Từ vựng IELTS ("bilingual"): Able to use two languages, or involving two languages.) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Bilingual education can help children maintain their cultural identity while developing skills for an increasingly connected world.

en: unwanted involvement in someone else's affairs or decisions
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("interference"): unwanted involvement in someone else's affairs or decisions

ex.en: I wanted to choose my clothes without anyone's interference.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "interference" (Từ vựng IELTS ("interference"): unwanted involvement in someone else's affairs or decisions) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Universities need protection from political interference to ensure that research findings remain independent and credible.

en: to become less strong, or make something less strong
vi: Hành động / quá trình (weaken): to become less strong, or make something less strong

ex.en: Too little sleep can weaken your ability to concentrate.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "weaken" (Hành động / quá trình (weaken): to become less strong, or make something less strong) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Persistent unemployment can weaken local economies by reducing household spending and discouraging business investment.

en: a wide street, often lined with trees
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("avenue"): a wide street, often lined with trees

ex.en: We walked along a quiet avenue shaded by tall trees.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "avenue" (Từ vựng IELTS ("avenue"): a wide street, often lined with trees) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Online learning offers an important avenue for adults seeking new skills while remaining in full-time employment.

en: In most cases or on most occasions.
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("typically"): In most cases or on most occasions.

ex.en: Our neighbours typically walk their dog before breakfast.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "typically" (Từ vựng IELTS ("typically"): In most cases or on most occasions.) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Cities with reliable public transport typically experience less traffic congestion than those dependent on private cars.

en: smooth, attractive movement or behaviour
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("grace"): smooth, attractive movement or behaviour

ex.en: The dancer moved across the stage with effortless grace.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "grace" (Từ vựng IELTS ("grace"): smooth, attractive movement or behaviour) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: A short grace period can help households manage unexpected delays in receiving their income.

en: Likely to move, fall, or collapse.
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("unstable"): Likely to move, fall, or collapse.

ex.en: This unstable chair wobbles whenever I sit on it.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "unstable" (Từ vựng IELTS ("unstable"): Likely to move, fall, or collapse.) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: An unstable economy can discourage investment and make long-term planning difficult for small businesses.

en: Able to strongly affect people's opinions, decisions, or actions.
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("influential"): Able to strongly affect people's opinions, decisions, or actions.

ex.en: Her grandfather was an influential teacher in their village.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "influential" (Từ vựng IELTS ("influential"): Able to strongly affect people's opinions, decisions, or actions.) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Scientific advisers can be influential in shaping government policies on public health and environmental protection.

en: Willingness to give money, time, or help freely.
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("generosity"): Willingness to give money, time, or help freely.

ex.en: Thanks to your generosity, everyone has a warm coat.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "generosity" (Từ vựng IELTS ("generosity"): Willingness to give money, time, or help freely.) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Community projects often depend on the generosity of residents who contribute both money and valuable practical skills.

en: A plant with large, often trumpet-shaped flowers.
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("lily"): A plant with large, often trumpet-shaped flowers.

ex.en: A white lily opened beside our kitchen window this morning.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "lily" (Từ vựng IELTS ("lily"): A plant with large, often trumpet-shaped flowers.) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Urban gardens planted with lilies and other flowering species can provide attractive spaces for local residents.

en: Having large, strong muscles.
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("muscular"): Having large, strong muscles.

ex.en: The muscular swimmer lifted the heavy box easily.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "muscular" (Từ vựng IELTS ("muscular"): Having large, strong muscles.) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Regular resistance training can improve muscular strength and help older adults maintain their independence.

en: A child or young person.
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("youngster"): A child or young person.

ex.en: A cheerful youngster helped me pick up the apples.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "youngster" (Từ vựng IELTS ("youngster"): A child or young person.) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Community sports programmes give youngsters opportunities to develop teamwork skills and build friendships outside school.

en: a very strong interest in someone or something
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("fascination"): a very strong interest in someone or something

ex.en: She watched the tiny fish with fascination for hours.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "fascination" (Từ vựng IELTS ("fascination"): a very strong interest in someone or something) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Children's fascination with wildlife can provide a valuable starting point for environmental education in primary schools.

en: A school or class for children beginning their education
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("kindergarten"): A school or class for children beginning their education

ex.en: My daughter painted a bright yellow bird at kindergarten.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "kindergarten" (Từ vựng IELTS ("kindergarten"): A school or class for children beginning their education) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: High-quality kindergarten education can develop children's social skills and prepare them for more structured learning.

en: A distinct period in a process of change or development.
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("phase"): A distinct period in a process of change or development.

ex.en: The kitchen repairs have entered their final phase.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "phase" (Từ vựng IELTS ("phase"): A distinct period in a process of change or development.) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: During the initial phase of urban development, planners should prioritise affordable housing and reliable public transport.

en: a person who controls a machine or piece of equipment
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("operator"): a person who controls a machine or piece of equipment

ex.en: The crane operator carefully lowered the beam into place.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "operator" (Từ vựng IELTS ("operator"): a person who controls a machine or piece of equipment) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Every public transport operator should ensure that its services remain accessible to passengers with limited mobility.

en: Someone or something that causes great admiration or surprise
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("marvel"): Someone or something that causes great admiration or surprise

ex.en: We marvelled at the tiny bird's beautifully woven nest.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "marvel" (Từ vựng IELTS ("marvel"): Someone or something that causes great admiration or surprise) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: The new bridge is an engineering marvel that connects isolated communities and improves access to essential services.

en: to use rude or offensive words
vi: Hành động / quá trình (swear): to use rude or offensive words

ex.en: Please don't swear when the game goes wrong.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "swear" (Hành động / quá trình (swear): to use rude or offensive words) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Witnesses must swear to tell the truth before giving evidence in many legal systems.

en: A short account presenting the main features of a subject.
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("overview"): A short account presenting the main features of a subject.

ex.en: Our guide gave us an overview of the tour.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "overview" (Từ vựng IELTS ("overview"): A short account presenting the main features of a subject.) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: The opening section provides an overview of the main challenges facing renewable energy development.

en: the process of finding people to join an organisation
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("recruitment"): the process of finding people to join an organisation

ex.en: Our cafe handles recruitment before the busy summer season.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "recruitment" (Từ vựng IELTS ("recruitment"): the process of finding people to join an organisation) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Fair recruitment practices help employers attract talented applicants from a wide range of social backgrounds.

en: Not very serious, important, or large.
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("minor"): Not very serious, important, or large.

ex.en: The bike only needs a few minor repairs.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "minor" (Từ vựng IELTS ("minor"): Not very serious, important, or large.) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Minor changes to daily travel habits can collectively reduce pollution in densely populated urban areas.

en: To examine facts carefully to discover what happened or why.
vi: Điều tra, nghiên cứu sâu

ex.en: A plumber came to investigate the strange noise upstairs.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "investigate" (Điều tra, nghiên cứu sâu) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Researchers are investigating how access to green spaces affects the mental health of urban residents.

en: To make something clear through examples or evidence.
vi: Minh họa, làm rõ

ex.en: She used two jars to illustrate the difference.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "illustrate" (Minh họa, làm rõ) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: These findings illustrate how access to public transport can improve employment opportunities in disadvantaged communities.

en: Deserving great admiration or bringing honour and pride.
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("glorious"): Deserving great admiration or bringing honour and pride.

ex.en: We spent a glorious afternoon swimming in the lake.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "glorious" (Từ vựng IELTS ("glorious"): Deserving great admiration or bringing honour and pride.) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Museums should examine difficult historical events as carefully as they celebrate a nation's glorious achievements.

en: A list of things to check or do
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("checklist"): A list of things to check or do

ex.en: I use a checklist when packing for a trip.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "checklist" (Từ vựng IELTS ("checklist"): A list of things to check or do) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: A standard safety checklist can help hospital staff reduce avoidable errors during routine medical procedures.

en: easy to understand or do, without complications
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("straightforward"): easy to understand or do, without complications

ex.en: The recipe is straightforward, even for a beginner.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "straightforward" (Từ vựng IELTS ("straightforward"): easy to understand or do, without complications) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Governments should make recycling procedures straightforward so that more households can participate without unnecessary confusion.

en: To rub skin with fingernails, often to relieve itching.
vi: Hành động / quá trình (scratch): To rub skin with fingernails, often to relieve itching.

ex.en: Please don't scratch that bite; it will get worse.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "scratch" (Hành động / quá trình (scratch): To rub skin with fingernails, often to relieve itching.) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Even a small scratch on a reusable container can make it harder to clean effectively.

en: a glass or plastic building that keeps growing plants warm
vi: Nhà kính trồng cây; hiệu ứng nhà kính

ex.en: We grow tomatoes in the greenhouse throughout the winter.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "greenhouse" (Nhà kính trồng cây; hiệu ứng nhà kính) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Greenhouse cultivation can extend growing seasons, although heating these structures may require considerable amounts of energy.

en: The ability to achieve results without wasting time, energy, or resources
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("efficiency"): The ability to achieve results without wasting time, energy, or resources

ex.en: Organising my tools improved the efficiency of my work.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "efficiency" (Từ vựng IELTS ("efficiency"): The ability to achieve results without wasting time, energy, or resources) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Improving energy efficiency in public buildings can reduce government spending and lower greenhouse gas emissions.

en: united or closely connected as a whole
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("cohesive"): united or closely connected as a whole

ex.en: Regular practice helped us become a more cohesive team.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "cohesive" (Từ vựng IELTS ("cohesive"): united or closely connected as a whole) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Shared public spaces can help build cohesive communities by encouraging interaction among people from different backgrounds.

en: The main outer body of a ship or boat.
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("hull"): The main outer body of a ship or boat.

ex.en: We painted the boat's hull blue before launching it.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "hull" (Từ vựng IELTS ("hull"): The main outer body of a ship or boat.) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Improved hull designs can reduce fuel consumption by allowing ships to move through water with less resistance.

en: a document describing a school or university for potential students
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("prospectus"): a document describing a school or university for potential students

ex.en: I checked the college prospectus for photography courses.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "prospectus" (Từ vựng IELTS ("prospectus"): a document describing a school or university for potential students) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: A university prospectus should provide accurate information about tuition fees, course content, and available student support.

en: A fourteen-line poem following a particular rhyme and rhythm pattern.
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("sonnet"): A fourteen-line poem following a particular rhyme and rhythm pattern.

ex.en: She read a sonnet aloud beside the open window.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "sonnet" (Từ vựng IELTS ("sonnet"): A fourteen-line poem following a particular rhyme and rhythm pattern.) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Studying a sonnet helps students understand how formal constraints can encourage creative expression in literature.

en: The education of boys and girls together in the same institution.
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("coeducation"): The education of boys and girls together in the same institution.

ex.en: My grandparents first experienced coeducation at their village school.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "coeducation" (Từ vựng IELTS ("coeducation"): The education of boys and girls together in the same institution.) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Supporters of coeducation argue that learning together helps boys and girls develop mutual respect.

en: An official abroad who assists citizens and represents national interests
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("consul"): An official abroad who assists citizens and represents national interests

ex.en: The consul helped us after we lost our passports.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "consul" (Từ vựng IELTS ("consul"): An official abroad who assists citizens and represents national interests) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: A consul may support citizens facing difficulties overseas and help strengthen commercial links between countries.

en: Controlling people or situations unfairly for personal advantage.
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("manipulation"): Controlling people or situations unfairly for personal advantage.

ex.en: She recognised his emotional manipulation and refused to feel guilty.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "manipulation" (Từ vựng IELTS ("manipulation"): Controlling people or situations unfairly for personal advantage.) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: The manipulation of survey results can mislead policymakers and reduce public trust in scientific research.

en: Happening or existing at the same time
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("concurrent"): Happening or existing at the same time

ex.en: Two concurrent meetings meant I had to choose one.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "concurrent" (Từ vựng IELTS ("concurrent"): Happening or existing at the same time) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Concurrent improvements in housing and public transport can make urban development more inclusive and sustainable.

en: Praise someone, often insincerely, to gain their favour.
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("flatter"): Praise someone, often insincerely, to gain their favour.

ex.en: That blue jacket really flatters you in this light.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "flatter" (Từ vựng IELTS ("flatter"): Praise someone, often insincerely, to gain their favour.) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Advertisements often flatter consumers by suggesting that choosing a particular product demonstrates intelligence or good taste.

en: Interfere in other people's affairs without being invited.
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("meddle"): Interfere in other people's affairs without being invited.

ex.en: Please don't meddle in how I arrange my room.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "meddle" (Từ vựng IELTS ("meddle"): Interfere in other people's affairs without being invited.) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Parents who constantly meddle in their children's decisions may prevent them from developing confidence and independence.

en: the act of thinking deeply and quietly about something
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("contemplation"): the act of thinking deeply and quietly about something

ex.en: He sat by the lake in quiet contemplation.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "contemplation" (Từ vựng IELTS ("contemplation"): the act of thinking deeply and quietly about something) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Public gardens offer urban residents valuable opportunities for quiet contemplation away from the pressures of daily life.

en: the level at which something starts happening or changes
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("threshold"): the level at which something starts happening or changes

ex.en: My brother has a much higher pain threshold than me.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "threshold" (Từ vựng IELTS ("threshold"): the level at which something starts happening or changes) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Raising the income threshold for financial assistance would allow more low-paid workers to receive support.

en: To be the parts that form a whole
vi: Hành động / quá trình (constitute): To be the parts that form a whole

ex.en: Vegetables constitute most of the food in our fridge.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "constitute" (Hành động / quá trình (constitute): To be the parts that form a whole) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Rising housing costs constitute a major barrier to financial independence for young adults in large cities.

en: Happening or provided before a surgical operation.
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("preoperative"): Happening or provided before a surgical operation.

ex.en: The nurse explained my preoperative checks before tomorrow's surgery.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "preoperative" (Từ vựng IELTS ("preoperative"): Happening or provided before a surgical operation.) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Thorough preoperative assessment helps medical teams identify potential risks and plan appropriate care for each patient.

en: Existing as a natural or essential part of something.
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("inherent"): Existing as a natural or essential part of something.

ex.en: Even simple home repairs come with some inherent risks.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "inherent" (Từ vựng IELTS ("inherent"): Existing as a natural or essential part of something.) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Policymakers must recognise the inherent limitations of economic growth as a measure of social progress and wellbeing.

en: based on observation or experiments rather than theory alone
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("empirical"): based on observation or experiments rather than theory alone

ex.en: Our garden trial provided empirical evidence that compost helps plants.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "empirical" (Từ vựng IELTS ("empirical"): based on observation or experiments rather than theory alone) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Education policies should be supported by empirical research rather than assumptions about how children learn.

en: An area beside a sea, lake, or river, especially in towns.
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("waterfront"): An area beside a sea, lake, or river, especially in towns.

ex.en: We walked along the waterfront after an early dinner.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "waterfront" (Từ vựng IELTS ("waterfront"): An area beside a sea, lake, or river, especially in towns.) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Redeveloping the waterfront can create attractive public spaces, provided that existing residents are not forced to leave.

en: To share out or spread something again in a different way.
vi: Hành động / quá trình (redistribute): To share out or spread something again in a different way.

ex.en: We redistributed the blankets so everyone had one.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "redistribute" (Hành động / quá trình (redistribute): To share out or spread something again in a different way.) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Progressive taxation can redistribute wealth and help governments fund essential services for disadvantaged communities.

en: the act of following a rule, law, or request
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("compliance"): the act of following a rule, law, or request

ex.en: The inspector checked our kitchen for compliance with hygiene rules.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "compliance" (Từ vựng IELTS ("compliance"): the act of following a rule, law, or request) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Regular inspections can improve compliance with environmental regulations and reduce pollution from industrial facilities.

en: Not genuine, or intended to deceive people
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("phony"): Not genuine, or intended to deceive people

ex.en: His phony smile disappeared as soon as we left.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "phony" (Từ vựng IELTS ("phony"): Not genuine, or intended to deceive people) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Consumers should be cautious about phony online reviews that exaggerate the benefits of health products.

en: with great care and attention to every detail
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("meticulously"): with great care and attention to every detail

ex.en: She meticulously cleaned each tiny part of the watch.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "meticulously" (Từ vựng IELTS ("meticulously"): with great care and attention to every detail) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Researchers must meticulously record their procedures so that other teams can reproduce and verify the results.

en: shaped like a ball
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("spherical"): shaped like a ball

ex.en: A spherical lamp hung above the dining table.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "spherical" (Từ vựng IELTS ("spherical"): shaped like a ball) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Researchers use spherical particles of different sizes to investigate how pollutants move through water filtration systems.

en: A detailed description of how something must be designed or made.
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("specification"): A detailed description of how something must be designed or made.

ex.en: Check the specifications before buying a new laptop.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "specification" (Từ vựng IELTS ("specification"): A detailed description of how something must be designed or made.) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Clear building specifications help ensure that new housing meets safety standards and uses energy efficiently.

en: Very serious or intense.
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("acute"): Very serious or intense.

ex.en: The village faced an acute water shortage last summer.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "acute" (Từ vựng IELTS ("acute"): Very serious or intense.) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: An acute shortage of affordable housing forces many young workers to live far from their workplaces.

en: To allow fresh air to enter and circulate through somewhere.
vi: Hành động / quá trình (ventilate): To allow fresh air to enter and circulate through somewhere.

ex.en: Open both windows to ventilate the kitchen after cooking.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "ventilate" (Hành động / quá trình (ventilate): To allow fresh air to enter and circulate through somewhere.) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Schools should ventilate classrooms regularly to improve indoor air quality and create healthier learning environments.

en: A small system showing the features of a larger one.
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("microcosm"): A small system showing the features of a larger one.

ex.en: Our busy kitchen is a microcosm of family life.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "microcosm" (Từ vựng IELTS ("microcosm"): A small system showing the features of a larger one.) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: A diverse urban neighbourhood can serve as a microcosm of the wider society's opportunities and challenges.

en: Consideration of past events, often with a changed understanding.
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("retrospect"): Consideration of past events, often with a changed understanding.

ex.en: In retrospect, packing extra socks was a brilliant idea.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "retrospect" (Từ vựng IELTS ("retrospect"): Consideration of past events, often with a changed understanding.) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: In retrospect, investing earlier in public transport could have prevented many of the city's current traffic problems.

en: make an action or process easier
vi: Tạo điều kiện thuận lợi, hỗ trợ

ex.en: These sliding doors facilitate access for people using wheelchairs.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "facilitate" (Tạo điều kiện thuận lợi, hỗ trợ) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Digital platforms can facilitate collaboration between students in different countries, allowing them to exchange ideas more easily.

en: to happen again, especially repeatedly or after an interval
vi: Hành động / quá trình (recur): to happen again, especially repeatedly or after an interval

ex.en: If these headaches recur, please speak to your doctor.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "recur" (Hành động / quá trình (recur): to happen again, especially repeatedly or after an interval) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Traffic congestion will continue to recur unless cities address the underlying causes of excessive car use.

en: to remove a ruler or government from power
vi: Hành động / quá trình (overthrow): to remove a ruler or government from power

ex.en: The film follows citizens who overthrow an unfair ruler.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "overthrow" (Hành động / quá trình (overthrow): to remove a ruler or government from power) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Economic hardship can weaken public support for a government and encourage attempts to overthrow it.

en: a substance burned to produce a pleasant smell
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("incense"): a substance burned to produce a pleasant smell

ex.en: A thin trail of smoke rose from the incense.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "incense" (Từ vựng IELTS ("incense"): a substance burned to produce a pleasant smell) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Burning incense indoors can affect air quality, particularly in small rooms with inadequate ventilation.

en: Very unusual and unexpected
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("freak"): Very unusual and unexpected

ex.en: A freak hailstorm covered our garden in white ice.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "freak" (Từ vựng IELTS ("freak"): Very unusual and unexpected) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: A freak weather event can expose weaknesses in urban infrastructure and disrupt essential public services.

en: Making illegal copies of documents or artworks; such a copy.
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("forgery"): Making illegal copies of documents or artworks; such a copy.

ex.en: The painting in the shop was a forgery.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "forgery" (Từ vựng IELTS ("forgery"): Making illegal copies of documents or artworks; such a copy.) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Museums employ specialists to detect forgery and protect the public from misleading claims about historical objects.

en: the upper edge of a cup, bowl, or other container
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("brim"): the upper edge of a cup, bowl, or other container

ex.en: She filled my cup to the brim with tea.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "brim" (Từ vựng IELTS ("brim"): the upper edge of a cup, bowl, or other container) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Community centres brimming with activity can strengthen social connections and reduce isolation among older residents.

en: Likely to experience something, especially something unpleasant.
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("liable"): Likely to experience something, especially something unpleasant.

ex.en: These old pipes are liable to burst in winter.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "liable" (Từ vựng IELTS ("liable"): Likely to experience something, especially something unpleasant.) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Employers may be held liable for injuries caused by unsafe conditions in the workplace.

en: To send someone or something to a particular destination.
vi: Hành động / quá trình (dispatch): To send someone or something to a particular destination.

ex.en: The shop dispatched my new shoes this morning.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "dispatch" (Hành động / quá trình (dispatch): To send someone or something to a particular destination.) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Local authorities should dispatch emergency teams quickly when severe flooding threatens homes and essential infrastructure.

en: The arrangement of objects in a straight line or correct position.
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("alignment"): The arrangement of objects in a straight line or correct position.

ex.en: The mechanic checked the alignment of my front wheels.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "alignment" (Từ vựng IELTS ("alignment"): The arrangement of objects in a straight line or correct position.) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Closer alignment between school curricula and workplace needs could improve employment prospects for young graduates.

en: Someone who supports government based on the people's choices
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("democrat"): Someone who supports government based on the people's choices

ex.en: As a democrat, she wants everyone to have a vote.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "democrat" (Từ vựng IELTS ("democrat"): Someone who supports government based on the people's choices) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: A committed democrat should defend fair elections even when the results favour a competing political party.

en: a desire to hurt someone or cause them trouble
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("malice"): a desire to hurt someone or cause them trouble

ex.en: There was no malice in his teasing smile.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "malice" (Từ vựng IELTS ("malice"): a desire to hurt someone or cause them trouble) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Schools should distinguish between careless remarks and comments made with malice when addressing conflicts among students.

en: Official confirmation that someone or something meets required standards.
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("certification"): Official confirmation that someone or something meets required standards.

ex.en: The swimming instructor proudly showed us her new certification.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "certification" (Từ vựng IELTS ("certification"): Official confirmation that someone or something meets required standards.) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Independent certification helps consumers identify products that meet recognised environmental standards throughout the production process.

en: needed for a particular purpose
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("requisite"): needed for a particular purpose

ex.en: She has the requisite skills to repair this bicycle.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "requisite" (Từ vựng IELTS ("requisite"): needed for a particular purpose) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Applicants without the requisite qualifications may benefit from training programmes designed to improve access to skilled employment.

en: Dishonest behaviour intended to make someone believe something false.
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("deceit"): Dishonest behaviour intended to make someone believe something false.

ex.en: His deceit became clear when we opened the empty box.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "deceit" (Từ vựng IELTS ("deceit"): Dishonest behaviour intended to make someone believe something false.) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Deceit in advertising can damage consumer trust and create unfair advantages for companies that misrepresent their products.

en: A temporary stop to an activity or someone's participation
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("suspension"): A temporary stop to an activity or someone's participation

ex.en: The storm caused the suspension of all ferry services.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "suspension" (Từ vựng IELTS ("suspension"): A temporary stop to an activity or someone's participation) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: The temporary suspension of construction work allowed researchers to assess the project's impact on local wildlife.

en: To spread through or occupy a place in unwanted numbers.
vi: Hành động / quá trình (overrun): To spread through or occupy a place in unwanted numbers.

ex.en: Weeds have overrun the garden since our neighbours moved away.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "overrun" (Hành động / quá trình (overrun): To spread through or occupy a place in unwanted numbers.) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Major infrastructure projects often overrun their budgets when planners underestimate material costs and construction delays.

en: playing an important part in making something happen
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("instrumental"): playing an important part in making something happen

ex.en: Your advice was instrumental in helping me find work.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "instrumental" (Từ vựng IELTS ("instrumental"): playing an important part in making something happen) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Investment in public transport has been instrumental in reducing traffic congestion in several major cities.

en: Unfair treatment of people to gain benefits from their work
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("exploitation"): Unfair treatment of people to gain benefits from their work

ex.en: The workers demanded fair wages and protection from exploitation.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "exploitation" (Từ vựng IELTS ("exploitation"): Unfair treatment of people to gain benefits from their work) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: The uncontrolled exploitation of natural resources can damage ecosystems and undermine the livelihoods of communities that depend on them.

en: A drug used to calm people or animals and reduce anxiety.
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("tranquilizer"): A drug used to calm people or animals and reduce anxiety.

ex.en: The vet gave the frightened horse a tranquilizer.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "tranquilizer" (Từ vựng IELTS ("tranquilizer"): A drug used to calm people or animals and reduce anxiety.) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Doctors should carefully assess the risks before prescribing a tranquilizer to a patient with persistent anxiety.

en: Most common or influential at a particular time or place.
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("prevailing"): Most common or influential at a particular time or place.

ex.en: The prevailing mood at dinner was one of relief.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "prevailing" (Từ vựng IELTS ("prevailing"): Most common or influential at a particular time or place.) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: The prevailing view among urban planners is that reliable public transport can reduce dependence on private cars.

en: A short period when activity or noise becomes less intense.
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("lull"): A short period when activity or noise becomes less intense.

ex.en: We stepped outside during a lull in the rain.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "lull" (Từ vựng IELTS ("lull"): A short period when activity or noise becomes less intense.) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: A temporary lull in economic activity may give businesses time to review their long-term strategies.

col: lull someone into a false sense of security

en: extremely unpleasant or offensive
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("obnoxious"): extremely unpleasant or offensive

ex.en: An obnoxious passenger played loud music throughout the journey.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "obnoxious" (Từ vựng IELTS ("obnoxious"): extremely unpleasant or offensive) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Obnoxious behaviour on public transport can discourage commuters from using otherwise convenient and affordable services.

en: Hang or bend down, often from weakness or tiredness.
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("droop"): Hang or bend down, often from weakness or tiredness.

ex.en: The flowers began to droop in the afternoon heat.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "droop" (Từ vựng IELTS ("droop"): Hang or bend down, often from weakness or tiredness.) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: During prolonged droughts, leaves often droop as plants lose water and struggle to maintain their structure.

en: Speed in acting, often without enough care or thought.
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("haste"): Speed in acting, often without enough care or thought.

ex.en: In my haste, I left my keys on the table.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "haste" (Từ vựng IELTS ("haste"): Speed in acting, often without enough care or thought.) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Policies developed in haste may overlook the needs of vulnerable groups and create additional social problems.

en: to release sweat through your skin, especially when hot
vi: Hành động / quá trình (perspire): to release sweat through your skin, especially when hot

ex.en: I began to perspire while carrying the heavy boxes.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "perspire" (Hành động / quá trình (perspire): to release sweat through your skin, especially when hot) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: People perspire more during intense exercise because the body needs to release excess heat.

en: The supply of water to land so crops can grow.
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("irrigation"): The supply of water to land so crops can grow.

ex.en: The farm's irrigation system keeps these vegetables growing.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "irrigation" (Từ vựng IELTS ("irrigation"): The supply of water to land so crops can grow.) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Efficient irrigation can increase crop yields while reducing water consumption in regions affected by drought.

en: To officially choose someone or something for a particular purpose.
vi: Hành động / quá trình (designate): To officially choose someone or something for a particular purpose.

ex.en: We designated one cupboard for all our cleaning supplies.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "designate" (Hành động / quá trình (designate): To officially choose someone or something for a particular purpose.) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Local authorities should designate more urban land as protected green space to improve residents' quality of life.

en: to become smaller or weaker, or make something so
vi: Giảm bớt, thu nhỏ

ex.en: The pain in my ankle gradually diminished overnight.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "diminish" (Giảm bớt, thu nhỏ) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Investment in reliable public transport can diminish dependence on private cars and improve air quality in crowded cities.

en: The middle of a place, group, activity, or situation.
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("midst"): The middle of a place, group, activity, or situation.

ex.en: We found a quiet garden in the midst of town.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "midst" (Từ vựng IELTS ("midst"): The middle of a place, group, activity, or situation.) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: In the midst of rapid urban growth, planners must preserve accessible green spaces for residents.

en: The universe considered as a complete, ordered system.
vi: Vũ trụ bao la có trật tự

ex.en: Looking through the telescope made me curious about the cosmos.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "cosmos" (Vũ trụ bao la có trật tự) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Studying the cosmos helps scientists investigate how galaxies formed and how the universe has changed over time.

en: stay hidden, often waiting to do something
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("lurk"): stay hidden, often waiting to do something

ex.en: A cat lurked behind the sofa, watching my shoelaces.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "lurk" (Từ vựng IELTS ("lurk"): stay hidden, often waiting to do something) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Security risks may lurk in outdated software, making regular system updates essential for protecting personal information.

en: Make sure that people obey a law or rule.
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("enforce"): Make sure that people obey a law or rule.

ex.en: The pool staff enforce strict rules about running indoors.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "enforce" (Từ vựng IELTS ("enforce"): Make sure that people obey a law or rule.) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Governments must enforce environmental regulations consistently if they want industries to reduce pollution and protect public health.

en: Suggested or understood without being directly stated.
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("implicit"): Suggested or understood without being directly stated.

ex.en: Her welcoming smile was an implicit invitation to join.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "implicit" (Từ vựng IELTS ("implicit"): Suggested or understood without being directly stated.) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Many workplaces have implicit expectations about overtime, which can make employees reluctant to leave on time.

en: Someone who helps opposing sides reach an agreement
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("mediator"): Someone who helps opposing sides reach an agreement

ex.en: A mediator helped our neighbours settle their garden fence dispute.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "mediator" (Từ vựng IELTS ("mediator"): Someone who helps opposing sides reach an agreement) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: An independent mediator can help employers and workers negotiate fair conditions without resorting to lengthy legal proceedings.

en: Someone arranging deals or buying goods to sell to others.
