ex.en: Limited access to reliable internet can hinder educational progress among students living in remote rural communities.

en: a long, determined search for something valuable or important
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("quest"): a long, determined search for something valuable or important

ex.en: Our quest for fresh bread led us across town.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "quest" (Từ vựng IELTS ("quest"): a long, determined search for something valuable or important) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: The quest for cleaner energy has encouraged governments to invest heavily in new storage technologies.

en: to walk unsteadily, as if about to fall
vi: Hành động / quá trình (stagger): to walk unsteadily, as if about to fall

ex.en: He staggered backwards as the heavy suitcase swung towards him.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "stagger" (Hành động / quá trình (stagger): to walk unsteadily, as if about to fall) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Employers could stagger working hours to ease congestion and reduce pressure on public transport.

en: a complete change in the appearance or nature of something
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("transformation"): a complete change in the appearance or nature of something

ex.en: The dusty attic underwent a transformation into a cosy bedroom.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "transformation" (Từ vựng IELTS ("transformation"): a complete change in the appearance or nature of something) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Investment in renewable energy could accelerate the transformation of industrial regions into centres of sustainable production.

en: Embarrassed because you have done something silly or wrong
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("sheepish"): Embarrassed because you have done something silly or wrong

ex.en: He gave a sheepish smile after spilling his juice.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "sheepish" (Từ vựng IELTS ("sheepish"): Embarrassed because you have done something silly or wrong) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Students may look sheepish after giving an incorrect answer, so teachers should respond with patience.

en: existing in or relating to traditional myths
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("mythical"): existing in or relating to traditional myths

ex.en: The museum displayed a painting of a mythical dragon.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "mythical" (Từ vựng IELTS ("mythical"): existing in or relating to traditional myths) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Mythical creatures in traditional stories can reveal how earlier societies understood nature and human behaviour.

en: The part of a cell containing most of its genetic material.
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("nucleus"): The part of a cell containing most of its genetic material.

ex.en: The cell's nucleus looked purple under our classroom microscope.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "nucleus" (Từ vựng IELTS ("nucleus"): The part of a cell containing most of its genetic material.) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Damage to genetic material in the nucleus can affect how a cell functions and divides.

en: The quality of happening at consistent intervals or following a pattern.
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("regularity"): The quality of happening at consistent intervals or following a pattern.

ex.en: The regularity of her morning walks helps her sleep better.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "regularity" (Từ vựng IELTS ("regularity"): The quality of happening at consistent intervals or following a pattern.) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: The regularity of public transport services strongly influences whether commuters choose buses over private cars.

en: To move smoothly and easily, often without much noise.
vi: Hành động / quá trình (glide): To move smoothly and easily, often without much noise.

ex.en: The swan glided across the pond towards the reeds.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "glide" (Hành động / quá trình (glide): To move smoothly and easily, often without much noise.) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Large birds conserve energy by gliding on rising air currents rather than continuously flapping their wings.

en: A serious promise to do or not do something
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("vow"): A serious promise to do or not do something

ex.en: She made a vow to visit her grandmother weekly.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "vow" (Từ vựng IELTS ("vow"): A serious promise to do or not do something) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Local leaders vowed to protect public parks despite growing pressure to develop more housing.

en: showing little interest or concern
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("indifferent"): showing little interest or concern

ex.en: Our cat remained indifferent to its expensive new toy.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "indifferent" (Từ vựng IELTS ("indifferent"): showing little interest or concern) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: People may appear indifferent to environmental problems when they believe their individual actions cannot make a difference.

en: a small part remaining after most has disappeared or been removed
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("remnant"): a small part remaining after most has disappeared or been removed

ex.en: Only a remnant of the old wall still stands.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "remnant" (Từ vựng IELTS ("remnant"): a small part remaining after most has disappeared or been removed) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Protecting remnants of ancient woodland can preserve habitats that support rare species and maintain local biodiversity.

en: the complete removal or destruction of something harmful
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("eradication"): the complete removal or destruction of something harmful

ex.en: Complete eradication of these weeds will take patience.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "eradication" (Từ vựng IELTS ("eradication"): the complete removal or destruction of something harmful) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: The eradication of infectious diseases requires sustained investment in vaccination programmes and public health infrastructure.

en: a person's usual emotional nature and way of reacting
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("temperament"): a person's usual emotional nature and way of reacting

ex.en: Our new puppy has a gentle temperament and rarely barks.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "temperament" (Từ vựng IELTS ("temperament"): a person's usual emotional nature and way of reacting) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: A calm temperament helps healthcare professionals communicate effectively with patients during stressful situations in busy hospitals.

en: To replace a film's original speech with another language.
vi: Hành động / quá trình (dub): To replace a film's original speech with another language.

ex.en: They dubbed the cartoon into Spanish for younger viewers.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "dub" (Hành động / quá trình (dub): To replace a film's original speech with another language.) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Journalists have dubbed the new railway a lifeline for rural communities previously isolated from major employment centres.

en: Something done to repair harm or show regret.
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("amends"): Something done to repair harm or show regret.

ex.en: I baked her a cake to make amends.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "amends" (Từ vựng IELTS ("amends"): Something done to repair harm or show regret.) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Companies should make amends for environmental damage by restoring habitats and compensating affected communities.

en: To start burning or cause something to burn.
vi: Hành động / quá trình (ignite): To start burning or cause something to burn.

ex.en: A tiny spark ignited the dry wood in the fireplace.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "ignite" (Hành động / quá trình (ignite): To start burning or cause something to burn.) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Practical science lessons can ignite students' curiosity and encourage them to explore unfamiliar ideas independently.

en: Using words in a clever and amusing way
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("witty"): Using words in a clever and amusing way

ex.en: Her witty reply made everyone at the table laugh.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "witty" (Từ vựng IELTS ("witty"): Using words in a clever and amusing way) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: A witty presentation can engage students, provided that humour supports rather than distracts from the lesson.

en: Official power to reject a decision, or its use.
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("veto"): Official power to reject a decision, or its use.

ex.en: The club president used her veto to stop the purchase.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "veto" (Từ vựng IELTS ("veto"): Official power to reject a decision, or its use.) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Giving every member a veto can protect minority interests but may also delay urgent collective decisions.

en: to cry loudly in pain, sadness, or distress
vi: Hành động / quá trình (wail): to cry loudly in pain, sadness, or distress

ex.en: The baby began to wail when her toy fell.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "wail" (Hành động / quá trình (wail): to cry loudly in pain, sadness, or distress) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Residents heard sirens wailing throughout the night as emergency teams responded to the severe flooding.

en: functioning as an adverb or relating to adverbs
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("adverbial"): functioning as an adverb or relating to adverbs

ex.en: Our teacher explained adverbial phrases using simple everyday examples.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "adverbial" (Từ vựng IELTS ("adverbial"): functioning as an adverb or relating to adverbs) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Understanding adverbial clauses helps language learners express relationships between events more precisely in academic writing.

en: a sculpture showing a person's head, shoulders, and upper chest
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("bust"): a sculpture showing a person's head, shoulders, and upper chest

ex.en: A marble bust stood beside the museum entrance.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "bust" (Từ vựng IELTS ("bust"): a sculpture showing a person's head, shoulders, and upper chest) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Displaying a bust of a local artist can help museums connect visitors with their community's cultural history.

en: a group of symptoms that occur together in a condition
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("syndrome"): a group of symptoms that occur together in a condition

ex.en: The doctor explained how the syndrome affects sleep.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "syndrome" (Từ vựng IELTS ("syndrome"): a group of symptoms that occur together in a condition) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Early recognition of a syndrome can help healthcare professionals provide appropriate support and manage symptoms more effectively.

en: An Australian egg-laying mammal with a flat bill and webbed feet.
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("platypus"): An Australian egg-laying mammal with a flat bill and webbed feet.

ex.en: We watched a platypus swimming quietly near the riverbank.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "platypus" (Từ vựng IELTS ("platypus"): An Australian egg-laying mammal with a flat bill and webbed feet.) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Protecting rivers from pollution is essential for the survival of the platypus and other freshwater animals.

en: To talk with someone and exchange thoughts.
vi: Hành động / quá trình (converse): To talk with someone and exchange thoughts.

ex.en: We conversed quietly while waiting for the train.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "converse" (Hành động / quá trình (converse): To talk with someone and exchange thoughts.) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Language exchange programmes allow students to converse with native speakers and develop confidence in unfamiliar social situations.

en: the act of carrying out a plan, order, or task

ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "execution" (Từ vựng IELTS ("execution"): the act of carrying out a plan, order, or task) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

en: Almost certainly, or as one confidently expects.

ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "doubtless" (Từ vựng IELTS ("doubtless"): Almost certainly, or as one confidently expects.) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

en: A conclusion reached from evidence rather than direct statements.

ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "inference" (Từ vựng IELTS ("inference"): A conclusion reached from evidence rather than direct statements.) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.vi: Đầu tư vào giao thông công cộng là giải pháp thiết thực để giảm bớt tình trạng kẹt xe.

ex.vi: Các chương trình giáo dục miễn phí đóng vai trò quan trọng trong việc xóa đói giảm nghèo.

alleviate pressure — giảm bớt áp lực
tip: Phân biệt: "alleviate" dùng cho vấn đề/nỗi khổ (poverty, traffic congestion, pain).

en: relating to written words or the wording of a document

ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "textual" (Từ vựng IELTS ("textual"): relating to written words or the wording of a document) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Students should support their interpretations with textual evidence rather than rely solely on personal reactions to a novel.

en: An outward appearance or slight degree of a particular quality

ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "semblance" (Từ vựng IELTS ("semblance"): An outward appearance or slight degree of a particular quality) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "indicative" (Từ vựng IELTS ("indicative"): Showing that something exists or is likely to be true.) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "barometer" (Từ vựng IELTS ("barometer"): an instrument that measures air pressure) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Consumer confidence is often regarded as a useful barometer of a country's overall economic health.

en: To give official permission for someone to do something.

ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "authorize" (Hành động / quá trình (authorize): To give official permission for someone to do something.) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Local authorities may authorize new housing developments only after assessing their likely effects on traffic and public services.

en: Careful and sensible about risks and future consequences.
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("prudent"): Careful and sensible about risks and future consequences.

ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "prudent" (Từ vựng IELTS ("prudent"): Careful and sensible about risks and future consequences.) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Prudent financial planning can help households cope with unexpected expenses during periods of economic uncertainty.

en: To become three times as much, or cause this increase.
vi: Hành động / quá trình (treble): To become three times as much, or cause this increase.

ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "treble" (Hành động / quá trình (treble): To become three times as much, or cause this increase.) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Investment in renewable energy could treble over the next decade if governments introduce stronger financial incentives.

en: Clever at getting what you want by deceiving others.
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("cunning"): Clever at getting what you want by deceiving others.

ex.en: The cunning fox waited until the dog fell asleep.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "cunning" (Từ vựng IELTS ("cunning"): Clever at getting what you want by deceiving others.) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Cunning advertising tactics can persuade consumers to purchase products they neither need nor can afford.

en: A narrow stretch of water reaching into the land.
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("inlet"): A narrow stretch of water reaching into the land.

ex.en: We paddled into a quiet inlet sheltered by cliffs.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "inlet" (Từ vựng IELTS ("inlet"): A narrow stretch of water reaching into the land.) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Coastal inlets provide sheltered habitats for marine species, but pollution can seriously damage these fragile ecosystems.

en: To grow strongly or develop successfully.
vi: Hành động / quá trình (flourish): To grow strongly or develop successfully.

ex.en: These herbs flourish on our warm, sunny kitchen windowsill.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "flourish" (Hành động / quá trình (flourish): To grow strongly or develop successfully.) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Small businesses are more likely to flourish when local governments provide affordable premises and reliable public transport.

en: Having a rough texture or consisting of large particles
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("coarse"): Having a rough texture or consisting of large particles

ex.en: The coarse wool scratched my neck all afternoon.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "coarse" (Từ vựng IELTS ("coarse"): Having a rough texture or consisting of large particles) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Coarse particles in urban air can irritate the lungs and worsen existing respiratory conditions among vulnerable residents.

en: Opposite in direction, order, or effect
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("inverse"): Opposite in direction, order, or effect

ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "inverse" (Từ vựng IELTS ("inverse"): Opposite in direction, order, or effect) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: The study found an inverse relationship between regular physical activity and reported stress levels among office workers.

en: A point just before something happens, especially something bad.
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("brink"): A point just before something happens, especially something bad.

ex.en: Their little shop was on the brink of closing.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "brink" (Từ vựng IELTS ("brink"): A point just before something happens, especially something bad.) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Prolonged drought has pushed several rural communities to the brink of a severe food crisis.

en: Only, with nothing or nobody else involved.
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("solely"): Only, with nothing or nobody else involved.

ex.en: This cupboard is used solely for cleaning supplies.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "solely" (Từ vựng IELTS ("solely"): Only, with nothing or nobody else involved.) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Schools should not judge students solely on examination results, since practical skills also matter.

en: To deliberately avoid someone or something.

ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "shun" (Hành động / quá trình (shun): To deliberately avoid someone or something.) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Some graduates shun corporate careers because they value personal independence more than a high salary.

en: The act of formally proposing someone for a position or award.
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("nomination"): The act of formally proposing someone for a position or award.

ex.en: Her nomination for the teaching award surprised everyone.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "nomination" (Từ vựng IELTS ("nomination"): The act of formally proposing someone for a position or award.) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: A transparent nomination process can help ensure that leadership candidates represent the interests of the wider community.

en: To the extent that something is true or possible.

ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "insofar" (Hành động / quá trình (insofar): To the extent that something is true or possible.) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Online learning is effective insofar as students have reliable internet access and receive adequate support from teachers.

en: To subject someone to unwanted sexual touching or behaviour.
vi: Hành động / quá trình (molest): To subject someone to unwanted sexual touching or behaviour.

ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "molest" (Hành động / quá trình (molest): To subject someone to unwanted sexual touching or behaviour.) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Public transport authorities should provide clear reporting procedures for passengers targeted by individuals who molest others.

en: to divide something into smaller parts or groups
vi: Hành động / quá trình (subdivide): to divide something into smaller parts or groups

ex.en: We subdivided the drawer with small wooden dividers.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "subdivide" (Hành động / quá trình (subdivide): to divide something into smaller parts or groups) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

en: A change in the genetic material of an organism.

ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "mutation" (Sự đột biến gen) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: A genetic mutation may increase disease risk, although environmental factors also influence whether symptoms eventually develop.

ex.en: I carefully disentangled the necklace from my headphones.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "disentangle" (Hành động / quá trình (disentangle): To separate things that have become twisted or caught together.) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

en: Angry because something seems unfair or insulting.

en: not having enough of something necessary
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("deficient"): not having enough of something necessary

vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("proofreading"): checking written material for errors before its final version

ex.en: I am proofreading my sister's essay at the kitchen table.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "proofreading" (Từ vựng IELTS ("proofreading"): checking written material for errors before its final version) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Careful proofreading helps students remove spelling errors and present their research more professionally.

en: Willing to talk and share thoughts or information.
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("communicative"): Willing to talk and share thoughts or information.

ex.en: My brother becomes more communicative during our evening walks.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "communicative" (Từ vựng IELTS ("communicative"): Willing to talk and share thoughts or information.) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Communicative activities in language classrooms help learners develop confidence and use new vocabulary in meaningful contexts.

en: Having no legal force or effect.
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("null"): Having no legal force or effect.

ex.en: The court declared their rental agreement null and void.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "null" (Từ vựng IELTS ("null"): Having no legal force or effect.) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: A contract may be declared null if one party was forced to accept its terms.

en: allowed or recognised by law
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("lawful"): allowed or recognised by law

ex.en: The lost bicycle was returned to its lawful owner.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "lawful" (Từ vựng IELTS ("lawful"): allowed or recognised by law) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Governments should ensure that personal information is collected only for lawful purposes and protected against misuse.

en: Treating others as inferior because of status, wealth, or taste.
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("snobbish"): Treating others as inferior because of status, wealth, or taste.

ex.en: Her snobbish neighbour refused to visit our small flat.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "snobbish" (Từ vựng IELTS ("snobbish"): Treating others as inferior because of status, wealth, or taste.) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Snobbish attitudes towards vocational training can discourage young people from pursuing valuable practical careers.

en: To try hard to achieve something
vi: Hành động / quá trình (endeavor): To try hard to achieve something

ex.en: We endeavor to answer every message before dinner.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "endeavor" (Hành động / quá trình (endeavor): To try hard to achieve something) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Universities should endeavor to make higher education accessible to students from a wider range of backgrounds.

en: Alone, or preferring to live or spend time alone.
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("solitary"): Alone, or preferring to live or spend time alone.

ex.en: A solitary walker followed the quiet path through the woods.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "solitary" (Từ vựng IELTS ("solitary"): Alone, or preferring to live or spend time alone.) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: While solitary study allows deep concentration, collaborative learning helps students develop communication skills and consider alternative perspectives.

en: Enough or more than enough for a particular purpose
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("ample"): Enough or more than enough for a particular purpose

ex.en: We have ample time for breakfast before the train leaves.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "ample" (Từ vựng IELTS ("ample"): Enough or more than enough for a particular purpose) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Providing ample green space in residential areas can improve public health and encourage more active lifestyles.

en: behaviour intended or likely to cause anger or a reaction
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("provocation"): behaviour intended or likely to cause anger or a reaction

ex.en: Despite the provocation, Amir stayed calm and walked away.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "provocation" (Từ vựng IELTS ("provocation"): behaviour intended or likely to cause anger or a reaction) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Teaching children to respond calmly to provocation can reduce conflict and promote a more supportive school environment.

en: to say something again to make it clear or emphasise it
vi: Hành động / quá trình (reiterate): to say something again to make it clear or emphasise it

ex.en: Before we left, Dad reiterated the importance of staying together.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "reiterate" (Hành động / quá trình (reiterate): to say something again to make it clear or emphasise it) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: The report reiterates that investment in public transport is essential for reducing urban air pollution.

en: despite something that might prevent or contradict something else
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("notwithstanding"): despite something that might prevent or contradict something else

ex.en: Notwithstanding the rain, we enjoyed our walk by the river.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "notwithstanding" (Từ vựng IELTS ("notwithstanding"): despite something that might prevent or contradict something else) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Notwithstanding its initial costs, investment in renewable energy can provide substantial economic and environmental benefits over time.

en: deserving disapproval because of dishonest or unfair behaviour
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("dishonorable"): deserving disapproval because of dishonest or unfair behaviour

ex.en: He felt that cheating at cards was dishonorable.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "dishonorable" (Từ vựng IELTS ("dishonorable"): deserving disapproval because of dishonest or unfair behaviour) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Dishonorable conduct by public officials can weaken trust in institutions and discourage citizens from participating in politics.

en: Extremely careful and attentive to every small detail.
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("meticulous"): Extremely careful and attentive to every small detail.

ex.en: He made meticulous notes while repairing the old clock.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "meticulous" (Từ vựng IELTS ("meticulous"): Extremely careful and attentive to every small detail.) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Meticulous planning is essential when researchers conduct experiments involving complex equipment and sensitive environmental measurements.

en: Emitting light through fluorescence, or using this effect for lighting.
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("fluorescent"): Emitting light through fluorescence, or using this effect for lighting.

ex.en: The fluorescent lamp flickered above the kitchen sink.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "fluorescent" (Từ vựng IELTS ("fluorescent"): Emitting light through fluorescence, or using this effect for lighting.) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Replacing fluorescent lighting with more efficient alternatives can lower electricity consumption in schools and offices.

en: Relating to education at college or university level.
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("tertiary"): Relating to education at college or university level.

ex.en: My sister hopes to enter tertiary education next year.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "tertiary" (Từ vựng IELTS ("tertiary"): Relating to education at college or university level.) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Affordable tertiary education can improve social mobility by giving disadvantaged students access to professional qualifications.

en: to agree with someone or share the same opinion
vi: Hành động / quá trình (concur): to agree with someone or share the same opinion

ex.en: I concur with your suggestion to leave before lunch.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "concur" (Hành động / quá trình (concur): to agree with someone or share the same opinion) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Most researchers concur that investment in early childhood education brings substantial benefits to society.

en: Lasting longer than expected or desired.
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("protracted"): Lasting longer than expected or desired.

ex.en: After a protracted discussion, we finally chose a sofa.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "protracted" (Từ vựng IELTS ("protracted"): Lasting longer than expected or desired.) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Protracted negotiations over funding can delay essential infrastructure projects and increase their overall cost considerably.

en: a state in which growth, activity, or development stops
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("stagnation"): a state in which growth, activity, or development stops

ex.en: After years of stagnation, our shop finally attracted new customers.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "stagnation" (Từ vựng IELTS ("stagnation"): a state in which growth, activity, or development stops) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Prolonged economic stagnation can reduce employment opportunities and discourage investment in essential public services.

en: Cause someone or something serious suffering or difficulty
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("afflict"): Cause someone or something serious suffering or difficulty

ex.en: Seasonal allergies afflict my brother whenever the flowers bloom.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "afflict" (Từ vựng IELTS ("afflict"): Cause someone or something serious suffering or difficulty) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Water shortages continue to afflict rural communities, limiting agricultural production and increasing the burden on local families.

en: A feeling of satisfaction from doing something meaningful
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("fulfillment"): A feeling of satisfaction from doing something meaningful

ex.en: She finds fulfillment in teaching children to swim.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "fulfillment" (Từ vựng IELTS ("fulfillment"): A feeling of satisfaction from doing something meaningful) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: For many employees, personal fulfillment matters as much as financial security when choosing a career.

en: A person or business that sells writing and office supplies.
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("stationer"): A person or business that sells writing and office supplies.

ex.en: The stationer helped me choose a notebook for school.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "stationer" (Từ vựng IELTS ("stationer"): A person or business that sells writing and office supplies.) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: A local stationer may struggle to compete with online retailers offering cheaper office supplies.

en: A living organism too small to see without a microscope
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("microbe"): A living organism too small to see without a microscope

ex.en: Some microbes help turn fresh milk into thick yoghurt.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "microbe" (Từ vựng IELTS ("microbe"): A living organism too small to see without a microscope) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Soil microbes play an essential role in recycling nutrients and maintaining the fertility of agricultural land.

en: A container or appliance that cooks food using steam.
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("steamer"): A container or appliance that cooks food using steam.

ex.en: Put the dumplings in the steamer for ten minutes.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "steamer" (Từ vựng IELTS ("steamer"): A container or appliance that cooks food using steam.) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: The arrival of the steamer transformed river trade by allowing goods to travel more reliably over long distances.

en: The soft light just after sunset or before sunrise
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("twilight"): The soft light just after sunset or before sunrise

ex.en: We walked home through the park in the twilight.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "twilight" (Từ vựng IELTS ("twilight"): The soft light just after sunset or before sunrise) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: In the twilight of their careers, experienced athletes can support younger competitors through coaching and mentoring.

en: a person who takes part in a competition
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("entrant"): a person who takes part in a competition

ex.en: Each entrant brought a homemade cake to the competition.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "entrant" (Từ vựng IELTS ("entrant"): a person who takes part in a competition) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: New entrants to the renewable energy market often struggle to compete with established companies for investment.

en: Of central importance to a system, belief, or activity.
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("cardinal"): Of central importance to a system, belief, or activity.

ex.en: Our cardinal rule is to leave nobody behind.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "cardinal" (Từ vựng IELTS ("cardinal"): Of central importance to a system, belief, or activity.) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Protecting patient privacy should remain a cardinal principle when hospitals introduce new digital record systems.

en: A belief that is commonly accepted but actually false.
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("fallacy"): A belief that is commonly accepted but actually false.

ex.en: It is a fallacy that expensive shoes always last longer.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "fallacy" (Từ vựng IELTS ("fallacy"): A belief that is commonly accepted but actually false.) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: The claim that economic growth automatically benefits every citizen rests on a fallacy about how wealth is distributed.

en: A wide topped tool with a narrow tube for pouring
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("funnel"): A wide topped tool with a narrow tube for pouring

ex.en: Use a funnel to pour oil into the bottle.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "funnel" (Từ vựng IELTS ("funnel"): A wide topped tool with a narrow tube for pouring) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Well-designed drainage systems funnel rainwater into storage tanks, reducing the risk of urban flooding.

en: Intended to hurt someone through harsh criticism or unkind remarks.
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("cutting"): Intended to hurt someone through harsh criticism or unkind remarks.

ex.en: His cutting remark about her cooking spoiled the meal.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "cutting" (Từ vựng IELTS ("cutting"): Intended to hurt someone through harsh criticism or unkind remarks.) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Cutting comments from teachers can discourage students from asking questions and participating actively in class.

en: to obtain something, especially through effort or careful arrangements
vi: Hành động / quá trình (procure): to obtain something, especially through effort or careful arrangements

ex.en: We finally procured a spare part for the oven.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "procure" (Hành động / quá trình (procure): to obtain something, especially through effort or careful arrangements) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Local authorities must procure reliable equipment to ensure that drinking water remains safe during emergencies.

en: the way you hold your body when sitting or standing
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("posture"): the way you hold your body when sitting or standing

ex.en: Adjusting your chair can improve your posture while working.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "posture" (Từ vựng IELTS ("posture"): the way you hold your body when sitting or standing) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Schools should teach children how good posture and regular movement can reduce discomfort during prolonged study.

en: Lacking physical strength, energy, or intensity.
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("feeble"): Lacking physical strength, energy, or intensity.

ex.en: After the illness, he felt too feeble to cook.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "feeble" (Từ vựng IELTS ("feeble"): Lacking physical strength, energy, or intensity.) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Feeble enforcement of environmental regulations allows some factories to continue polluting rivers without facing meaningful consequences.

en: A situation where disagreement prevents any further progress.
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("deadlock"): A situation where disagreement prevents any further progress.

ex.en: Our discussion reached a deadlock over who should pay.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "deadlock" (Từ vựng IELTS ("deadlock"): A situation where disagreement prevents any further progress.) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: An independent mediator may help break the deadlock when negotiations between employers and workers fail.

en: a tiny blood vessel or an extremely narrow tube
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("capillary"): a tiny blood vessel or an extremely narrow tube

ex.en: The diagram shows a capillary beside several skin cells.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "capillary" (Từ vựng IELTS ("capillary"): a tiny blood vessel or an extremely narrow tube) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Capillary action allows water to move through narrow spaces in soil, helping moisture reach plant roots.

en: being the first of its kind for someone or something
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("maiden"): being the first of its kind for someone or something

ex.en: The new ferry completed its maiden voyage this morning.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "maiden" (Từ vựng IELTS ("maiden"): being the first of its kind for someone or something) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: The aircraft's maiden flight marked an important step towards developing cleaner forms of regional transport.

en: The legal process of charging and trying someone for a crime.
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("prosecution"): The legal process of charging and trying someone for a crime.

ex.en: The shop owner faced prosecution for selling stolen bicycles.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "prosecution" (Từ vựng IELTS ("prosecution"): The legal process of charging and trying someone for a crime.) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Effective prosecution of environmental offences requires reliable evidence and sufficient resources for specialist legal teams.

en: Accepting different opinions and supporting people's freedom to choose.
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("liberal"): Accepting different opinions and supporting people's freedom to choose.

ex.en: My parents are liberal about what clothes I wear.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "liberal" (Từ vựng IELTS ("liberal"): Accepting different opinions and supporting people's freedom to choose.) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: A liberal society should protect individual freedoms while encouraging citizens to respect the rights of others.

en: to form an idea or imagine something
vi: Hành động / quá trình (conceive): to form an idea or imagine something

ex.en: She conceived the idea while walking through the park.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "conceive" (Hành động / quá trình (conceive): to form an idea or imagine something) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Urban planners must conceive new ways of accommodating population growth without sacrificing green spaces or affordable housing.

en: requiring a lot of time and hard work
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("laborious"): requiring a lot of time and hard work

ex.en: Removing the old wallpaper was a slow, laborious job.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "laborious" (Từ vựng IELTS ("laborious"): requiring a lot of time and hard work) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Digitising historical records is a laborious process, but it greatly improves public access to valuable research materials.

en: The quality of being clear and easy to understand.
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("clarity"): The quality of being clear and easy to understand.

ex.en: I appreciate the clarity of your instructions for this game.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "clarity" (Từ vựng IELTS ("clarity"): The quality of being clear and easy to understand.) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Greater clarity in public health advice can help people make informed decisions about their daily habits.

en: Grateful to someone for help or support.
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("indebted"): Grateful to someone for help or support.

ex.en: I am deeply indebted to you for your kindness.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "indebted" (Từ vựng IELTS ("indebted"): Grateful to someone for help or support.) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Heavily indebted countries may struggle to invest adequately in public healthcare and education.

en: A loud, unpleasant mixture of continuing noises.
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("din"): A loud, unpleasant mixture of continuing noises.

ex.en: We could barely hear each other above the din.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "din" (Từ vựng IELTS ("din"): A loud, unpleasant mixture of continuing noises.) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: The constant din of traffic can reduce residents' quality of life and disturb their sleep.

en: Communication over a distance using electronic signals.
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("telecommunication"): Communication over a distance using electronic signals.

ex.en: Telecommunication keeps our family connected despite the ocean between us.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "telecommunication" (Từ vựng IELTS ("telecommunication"): Communication over a distance using electronic signals.) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Investment in telecommunication infrastructure can improve rural access to education, healthcare, and employment opportunities.

en: money spent on something
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("expenditure"): money spent on something

ex.en: We track our monthly expenditure in a small notebook.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "expenditure" (Từ vựng IELTS ("expenditure"): money spent on something) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Higher public expenditure on preventive healthcare could reduce the long-term cost of treating chronic diseases.

en: the act of keeping something or preventing someone from leaving
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("retention"): the act of keeping something or preventing someone from leaving

ex.en: Our manager improved staff retention by offering flexible hours.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "retention" (Từ vựng IELTS ("retention"): the act of keeping something or preventing someone from leaving) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Regular revision and adequate sleep can improve the retention of information among students preparing for examinations.

en: Hard, boring work that must be repeated regularly.
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("drudgery"): Hard, boring work that must be repeated regularly.

ex.en: A dishwasher takes much of the drudgery out of cleaning.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "drudgery" (Từ vựng IELTS ("drudgery"): Hard, boring work that must be repeated regularly.) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Automation can reduce the drudgery of repetitive tasks, allowing workers to focus on more creative activities.

en: A lawyer who presents a criminal case against an accused person.
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("prosecutor"): A lawyer who presents a criminal case against an accused person.

ex.en: The prosecutor asked the witness about the missing bicycle.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "prosecutor" (Từ vựng IELTS ("prosecutor"): A lawyer who presents a criminal case against an accused person.) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: An independent prosecutor can help ensure that criminal cases are handled fairly without inappropriate political interference.

en: Feeling sorry about something that happened or something you did.
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("regretful"): Feeling sorry about something that happened or something you did.

ex.en: He looked regretful after speaking sharply to his sister.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "regretful" (Từ vựng IELTS ("regretful"): Feeling sorry about something that happened or something you did.) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Some graduates feel regretful about choosing a degree solely for its expected financial rewards.

en: The legal right or arrangement to occupy rented property.
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("tenancy"): The legal right or arrangement to occupy rented property.

ex.en: Our tenancy ends next month, so we are packing.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "tenancy" (Từ vựng IELTS ("tenancy"): The legal right or arrangement to occupy rented property.) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Clear tenancy agreements can protect both landlords and tenants by defining their respective rights and responsibilities.

en: Property, shares, or other assets owned by someone.
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("holding"): Property, shares, or other assets owned by someone.

ex.en: She sold her holding in the family business yesterday.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "holding" (Từ vựng IELTS ("holding"): Property, shares, or other assets owned by someone.) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Large investment funds can influence corporate decisions through their substantial holdings in major companies across different sectors.

en: Someone found guilty of a crime, especially someone in prison.
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("convict"): Someone found guilty of a crime, especially someone in prison.

ex.en: The former convict now works at a local bakery.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "convict" (Từ vựng IELTS ("convict"): Someone found guilty of a crime, especially someone in prison.) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Education programmes can help a convict develop practical skills and prepare for employment after release from prison.

en: An insulting term for someone who is frequently drunk.
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("drunkard"): An insulting term for someone who is frequently drunk.

ex.en: The novel portrays the lonely innkeeper as a drunkard.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "drunkard" (Từ vựng IELTS ("drunkard"): An insulting term for someone who is frequently drunk.) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Calling someone a drunkard can reinforce stigma and discourage them from seeking professional help for alcohol dependence.

en: A dog bred to hunt using smell or sight.
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("hound"): A dog bred to hunt using smell or sight.

ex.en: The hound followed a scent through the wet grass.

vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("stationary"): Not moving or changing position.

en: Likely or willing to think or act a certain way.

ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "inclined" (Từ vựng IELTS ("inclined"): Likely or willing to think or act a certain way.) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

en: A country's independent authority to govern itself.
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("sovereignty"): A country's independent authority to govern itself.

ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "sovereignty" (Từ vựng IELTS ("sovereignty"): A country's independent authority to govern itself.) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "simulate" (Mô phỏng, giả lập) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Researchers simulate extreme weather conditions to assess how new building materials perform under environmental stress.

en: to start a line further inward than the surrounding lines

ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "indent" (Hành động / quá trình (indent): to start a line further inward than the surrounding lines) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

en: a system of beliefs shaping political or social views
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("ideology"): a system of beliefs shaping political or social views

ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "ideology" (Từ vựng IELTS ("ideology"): a system of beliefs shaping political or social views) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

en: a social rule against discussing or doing something

ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "taboo" (Từ vựng IELTS ("taboo"): a social rule against discussing or doing something) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

en: to strengthen a place or structure against attack or damage
vi: Hành động / quá trình (fortify): to strengthen a place or structure against attack or damage

ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "fortify" (Hành động / quá trình (fortify): to strengthen a place or structure against attack or damage) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

en: A long, narrow ditch dug in the ground.

ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "trench" (Từ vựng IELTS ("trench"): A long, narrow ditch dug in the ground.) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

en: A machine or structure that burns waste at high temperatures
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("incinerator"): A machine or structure that burns waste at high temperatures

ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "incinerator" (Từ vựng IELTS ("incinerator"): A machine or structure that burns waste at high temperatures) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Modern incinerators can generate electricity from waste, but their emissions require strict monitoring to protect public health.

en: highest in rank, authority, or importance
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("supreme"): highest in rank, authority, or importance

ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "supreme" (Từ vựng IELTS ("supreme"): highest in rank, authority, or importance) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: In many countries, the supreme court can review whether new legislation complies with the constitution.

en: confidence and willingness to take risks or challenge expectations
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("boldness"): confidence and willingness to take risks or challenge expectations

ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "boldness" (Từ vựng IELTS ("boldness"): confidence and willingness to take risks or challenge expectations) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

en: using careful examination of details to understand something
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("analytic"): using careful examination of details to understand something

en: the process of making a sound or signal stronger
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("amplification"): the process of making a sound or signal stronger

en: Greater importance that gives someone or something priority over others.

en: The power to evoke shared feelings, memories, or understanding.

en: to bend your upper body forward and downward

vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("postmortem"): a medical examination of a body to determine death's cause

en: to confirm officially that something is true or meets standards

ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "certify" (Hành động / quá trình (certify): to confirm officially that something is true or meets standards) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

en: to become stronger or make a feeling or effect stronger

en: To publicly support a policy, idea, or course of action.

ex.en: Protecting the habitat of a tigress and her cubs can help maintain a healthy tiger population.

en: A natural ability to learn or do something well

ex.en: Schools should recognise practical aptitude as well as academic achievement when advising students about careers.

en: to make someone feel deeply ashamed or foolish

en: Careful examination of something, especially to find faults or problems.

en: an animal, such as a frog, living in water and on land
vi: Động vật lưỡng cư

ex.en: Declining amphibian populations may indicate changes in water quality and wider damage to freshwater ecosystems.

en: The process of making something stronger or more effective.

ex.en: Advances in optics have improved medical imaging, allowing doctors to examine internal structures in greater detail.

en: Relating to time or the order of events.

ex.en: Understanding temporal patterns in electricity demand can help cities manage their energy supplies more efficiently.

en: unnecessary because it is no longer needed or repeats something

en: morally right or acting according to strong moral principles

en: less strict or severe when enforcing rules or giving punishment

ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "lenient" (Từ vựng IELTS ("lenient"): less strict or severe when enforcing rules or giving punishment) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

en: having a rectangular shape with unequal adjacent sides
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("oblong"): having a rectangular shape with unequal adjacent sides

en: Rise and fall irregularly in level, amount, or value.

en: The practice of following a rule, law, or custom

en: expressing a meaning opposite to the words used
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("ironical"): expressing a meaning opposite to the words used

ex.en: It is ironical that technologies designed to save time can leave workers feeling busier than ever.

en: visible on the outside rather than reflecting inner feelings

ex.en: A city's outward appearance may improve through redevelopment, while underlying social inequalities remain largely unchanged.

en: To spread out or make people or things spread out

ex.en: Planting trees can help disperse strong winds and protect exposed farmland from soil erosion.

en: an organism such as a mushroom, mould, or yeast

ex.en: Some types of fungus help maintain healthy forests by breaking down dead wood and recycling nutrients.

en: an idea accepted as the basis for reasoning or action

ex.en: The policy is based on the premise that affordable education improves both individual prospects and national productivity.

en: the state of containing no unwanted or harmful substances
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("purity"): the state of containing no unwanted or harmful substances

ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "purity" (Từ vựng IELTS ("purity"): the state of containing no unwanted or harmful substances) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Regular monitoring of water purity is essential for preventing disease and maintaining public confidence in local supplies.

en: The freedom or right to make decisions independently.
