ex.en: My brother gets touchy when anyone criticises his cooking.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "touchy" (Từ vựng IELTS ("touchy"): Easily upset or offended, especially by criticism.) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Pay differences remain a touchy subject in many workplaces, making open discussions about fairness particularly difficult.

en: The skill and quality shown in making something.
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("workmanship"): The skill and quality shown in making something.

ex.en: The smooth wooden joints reveal the chair's excellent workmanship.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "workmanship" (Từ vựng IELTS ("workmanship"): The skill and quality shown in making something.) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Consumers may accept higher prices when products demonstrate superior workmanship and offer a longer useful life.

en: to gather and arrange people, resources, or ideas effectively
vi: Hành động / quá trình (marshal): to gather and arrange people, resources, or ideas effectively

ex.en: A volunteer marshalled the runners into a neat line.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "marshal" (Hành động / quá trình (marshal): to gather and arrange people, resources, or ideas effectively) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Governments must marshal resources effectively to provide emergency housing for communities affected by severe flooding.

en: relating to medicines or their production
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("pharmaceutical"): relating to medicines or their production

ex.en: My sister works in a pharmaceutical research laboratory.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "pharmaceutical" (Từ vựng IELTS ("pharmaceutical"): relating to medicines or their production) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Pharmaceutical companies should ensure that essential medicines remain affordable for patients in poorer communities.

en: offering little hope of improvement or success
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("bleak"): offering little hope of improvement or success

ex.en: Without enough rain, the farm faces a bleak future.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "bleak" (Từ vựng IELTS ("bleak"): offering little hope of improvement or success) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Employment prospects remain bleak in rural areas where traditional industries have declined and investment is limited.

en: Very tired, especially after prolonged effort
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("weary"): Very tired, especially after prolonged effort

ex.en: The weary hikers rested beside a stream before sunset.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "weary" (Từ vựng IELTS ("weary"): Very tired, especially after prolonged effort) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Commuters who endure long journeys often arrive home too weary to exercise or spend quality time with family.

en: A layer that covers a surface or area
vi: Lớp phủ địa chất nằm giữa vỏ và lõi Trái Đất

ex.en: A mantle of snow covered the garden overnight.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "mantle" (Lớp phủ địa chất nằm giữa vỏ và lõi Trái Đất) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Younger researchers must take on the mantle of leadership as experienced scientists retire from their positions.

en: used in or connected with a formal public ceremony
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("ceremonial"): used in or connected with a formal public ceremony

ex.en: The mayor wore a ceremonial robe for the opening.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "ceremonial" (Từ vựng IELTS ("ceremonial"): used in or connected with a formal public ceremony) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Traditional ceremonial clothing can strengthen cultural identity and connect younger generations with their community's history.

en: Relating to the moon.
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("lunar"): Relating to the moon.

ex.en: We watched the lunar eclipse from our garden.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "lunar" (Từ vựng IELTS ("lunar"): Relating to the moon.) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Research on lunar rocks helps scientists understand how the moon and the early solar system developed.

en: to manage an organization or put a system into operation
vi: Hành động / quá trình (administer): to manage an organization or put a system into operation

ex.en: The nurse administered the medicine before I went home.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "administer" (Hành động / quá trình (administer): to manage an organization or put a system into operation) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Local authorities administer housing programmes designed to provide affordable accommodation for families on low incomes.

en: The chemical process of burning, which releases heat.
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("combustion"): The chemical process of burning, which releases heat.

ex.en: The stove needs enough air for efficient combustion.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "combustion" (Từ vựng IELTS ("combustion"): The chemical process of burning, which releases heat.) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: The combustion of fossil fuels releases carbon dioxide, contributing significantly to the rise in global temperatures.

en: Having no name, or having a name that remains unknown
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("nameless"): Having no name, or having a name that remains unknown

ex.en: A nameless donor left fresh flowers outside the shelter.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "nameless" (Từ vựng IELTS ("nameless"): Having no name, or having a name that remains unknown) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Many nameless workers contributed to the construction of monuments that now attract tourists worldwide.

en: an event causing extremely serious damage or suffering
vi: Thảm họa lớn, đại họa

ex.en: The flood was a catastrophe for our small village.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "catastrophe" (Thảm họa lớn, đại họa) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Investing in stronger coastal defences could prevent a natural hazard from becoming a humanitarian catastrophe.

en: a ring of flowers or leaves used decoratively or ceremonially
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("wreath"): a ring of flowers or leaves used decoratively or ceremonially

ex.en: She hung a wreath of leaves on the door.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "wreath" (Từ vựng IELTS ("wreath"): a ring of flowers or leaves used decoratively or ceremonially) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Laying a wreath at a memorial allows communities to express shared grief and honour the past.

en: Clear enough for written or printed words to be read.
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("legible"): Clear enough for written or printed words to be read.

ex.en: Your handwriting is much more legible with this pen.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "legible" (Từ vựng IELTS ("legible"): Clear enough for written or printed words to be read.) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Public information should be presented in a legible format so that older residents can access essential services independently.

en: kind and polite, especially when treating others generously
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("gracious"): kind and polite, especially when treating others generously

ex.en: Our gracious host brought extra blankets for everyone.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "gracious" (Từ vựng IELTS ("gracious"): kind and polite, especially when treating others generously) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Public figures who remain gracious towards their critics can encourage more respectful discussion within society.

en: A person who works on a ship at sea.
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("seaman"): A person who works on a ship at sea.

ex.en: The experienced seaman checked the ropes before the ship departed.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "seaman" (Từ vựng IELTS ("seaman"): A person who works on a ship at sea.) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Every seaman should receive practical safety training before joining a crew on an international shipping route.

en: requiring considerable effort and sustained hard work
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("arduous"): requiring considerable effort and sustained hard work

ex.en: The arduous climb left us exhausted but deeply satisfied.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "arduous" (Từ vựng IELTS ("arduous"): requiring considerable effort and sustained hard work) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Restoring damaged ecosystems is an arduous process that requires sustained investment and cooperation between scientists and local communities.

en: in a clear and direct way that leaves no doubt
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("expressly"): in a clear and direct way that leaves no doubt

ex.en: I expressly asked for a room away from the lift.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "expressly" (Từ vựng IELTS ("expressly"): in a clear and direct way that leaves no doubt) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Public funds allocated expressly for environmental protection should not be diverted to projects that increase industrial pollution.

en: an idea accepted as true without enough evidence
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("supposition"): an idea accepted as true without enough evidence

ex.en: Your supposition about the missing keys turned out wrong.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "supposition" (Từ vựng IELTS ("supposition"): an idea accepted as true without enough evidence) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Education policies should be based on reliable evidence rather than supposition about how children learn.

en: Relating to heat
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("thermal"): Relating to heat

ex.en: Our thermal camera shows where heat escapes the house.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "thermal" (Từ vựng IELTS ("thermal"): Relating to heat) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Improving thermal insulation in older buildings can reduce energy consumption and make homes more comfortable during winter.

en: To recognize or explain the differences between things
vi: Hành động / quá trình (differentiate): To recognize or explain the differences between things

ex.en: Can you differentiate these two birds by their songs?
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "differentiate" (Hành động / quá trình (differentiate): To recognize or explain the differences between things) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Schools should teach students to differentiate between reliable evidence and unsupported claims in online media.

en: moving or responding slowly, often from lack of energy
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("sluggish"): moving or responding slowly, often from lack of energy

ex.en: I felt sluggish after eating such a large lunch.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "sluggish" (Từ vựng IELTS ("sluggish"): moving or responding slowly, often from lack of energy) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Sluggish economic growth can discourage investment and limit employment opportunities for recent university graduates.

en: To decorate cloth by sewing patterns with thread.
vi: Hành động / quá trình (embroider): To decorate cloth by sewing patterns with thread.

ex.en: My aunt embroidered tiny flowers around the pillow's edge.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "embroider" (Hành động / quá trình (embroider): To decorate cloth by sewing patterns with thread.) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Local artisans embroider traditional patterns on clothing, preserving cultural knowledge while creating products that appeal to visitors.

en: A decorative picture made by cutting shapes from paper
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("papercut"): A decorative picture made by cutting shapes from paper

ex.en: She framed a delicate papercut of birds and flowers.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "papercut" (Từ vựng IELTS ("papercut"): A decorative picture made by cutting shapes from paper) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Displaying traditional papercuts in community museums can help younger generations appreciate local craft skills and cultural heritage.

en: Consisting of parts or people that are all similar
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("homogeneous"): Consisting of parts or people that are all similar

ex.en: Stir the sauce until the mixture is completely homogeneous.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "homogeneous" (Từ vựng IELTS ("homogeneous"): Consisting of parts or people that are all similar) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Treating urban populations as homogeneous can lead planners to overlook important differences in residents' needs.

en: Beliefs and principles about what is right and wrong
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("morality"): Beliefs and principles about what is right and wrong

ex.en: Our family discussed morality after finding a lost wallet.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "morality" (Từ vựng IELTS ("morality"): Beliefs and principles about what is right and wrong) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: The morality of animal testing remains controversial, particularly when potential medical benefits conflict with concerns about animal welfare.

en: To remove the cap from a container or pen.
vi: Hành động / quá trình (uncap): To remove the cap from a container or pen.

ex.en: She uncapped the bottle and poured everyone some juice.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "uncap" (Hành động / quá trình (uncap): To remove the cap from a container or pen.) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Laboratory staff should uncap sample containers carefully to prevent contamination and maintain reliable research results.

en: General agreement among members of a group.
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("consensus"): General agreement among members of a group.

ex.en: We finally reached a consensus on where to eat.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "consensus" (Từ vựng IELTS ("consensus"): General agreement among members of a group.) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: There is a broad consensus among researchers that early childhood education can improve children's future learning outcomes.

en: A woman having a relationship with someone married to another person.
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("mistress"): A woman having a relationship with someone married to another person.

ex.en: In the novel, he buys his mistress a necklace.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "mistress" (Từ vựng IELTS ("mistress"): A woman having a relationship with someone married to another person.) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Historical novels often portray a wealthy man's mistress as financially dependent, reflecting unequal opportunities for women.

en: extremely ugly or unpleasant
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("hideous"): extremely ugly or unpleasant

ex.en: That hideous carpet clashes with everything in the room.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "hideous" (Từ vựng IELTS ("hideous"): extremely ugly or unpleasant) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Poorly planned developments can create hideous buildings that damage the visual character of historic neighbourhoods.

en: A strong-smelling gas also dissolved in water for cleaning.
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("ammonia"): A strong-smelling gas also dissolved in water for cleaning.

ex.en: This cleaning liquid contains ammonia, so keep the window open.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "ammonia" (Từ vựng IELTS ("ammonia"): A strong-smelling gas also dissolved in water for cleaning.) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Ammonia emissions from agriculture can contribute to air pollution and damage sensitive natural habitats.

en: the act of building or putting a structure upright
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("erection"): the act of building or putting a structure upright

ex.en: The erection of our garden shed took all afternoon.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "erection" (Từ vựng IELTS ("erection"): the act of building or putting a structure upright) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: The erection of temporary flood barriers can protect vulnerable homes while permanent defences are being constructed.

en: Loyalty and support given to a country, group, or leader.
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("allegiance"): Loyalty and support given to a country, group, or leader.

ex.en: Despite moving abroad, he kept his allegiance to his hometown club.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "allegiance" (Từ vựng IELTS ("allegiance"): Loyalty and support given to a country, group, or leader.) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Political allegiance can influence how voters interpret economic policies and assess the performance of elected officials.

en: extreme tiredness caused by effort, stress, or illness
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("fatigue"): extreme tiredness caused by effort, stress, or illness

ex.en: After the long hike, fatigue made my legs shake.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "fatigue" (Từ vựng IELTS ("fatigue"): extreme tiredness caused by effort, stress, or illness) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Persistent fatigue can reduce employees' concentration and increase the likelihood of accidents in the workplace.

en: extremely unusual or strange, often seeming unreasonable
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("outlandish"): extremely unusual or strange, often seeming unreasonable

ex.en: He arrived wearing an outlandish hat shaped like a pineapple.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "outlandish" (Từ vựng IELTS ("outlandish"): extremely unusual or strange, often seeming unreasonable) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Although some environmental proposals initially seem outlandish, they may eventually inspire practical solutions to urban pollution.

en: Giving information that makes something easier to understand.
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("explanatory"): Giving information that makes something easier to understand.

ex.en: The recipe includes explanatory pictures for each tricky step.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "explanatory" (Từ vựng IELTS ("explanatory"): Giving information that makes something easier to understand.) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Public health campaigns should provide explanatory materials that help people understand both the benefits and limitations of medical screening.

en: to begin something or start happening
vi: Hành động / quá trình (commence): to begin something or start happening

ex.en: The evening concert will commence after a short welcome.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "commence" (Hành động / quá trình (commence): to begin something or start happening) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Construction of the new railway will commence once the environmental assessment has been completed.

en: Impressive language that may lack sincerity or practical substance.
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("rhetoric"): Impressive language that may lack sincerity or practical substance.

ex.en: We need real help, not more rhetoric about teamwork.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "rhetoric" (Từ vựng IELTS ("rhetoric"): Impressive language that may lack sincerity or practical substance.) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Governments must move beyond environmental rhetoric and introduce measurable policies to reduce industrial pollution.

en: A stated reason that hides someone's real purpose.
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("pretext"): A stated reason that hides someone's real purpose.

ex.en: He used a headache as a pretext to leave.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "pretext" (Từ vựng IELTS ("pretext"): A stated reason that hides someone's real purpose.) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Companies should not use economic uncertainty as a pretext for abandoning their environmental commitments.

en: To jump suddenly towards something to catch or attack it.
vi: Hành động / quá trình (pounce): To jump suddenly towards something to catch or attack it.

ex.en: Our kitten pounced on a leaf blowing across the garden.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "pounce" (Hành động / quá trình (pounce): To jump suddenly towards something to catch or attack it.) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: News outlets often pounce on minor errors, distracting audiences from more important policy debates.

en: Introducing important new ideas or methods before others.
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("pioneering"): Introducing important new ideas or methods before others.

ex.en: Her pioneering design lets wheelchair users reach every shelf.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "pioneering" (Từ vựng IELTS ("pioneering"): Introducing important new ideas or methods before others.) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Pioneering research into energy storage could make renewable electricity more reliable and reduce dependence on fossil fuels.

en: A task or project, especially one requiring considerable effort.
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("undertaking"): A task or project, especially one requiring considerable effort.

ex.en: Renovating this old house is a much bigger undertaking.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "undertaking" (Từ vựng IELTS ("undertaking"): A task or project, especially one requiring considerable effort.) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Building a nationwide railway network is a major undertaking that requires sustained investment and careful planning.

en: to stop something from having an effect
vi: Hành động / quá trình (neutralize): to stop something from having an effect

ex.en: This spray helps neutralize unpleasant smells in the kitchen.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "neutralize" (Hành động / quá trình (neutralize): to stop something from having an effect) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Farmers sometimes add lime to acidic soil to neutralize excess acidity and improve conditions for crop growth.

en: A strong hope or ambition to achieve something.
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("aspiration"): A strong hope or ambition to achieve something.

ex.en: Her greatest aspiration is to open a small bakery.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "aspiration" (Từ vựng IELTS ("aspiration"): A strong hope or ambition to achieve something.) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Access to affordable higher education can help young people fulfil their aspirations, regardless of their family income.

en: an idea or understanding of what something is like
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("conception"): an idea or understanding of what something is like

ex.en: His conception of a perfect holiday involves no phones.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "conception" (Từ vựng IELTS ("conception"): an idea or understanding of what something is like) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Access to green spaces can broaden children's conception of nature beyond what they learn in classrooms.

en: With care and a strong sense of responsibility.
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("conscientiously"): With care and a strong sense of responsibility.

ex.en: The nurse conscientiously checked every item in the kit.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "conscientiously" (Từ vựng IELTS ("conscientiously"): With care and a strong sense of responsibility.) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Teachers who conscientiously review individual progress can identify learning difficulties before students fall significantly behind.

en: A subgroup whose views conflict with others in a larger group.
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("faction"): A subgroup whose views conflict with others in a larger group.

ex.en: One faction of our club wants a new leader.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "faction" (Từ vựng IELTS ("faction"): A subgroup whose views conflict with others in a larger group.) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: A powerful faction within the ruling party opposed the proposed reforms to the national education system.

en: Relating to the earliest known inhabitants of a region
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("aboriginal"): Relating to the earliest known inhabitants of a region

ex.en: The exhibition celebrates aboriginal cultures from several different regions.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "aboriginal" (Từ vựng IELTS ("aboriginal"): Relating to the earliest known inhabitants of a region) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Protecting aboriginal languages requires sustained funding and close cooperation with the communities that speak them.

en: to balance or reduce the effect of something
vi: Hành động / quá trình (offset): to balance or reduce the effect of something

ex.en: My shorter commute offsets the higher rent here.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "offset" (Hành động / quá trình (offset): to balance or reduce the effect of something) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Planting trees can offset some carbon emissions, but reducing fossil fuel consumption remains essential.

en: Suitable for or used for growing crops.
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("arable"): Suitable for or used for growing crops.

ex.en: The family grows potatoes on a small arable field.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "arable" (Từ vựng IELTS ("arable"): Suitable for or used for growing crops.) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Rapid urban expansion is reducing the amount of arable land available for food production in many regions.

en: An agreement to stop fighting or arguing for a time
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("truce"): An agreement to stop fighting or arguing for a time

ex.en: After arguing all morning, the neighbours called a truce.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "truce" (Từ vựng IELTS ("truce"): An agreement to stop fighting or arguing for a time) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: A temporary truce can allow aid workers to deliver essential supplies to communities affected by conflict.

en: full of energy, excitement, and happiness
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("exuberant"): full of energy, excitement, and happiness

ex.en: The exuberant puppy bounced around the garden all morning.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "exuberant" (Từ vựng IELTS ("exuberant"): full of energy, excitement, and happiness) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Exuberant celebrations at international sporting events can create a powerful sense of shared identity among spectators.

en: A compound consisting of oxygen and another chemical element.
vi: Hợp chất ô-xít hóa học

ex.en: This sunscreen contains zinc oxide to protect your skin.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "oxide" (Hợp chất ô-xít hóa học) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Nitrogen oxides released by vehicle engines contribute to air pollution and can damage human health.

en: write or carve words on an object, often permanently
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("inscribe"): write or carve words on an object, often permanently

ex.en: The jeweller inscribed our initials inside the silver ring.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "inscribe" (Từ vựng IELTS ("inscribe"): write or carve words on an object, often permanently) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Communities often inscribe memorial stones with personal stories to preserve local history for future generations.

en: A disadvantage that makes success or progress more difficult.
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("handicap"): A disadvantage that makes success or progress more difficult.

ex.en: Without a car, the distance became a real handicap.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "handicap" (Từ vựng IELTS ("handicap"): A disadvantage that makes success or progress more difficult.) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Limited access to reliable internet can be a serious handicap for students in remote communities.

en: A broad statement based on particular cases, sometimes without enough evidence.
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("generalization"): A broad statement based on particular cases, sometimes without enough evidence.

ex.en: Calling all teenagers lazy is an unfair generalization.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "generalization" (Từ vựng IELTS ("generalization"): A broad statement based on particular cases, sometimes without enough evidence.) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Researchers should avoid making a generalization about an entire population from a small, unrepresentative sample.

en: To move an organ or plant into a new location.
vi: Hành động / quá trình (transplant): To move an organ or plant into a new location.

ex.en: We transplant the seedlings once their roots are strong.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "transplant" (Hành động / quá trình (transplant): To move an organ or plant into a new location.) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Advances in medicine have made it possible to transplant organs successfully and improve patients' quality of life.

en: To support and maintain a principle, right, or standard
vi: Hành động / quá trình (uphold): To support and maintain a principle, right, or standard

ex.en: Our coach always tries to uphold fair play.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "uphold" (Hành động / quá trình (uphold): To support and maintain a principle, right, or standard) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Independent courts help uphold citizens' rights by ensuring that public authorities act within the law.

en: the end of the period when something remains valid
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("expiration"): the end of the period when something remains valid

ex.en: Check the expiration date before you buy the yoghurt.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "expiration" (Từ vựng IELTS ("expiration"): the end of the period when something remains valid) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: The expiration of temporary work permits can create uncertainty for both employees and local businesses.

en: Behaviour that follows accepted rules, standards, or group expectations.
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("conformity"): Behaviour that follows accepted rules, standards, or group expectations.

ex.en: Our art teacher encourages creativity rather than strict conformity.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "conformity" (Từ vựng IELTS ("conformity"): Behaviour that follows accepted rules, standards, or group expectations.) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Strong pressure for conformity in schools may discourage students from questioning established ideas and developing independent judgement.

en: A required procedure, often unlikely to change the outcome.
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("formality"): A required procedure, often unlikely to change the outcome.

ex.en: Signing this final document is just a formality.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "formality" (Từ vựng IELTS ("formality"): A required procedure, often unlikely to change the outcome.) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Excessive formality in classroom discussions may discourage students from expressing their opinions openly and confidently.

en: boring because it continues too long or involves repeated actions
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("tedious"): boring because it continues too long or involves repeated actions

ex.en: Sorting all these old receipts is a tedious job.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "tedious" (Từ vựng IELTS ("tedious"): boring because it continues too long or involves repeated actions) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Automation can free employees from tedious tasks, allowing them to focus on more creative and rewarding work.

en: Money spent on a particular purpose, especially when starting something.
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("outlay"): Money spent on a particular purpose, especially when starting something.

ex.en: Our initial outlay included tools and a sturdy workbench.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "outlay" (Từ vựng IELTS ("outlay"): Money spent on a particular purpose, especially when starting something.) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Although solar panels require a substantial initial outlay, they can reduce household energy costs over time.

en: Having sharp corners or clearly defined angles.
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("angular"): Having sharp corners or clearly defined angles.

ex.en: The angular table looked striking beside our curved sofa.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "angular" (Từ vựng IELTS ("angular"): Having sharp corners or clearly defined angles.) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: The museum's angular design contrasts sharply with the rounded forms commonly found in the surrounding landscape.

en: To replace goods that have been sold or used.
vi: Hành động / quá trình (restock): To replace goods that have been sold or used.

ex.en: We need to restock the fridge before our guests arrive.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "restock" (Hành động / quá trình (restock): To replace goods that have been sold or used.) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Retailers increasingly use digital systems to predict demand and restock shelves before products sell out.

en: A bitter disagreement continuing for a long time.
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("feud"): A bitter disagreement continuing for a long time.

ex.en: The neighbours ended their feud over the garden fence.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "feud" (Từ vựng IELTS ("feud"): A bitter disagreement continuing for a long time.) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: A long-running feud between community leaders can prevent cooperation on projects that would benefit local residents.

en: A drink believed to have magical or medicinal effects.
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("potion"): A drink believed to have magical or medicinal effects.

ex.en: In the story, a potion turns the prince invisible.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "potion" (Từ vựng IELTS ("potion"): A drink believed to have magical or medicinal effects.) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: The magical potion remains a familiar device in children's literature, allowing authors to explore transformation and identity.

en: to judge the quality, condition, or performance of something
vi: Hành động / quá trình (appraise): to judge the quality, condition, or performance of something

ex.en: The coach appraised my technique and suggested some changes.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "appraise" (Hành động / quá trình (appraise): to judge the quality, condition, or performance of something) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Local authorities must appraise the environmental impact of major construction projects before granting planning permission.

en: a tax charged on goods entering or leaving a country
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("tariff"): a tax charged on goods entering or leaving a country

ex.en: The new tariff made imported cheese much more expensive.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "tariff" (Từ vựng IELTS ("tariff"): a tax charged on goods entering or leaving a country) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Although tariffs may protect domestic manufacturers, they can also raise consumer prices and provoke trade disputes.

en: using mocking words, often meaning the opposite, to criticize
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("sarcastic"): using mocking words, often meaning the opposite, to criticize

ex.en: His sarcastic comment about my cooking hurt my feelings.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "sarcastic" (Từ vựng IELTS ("sarcastic"): using mocking words, often meaning the opposite, to criticize) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Sarcastic remarks in online discussions can discourage participation and make constructive debate more difficult.

en: Causing extremely serious damage or destruction.
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("devastating"): Causing extremely serious damage or destruction.

ex.en: A devastating storm tore the roof off our garage.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "devastating" (Từ vựng IELTS ("devastating"): Causing extremely serious damage or destruction.) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Prolonged drought can have devastating effects on agriculture, threatening food supplies and the livelihoods of rural communities.

en: happening or existing at exactly the same time
vi: Đồng thời, cùng một lúc

ex.en: Simultaneous cheers erupted from both sides of the street.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "simultaneous" (Đồng thời, cùng một lúc) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Simultaneous investment in public transport and cycling infrastructure can reduce congestion more effectively than isolated measures.

en: Empty of people and lacking signs of life
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("desolate"): Empty of people and lacking signs of life

ex.en: We crossed a desolate valley before reaching the village.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "desolate" (Từ vựng IELTS ("desolate"): Empty of people and lacking signs of life) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Former industrial sites often remain desolate until public investment brings new housing and green spaces.

en: a mammal with strong front teeth that grow continuously
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("rodent"): a mammal with strong front teeth that grow continuously

ex.en: A small rodent was nibbling seeds beside the shed.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "rodent" (Từ vựng IELTS ("rodent"): a mammal with strong front teeth that grow continuously) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Improved food storage can reduce rodent populations without introducing harmful chemicals into the local environment.

en: The process of making conditions normal or usual.
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("normalization"): The process of making conditions normal or usual.

ex.en: The normalization of bus services made commuting easier again.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "normalization" (Từ vựng IELTS ("normalization"): The process of making conditions normal or usual.) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: The normalization of diplomatic relations can encourage trade and strengthen cooperation on shared environmental challenges.

en: an office representing a country and helping its citizens abroad
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("consulate"): an office representing a country and helping its citizens abroad

ex.en: She contacted the consulate after losing her passport abroad.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "consulate" (Từ vựng IELTS ("consulate"): an office representing a country and helping its citizens abroad) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: A consulate can provide essential assistance to citizens who encounter legal or administrative difficulties while travelling abroad.

en: Without achieving the desired result despite effort
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("vainly"): Without achieving the desired result despite effort

ex.en: I searched vainly for my keys under the sofa.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "vainly" (Từ vựng IELTS ("vainly"): Without achieving the desired result despite effort) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Residents have vainly requested better bus services for years, leaving many dependent on private cars.

en: To surgically remove all or part of a limb.
vi: Hành động / quá trình (amputate): To surgically remove all or part of a limb.

ex.en: The vet had to amputate the cat's badly injured leg.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "amputate" (Hành động / quá trình (amputate): To surgically remove all or part of a limb.) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Early treatment of severe infections can reduce the need to amputate limbs and improve patients' quality of life.

en: possible and practical to achieve with available resources
vi: Khả thi, có thể thực hiện được

ex.en: Cycling to work is feasible now that I live nearby.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "feasible" (Khả thi, có thể thực hiện được) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Solar power becomes more economically feasible when installation costs fall and reliable energy storage is available.

en: a large structure or machine used for drilling
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("rig"): a large structure or machine used for drilling

ex.en: We could see an oil rig from the beach.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "rig" (Từ vựng IELTS ("rig"): a large structure or machine used for drilling) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Independent observers can help prevent powerful groups from attempting to rig elections in their favour.

en: The gradual removal of soil or rock by natural forces.
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("erosion"): The gradual removal of soil or rock by natural forces.

ex.en: Heavy rain caused erosion along the muddy river bank.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "erosion" (Từ vựng IELTS ("erosion"): The gradual removal of soil or rock by natural forces.) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Planting trees can reduce soil erosion because their roots help hold the ground together during heavy rainfall.

en: showing that you think someone or something deserves no respect
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("scornful"): showing that you think someone or something deserves no respect

ex.en: He gave my handmade kite a scornful look.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "scornful" (Từ vựng IELTS ("scornful"): showing that you think someone or something deserves no respect) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Scornful responses from teachers can discourage students from asking questions and reduce their confidence in class.

en: Making success harder or putting someone in a worse position.
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("disadvantageous"): Making success harder or putting someone in a worse position.

ex.en: The early start time is disadvantageous for commuters.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "disadvantageous" (Từ vựng IELTS ("disadvantageous"): Making success harder or putting someone in a worse position.) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Limited access to affordable childcare can be particularly disadvantageous to parents seeking full-time employment.

en: To show something proudly to attract attention or admiration.
vi: Hành động / quá trình (flaunt): To show something proudly to attract attention or admiration.

ex.en: He flaunted his new watch at dinner last night.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "flaunt" (Hành động / quá trình (flaunt): To show something proudly to attract attention or admiration.) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Social media encourages some users to flaunt their wealth, potentially increasing feelings of inadequacy among viewers.

en: strong, healthy, and unlikely to break or become weak
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("robust"): strong, healthy, and unlikely to break or become weak

ex.en: These robust boots survived years of muddy country walks.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "robust" (Từ vựng IELTS ("robust"): strong, healthy, and unlikely to break or become weak) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Governments need robust evidence before introducing policies that could significantly affect public health and household spending.

en: Understood or accepted without being directly stated.
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("tacit"): Understood or accepted without being directly stated.

ex.en: Her smile gave me tacit permission to continue.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "tacit" (Từ vựng IELTS ("tacit"): Understood or accepted without being directly stated.) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Public silence should not be interpreted as tacit approval of policies that restrict access to essential services.

en: To become solid, or make something become solid.
vi: Hành động / quá trình (solidify): To become solid, or make something become solid.

ex.en: Leave the melted chocolate to solidify before adding decorations.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "solidify" (Hành động / quá trình (solidify): To become solid, or make something become solid.) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Joint research projects can solidify partnerships between universities and encourage the exchange of specialist knowledge.

en: To want something very strongly.
vi: Hành động / quá trình (crave): To want something very strongly.

ex.en: After the long walk, I craved a warm meal.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "crave" (Hành động / quá trình (crave): To want something very strongly.) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Many urban residents crave contact with nature, highlighting the importance of accessible parks and green spaces.

en: To make a sudden, loud, high sound with your voice.
vi: Hành động / quá trình (shriek): To make a sudden, loud, high sound with your voice.

ex.en: The children shrieked with delight as the sprinkler started.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "shriek" (Hành động / quá trình (shriek): To make a sudden, loud, high sound with your voice.) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Visitors' sudden shrieks can disturb sensitive wildlife, so guides should encourage quiet behaviour in protected natural areas.

en: To severely damage something's ability to function
vi: Hành động / quá trình (cripple): To severely damage something's ability to function

ex.en: The power cut crippled our heating system all evening.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "cripple" (Hành động / quá trình (cripple): To severely damage something's ability to function) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: A prolonged drought can cripple agricultural production, reducing rural incomes and increasing food prices across the country.

en: Describing invisible radiation with wavelengths shorter than visible violet light.
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("ultraviolet"): Describing invisible radiation with wavelengths shorter than visible violet light.

ex.en: These sunglasses protect your eyes from harmful ultraviolet rays.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "ultraviolet" (Từ vựng IELTS ("ultraviolet"): Describing invisible radiation with wavelengths shorter than visible violet light.) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Excessive exposure to ultraviolet radiation increases the risk of skin damage, making sun protection essential.

en: Lasting forever or seeming never to end.
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("everlasting"): Lasting forever or seeming never to end.

ex.en: They promised each other everlasting friendship beneath the old tree.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "everlasting" (Từ vựng IELTS ("everlasting"): Lasting forever or seeming never to end.) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Although digital storage appears to offer everlasting access, files can become unreadable as technology changes.

en: Protection a country gives people escaping danger in another country.
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("asylum"): Protection a country gives people escaping danger in another country.

ex.en: Her family sought asylum after fleeing their home country.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "asylum" (Từ vựng IELTS ("asylum"): Protection a country gives people escaping danger in another country.) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Governments should assess asylum applications fairly while ensuring that vulnerable applicants have access to legal advice.

en: an organism living on or inside another and taking nutrients
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("parasite"): an organism living on or inside another and taking nutrients

ex.en: The vet found a parasite in our dog's fur.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "parasite" (Từ vựng IELTS ("parasite"): an organism living on or inside another and taking nutrients) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Warmer temperatures may allow certain parasites to spread into regions where they previously could not survive.

en: to decay naturally into simpler substances
vi: Hành động / quá trình (decompose): to decay naturally into simpler substances

ex.en: Fallen leaves decompose slowly in the damp garden soil.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "decompose" (Hành động / quá trình (decompose): to decay naturally into simpler substances) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Organic waste can decompose into valuable nutrients, reducing the need for artificial fertilisers in agriculture.

en: Control of another territory and its people by a country
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("colonialism"): Control of another territory and its people by a country

ex.en: The museum explores how colonialism changed life on the island.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "colonialism" (Từ vựng IELTS ("colonialism"): Control of another territory and its people by a country) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: The legacy of colonialism continues to influence language, economic structures, and political institutions in many countries.

en: A scientist who studies weather and atmospheric conditions.
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("meteorologist"): A scientist who studies weather and atmospheric conditions.

ex.en: The meteorologist warned us that heavy snow was approaching.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "meteorologist" (Từ vựng IELTS ("meteorologist"): A scientist who studies weather and atmospheric conditions.) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Meteorologists analyse atmospheric data to forecast extreme weather and help communities prepare for potentially dangerous conditions.

en: relating to theatre or the performance of plays
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("theatrical"): relating to theatre or the performance of plays

ex.en: We watched a theatrical performance in the park yesterday.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "theatrical" (Từ vựng IELTS ("theatrical"): relating to theatre or the performance of plays) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Public funding for theatrical productions can make live performances accessible to communities with limited cultural resources.

en: A state of worry or excitement that prevents calm behaviour.
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("agitation"): A state of worry or excitement that prevents calm behaviour.

ex.en: Her agitation grew as she searched for her missing keys.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "agitation" (Từ vựng IELTS ("agitation"): A state of worry or excitement that prevents calm behaviour.) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Prolonged exposure to traffic noise may increase agitation and reduce residents' ability to concentrate at home.

en: built up over time, especially financially, but not necessarily paid
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("accrued"): built up over time, especially financially, but not necessarily paid

ex.en: My bank statement shows the accrued interest on my savings.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "accrued" (Từ vựng IELTS ("accrued"): built up over time, especially financially, but not necessarily paid) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Companies must account for accrued expenses to provide an accurate picture of their financial position at year end.

en: Expressing opinions or complaints openly and strongly.
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("vocal"): Expressing opinions or complaints openly and strongly.

ex.en: Our neighbours were vocal about plans to close the pool.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "vocal" (Từ vựng IELTS ("vocal"): Expressing opinions or complaints openly and strongly.) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Residents have become increasingly vocal in their opposition to developments that threaten local green spaces.

en: for a period of time to pass
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("elapse"): for a period of time to pass

ex.en: Several minutes elapsed before the bus finally arrived.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "elapse" (Từ vựng IELTS ("elapse"): for a period of time to pass) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Several years may elapse before environmental policies produce measurable improvements in urban air quality.

en: Loss of respect caused by shameful or dishonest behaviour.
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("dishonour"): Loss of respect caused by shameful or dishonest behaviour.

ex.en: His cheating brought dishonour on the whole team.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "dishonour" (Từ vựng IELTS ("dishonour"): Loss of respect caused by shameful or dishonest behaviour.) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Companies that dishonour their commitments to workers risk losing public trust and damaging their long-term commercial prospects.

en: suggesting that something bad or unpleasant may happen
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("ominous"): suggesting that something bad or unpleasant may happen

ex.en: Ominous clouds gathered as we hurried back home.

en: to partly cover something or share features with it

ex.en: The curtains overlap slightly in the middle of the window.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "overlap" (Hành động / quá trình (overlap): to partly cover something or share features with it) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: University courses often overlap in content, allowing students to explore connections between different academic disciplines.

vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("volatile"): Likely to change suddenly and unpredictably.

ex.en: Volatile food prices make it difficult for low-income households to plan their spending and maintain a balanced diet.

en: To relate to or apply to a particular subject.

ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "pertain" (Hành động / quá trình (pertain): To relate to or apply to a particular subject.) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: The committee reviewed documents pertaining to water quality before recommending stricter controls on industrial waste.

en: A very thin thread or thread-like structure.
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("filament"): A very thin thread or thread-like structure.

ex.en: A delicate filament stretched between the spider and the branch.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "filament" (Từ vựng IELTS ("filament"): A very thin thread or thread-like structure.) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Researchers are developing stronger filaments for use in lightweight materials that could reduce fuel consumption in transport.

en: To communicate knowledge, information, or skills to someone
vi: Hành động / quá trình (impart): To communicate knowledge, information, or skills to someone

ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "impart" (Hành động / quá trình (impart): To communicate knowledge, information, or skills to someone) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Schools should impart practical skills that enable young people to manage their finances independently.

en: To lose value, or reduce an asset's recorded value.
vi: Hành động / quá trình (depreciate): To lose value, or reduce an asset's recorded value.

ex.en: New cars often depreciate quickly during their first year.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "depreciate" (Hành động / quá trình (depreciate): To lose value, or reduce an asset's recorded value.) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

en: By means of this statement or official action.
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("hereby"): By means of this statement or official action.

ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "hereby" (Từ vựng IELTS ("hereby"): By means of this statement or official action.) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: The council hereby authorises the conversion of unused public buildings into affordable housing for local residents.

en: To shine with small, quick changes in brightness.

ex.en: Tiny lights twinkled around the window as we ate.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "twinkle" (Hành động / quá trình (twinkle): To shine with small, quick changes in brightness.) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Although stars twinkle beautifully, atmospheric disturbances that cause this effect can limit the accuracy of astronomical observations.

en: Having a bright red colour
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("scarlet"): Having a bright red colour

ex.en: She wore a scarlet scarf against her grey coat.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "scarlet" (Từ vựng IELTS ("scarlet"): Having a bright red colour) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: In visual advertising, scarlet backgrounds can attract attention, although colour associations vary across cultures.

en: An area of knowledge, activity, or experience.
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("realm"): An area of knowledge, activity, or experience.

ex.en: Robots have moved beyond the realm of science fiction.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "realm" (Từ vựng IELTS ("realm"): An area of knowledge, activity, or experience.) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Advances in artificial intelligence are transforming the realm of education by enabling more personalised learning experiences.

en: an old machine that plays sound from flat records
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("gramophone"): an old machine that plays sound from flat records

ex.en: My grandfather played an old record on his gramophone.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "gramophone" (Từ vựng IELTS ("gramophone"): an old machine that plays sound from flat records) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: The gramophone transformed home entertainment by allowing families to enjoy recorded music without attending live performances.

en: A large group of insects moving or gathering together.
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("swarm"): A large group of insects moving or gathering together.

ex.en: A swarm of bees gathered on the apple tree.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "swarm" (Từ vựng IELTS ("swarm"): A large group of insects moving or gathering together.) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Visitors swarm into coastal towns during summer, increasing demand for public transport and waste collection services.

en: To try very hard to achieve something.

ex.en: Governments should strive to provide affordable housing without reducing the quality of public services.

en: To want something deeply, especially something difficult to obtain
vi: Hành động / quá trình (yearn): To want something deeply, especially something difficult to obtain

ex.en: After months abroad, she yearned for her mother's cooking.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "yearn" (Hành động / quá trình (yearn): To want something deeply, especially something difficult to obtain) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

en: To admit something is true, often unwillingly

ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "concede" (Hành động / quá trình (concede): To admit something is true, often unwillingly) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("conversely"): used to introduce an opposite situation or relationship

ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "conversely" (Từ vựng IELTS ("conversely"): used to introduce an opposite situation or relationship) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Reliable public transport can reduce car use; conversely, poor services may encourage greater dependence on private vehicles.

en: The quality of ideas fitting together clearly and logically.
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("coherence"): The quality of ideas fitting together clearly and logically.

ex.en: Your story needs more coherence between its different parts.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "coherence" (Từ vựng IELTS ("coherence"): The quality of ideas fitting together clearly and logically.) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Clear paragraph structure improves the coherence of an essay and helps readers follow complex arguments.

en: A king or queen who serves as head of state

ex.en: The monarch waved to the crowd from the palace balcony.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "monarch" (Từ vựng IELTS ("monarch"): A king or queen who serves as head of state) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: In a constitutional monarchy, the monarch usually performs ceremonial duties while elected representatives exercise political power.

en: To go around something or avoid a usual step

ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "bypass" (Hành động / quá trình (bypass): To go around something or avoid a usual step) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

en: A very large number of people or things
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("multitude"): A very large number of people or things

ex.en: A multitude of colourful birds gathered around the pond.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "multitude" (Từ vựng IELTS ("multitude"): A very large number of people or things) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Urban planners must consider a multitude of factors when designing affordable housing for growing populations.

en: No longer alive, especially in formal or legal contexts.
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("deceased"): No longer alive, especially in formal or legal contexts.

ex.en: She keeps a photograph of her deceased grandfather nearby.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "deceased" (Từ vựng IELTS ("deceased"): No longer alive, especially in formal or legal contexts.) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Museums sometimes display personal belongings of deceased artists to help visitors understand their lives and creative influences.

en: angry because you believe you have been treated unfairly
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("resentful"): angry because you believe you have been treated unfairly

ex.en: He felt resentful when his brother took all the credit.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "resentful" (Từ vựng IELTS ("resentful"): angry because you believe you have been treated unfairly) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Employees may become resentful if promotion decisions appear to favour personal connections rather than professional ability.

en: Involving major changes to the basic nature of something.

ex.en: Reducing dependence on private cars requires radical changes to urban planning and public transport investment.

en: A change in the route or use of something.
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("diversion"): A change in the route or use of something.

ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "diversion" (Từ vựng IELTS ("diversion"): A change in the route or use of something.) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: The diversion of public funds away from education could limit opportunities for children in disadvantaged communities.

en: A short nail with a broad, flat head.
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("tack"): A short nail with a broad, flat head.

ex.en: I used a tack to secure the loose fabric.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "tack" (Từ vựng IELTS ("tack"): A short nail with a broad, flat head.) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: When public campaigns fail to change behaviour, policymakers may need to take a different tack.

en: A fresh assessment of something, often leading to changed views.
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("reappraisal"): A fresh assessment of something, often leading to changed views.

ex.en: The unexpected repair bill prompted a reappraisal of our budget.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "reappraisal" (Từ vựng IELTS ("reappraisal"): A fresh assessment of something, often leading to changed views.) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: New evidence has led to a reappraisal of the environmental benefits associated with this farming method.

en: A frog-like animal with rough skin that usually lives on land.
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("toad"): A frog-like animal with rough skin that usually lives on land.

ex.en: A small toad was hiding beneath the garden pot.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "toad" (Từ vựng IELTS ("toad"): A frog-like animal with rough skin that usually lives on land.) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Protecting ponds and nearby woodland helps toads survive as urban development reduces their natural habitats.

en: to cause someone or something to suffer harm
vi: Hành động / quá trình (inflict): to cause someone or something to suffer harm

en: An exact copy of something
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("duplicate"): An exact copy of something

ex.en: Research teams should share their findings to avoid duplicating work and wasting limited public funding.

en: a system of methods and principles used in research
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("methodology"): a system of methods and principles used in research

ex.en: Our tutor explained the methodology before we began our project.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "methodology" (Từ vựng IELTS ("methodology"): a system of methods and principles used in research) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Researchers must describe their methodology clearly so that others can evaluate the reliability of their findings.

en: A person employed to do practical work on a farm
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("farmhand"): A person employed to do practical work on a farm

ex.en: A farmhand carried fresh hay into the barn this morning.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "farmhand" (Từ vựng IELTS ("farmhand"): A person employed to do practical work on a farm) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

en: a collection of work showing someone's skills and experience
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("portfolio"): a collection of work showing someone's skills and experience

ex.en: She brought her photography portfolio to the interview.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "portfolio" (Từ vựng IELTS ("portfolio"): a collection of work showing someone's skills and experience) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: A diversified investment portfolio can reduce financial risk, although it cannot guarantee steady returns.

en: to give someone information that helps them understand something

ex.en: Public health campaigns should enlighten citizens about the benefits of vaccination while addressing common concerns respectfully.

en: a tiny opening in skin or another surface
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("pore"): a tiny opening in skin or another surface

ex.en: Tiny drops of sweat appeared around his skin pores.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "pore" (Từ vựng IELTS ("pore"): a tiny opening in skin or another surface) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Researchers pore over historical records to understand how earlier societies responded to periods of severe drought.

en: The size, extent, or importance of something.
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("magnitude"): The size, extent, or importance of something.

ex.en: We only realised the magnitude of the damage at sunrise.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "magnitude" (Từ vựng IELTS ("magnitude"): The size, extent, or importance of something.) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: The magnitude of global food waste highlights the need for better storage systems and more responsible consumption.

en: A situation that is strikingly opposite to what is expected.
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("irony"): A situation that is strikingly opposite to what is expected.

ex.en: There is considerable irony in promoting environmental awareness through disposable products that create additional waste.

en: The arrival of an important new invention, event, or period
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("advent"): The arrival of an important new invention, event, or period

ex.en: The advent of smartphones changed how we take photos.

en: To help opposing sides reach an agreement.
vi: Hành động / quá trình (mediate): To help opposing sides reach an agreement.

ex.en: Our neighbour offered to mediate when we argued about parking.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "mediate" (Hành động / quá trình (mediate): To help opposing sides reach an agreement.) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

en: Distance north or south of the equator, measured in degrees.

ex.en: Regions at higher latitudes generally experience greater seasonal variations in daylight than those near the equator.

vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("relentless"): continuing strongly without stopping or becoming less intense

ex.en: Relentless pressure to achieve high grades can undermine students' confidence and damage their mental health.

en: To tend towards a particular opinion or course of action

ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "incline" (Hành động / quá trình (incline): To tend towards a particular opinion or course of action) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Rising housing costs may incline young adults to remain in their parents' homes longer.

en: Similar in a way that allows a useful comparison.
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("analogous"): Similar in a way that allows a useful comparison.

ex.en: Our shared kitchen is analogous to a busy workshop.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "analogous" (Từ vựng IELTS ("analogous"): Similar in a way that allows a useful comparison.) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: The role of public libraries is analogous to that of schools in supporting lifelong learning within communities.

en: To make something widely known, liked, or used.
vi: Hành động / quá trình (popularize): To make something widely known, liked, or used.

ex.en: Her cooking videos helped popularize this simple bean soup.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "popularize" (Hành động / quá trình (popularize): To make something widely known, liked, or used.) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Public broadcasters can popularize scientific knowledge by explaining complex discoveries through accessible documentaries and practical demonstrations.

en: to show or describe something in art, images, or words
vi: Hành động / quá trình (depict): to show or describe something in art, images, or words

ex.en: This painting depicts children playing beside a quiet lake.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "depict" (Hành động / quá trình (depict): to show or describe something in art, images, or words) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Films often depict urban life as exciting, overlooking the isolation that many residents experience in large cities.

en: Land covered with grass where farm animals feed.
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("pasture"): Land covered with grass where farm animals feed.

ex.en: The cows wandered across the green pasture after sunrise.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "pasture" (Từ vựng IELTS ("pasture"): Land covered with grass where farm animals feed.) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Converting forests into pasture can reduce biodiversity and increase greenhouse gas emissions from land use.

en: Someone who writes an account of another person's life.
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("biographer"): Someone who writes an account of another person's life.

ex.en: The biographer interviewed my grandmother about her childhood friend.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "biographer" (Từ vựng IELTS ("biographer"): Someone who writes an account of another person's life.) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: A responsible biographer compares multiple sources before drawing conclusions about a historical figure's personal motivations.

en: a confident statement that something is true
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("assertion"): a confident statement that something is true

ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "assertion" (Từ vựng IELTS ("assertion"): a confident statement that something is true) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: The assertion that economic growth always improves wellbeing requires careful examination of social and environmental evidence.

en: A state in which all movement or activity has stopped.
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("standstill"): A state in which all movement or activity has stopped.

ex.en: Traffic came to a standstill outside the station.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "standstill" (Từ vựng IELTS ("standstill"): A state in which all movement or activity has stopped.) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Severe flooding brought construction to a standstill, delaying urgently needed housing projects across the region.

en: Food such as hay or straw given to farm animals.
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("fodder"): Food such as hay or straw given to farm animals.

ex.en: We stored extra fodder in the barn before winter.

ex.en: Celebrity lifestyles often provide fodder for media coverage, diverting public attention from more significant social issues.

en: to make something operate or spread across the world
vi: Hành động / quá trình (globalize): to make something operate or spread across the world

ex.en: Online shops help small businesses globalize without opening stores abroad.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "globalize" (Hành động / quá trình (globalize): to make something operate or spread across the world) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: As companies globalize their operations, governments must cooperate to protect workers and maintain fair competition.

en: To move slowly from side to side, or cause this movement.

en: relating to space and the positions of objects within it

en: a dark underground prison, especially beneath a castle
