ex.en: We explored the castle's cold dungeon with a guide.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "dungeon" (Từ vựng IELTS ("dungeon"): a dark underground prison, especially beneath a castle) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Preserving a medieval dungeon can help museums illustrate how imprisonment and justice have changed over time.

en: Shock and disappointment caused by something unexpected and unpleasant.
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("dismay"): Shock and disappointment caused by something unexpected and unpleasant.

ex.en: To my dismay, the cake collapsed in the oven.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "dismay" (Từ vựng IELTS ("dismay"): Shock and disappointment caused by something unexpected and unpleasant.) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Residents expressed dismay at plans to replace their local park with a large commercial development.

en: Press something into a smaller space or reduce its size
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("compress"): Press something into a smaller space or reduce its size

ex.en: She compressed the blankets into a small storage bag.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "compress" (Từ vựng IELTS ("compress"): Press something into a smaller space or reduce its size) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Digital tools can compress large files, allowing students with limited internet access to download educational materials more easily.

en: To consider something to be caused by a particular factor
vi: Hành động / quá trình (ascribe): To consider something to be caused by a particular factor

ex.en: I ascribe my better sleep to regular evening walks.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "ascribe" (Hành động / quá trình (ascribe): To consider something to be caused by a particular factor) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Researchers should not ascribe differences in academic performance solely to individual effort without considering social circumstances.

en: A short period of illness or intense activity
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("bout"): A short period of illness or intense activity

ex.en: A bout of flu kept me home all week.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "bout" (Từ vựng IELTS ("bout"): A short period of illness or intense activity) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Regular exercise may help reduce bouts of anxiety and improve overall mental health among university students.

en: a period of renewed interest, activity, or success
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("renaissance"): a period of renewed interest, activity, or success

ex.en: Our local theatre is enjoying a renaissance this summer.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "renaissance" (Từ vựng IELTS ("renaissance"): a period of renewed interest, activity, or success) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Investment in public galleries could encourage a cultural renaissance in cities affected by industrial decline.

en: Passed from parents to children through genes.
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("hereditary"): Passed from parents to children through genes.

ex.en: The doctor asked whether the condition might be hereditary.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "hereditary" (Từ vựng IELTS ("hereditary"): Passed from parents to children through genes.) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Genetic counselling can help families understand hereditary conditions and make informed decisions about their healthcare.

en: a period of history marked by distinctive events or changes
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("epoch"): a period of history marked by distinctive events or changes

ex.en: These old photographs capture an epoch of rapid change.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "epoch" (Từ vựng IELTS ("epoch"): a period of history marked by distinctive events or changes) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: The development of agriculture marked a new epoch in human history, transforming settlement patterns and social organisation.

en: Someone who supports extending a country's power over other countries.
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("imperialist"): Someone who supports extending a country's power over other countries.

ex.en: The novel portrays the governor as an ambitious imperialist.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "imperialist" (Từ vựng IELTS ("imperialist"): Someone who supports extending a country's power over other countries.) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Historians examine how imperialist policies reshaped local economies and weakened political independence in colonised regions.

en: Secretive and clever, often to gain an unfair advantage.
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("sly"): Secretive and clever, often to gain an unfair advantage.

ex.en: The sly cat stole a biscuit while I turned away.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "sly" (Từ vựng IELTS ("sly"): Secretive and clever, often to gain an unfair advantage.) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Sly attempts to hide additional charges can damage consumer trust and harm a company's reputation.

en: the act of climbing or moving upwards
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("ascent"): the act of climbing or moving upwards

ex.en: We began our ascent just as the sun rose.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "ascent" (Từ vựng IELTS ("ascent"): the act of climbing or moving upwards) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: The rapid ascent of renewable energy reflects both technological progress and stronger public support for environmental protection.

en: Looking young or showing the energy and qualities of youth.
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("youthful"): Looking young or showing the energy and qualities of youth.

ex.en: My grandfather still has a youthful smile and boundless energy.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "youthful" (Từ vựng IELTS ("youthful"): Looking young or showing the energy and qualities of youth.) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: A youthful workforce can bring fresh ideas, while experienced employees contribute valuable practical knowledge.

en: Including people and cultural influences from many different countries.
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("cosmopolitan"): Including people and cultural influences from many different countries.

ex.en: Our cosmopolitan neighbourhood has restaurants serving food from many countries.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "cosmopolitan" (Từ vựng IELTS ("cosmopolitan"): Including people and cultural influences from many different countries.) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Cosmopolitan cities can encourage cultural exchange by creating shared spaces where residents from different backgrounds regularly interact.

en: Become faster, or make something happen faster.
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("quicken"): Become faster, or make something happen faster.

ex.en: I quickened my pace when the rain started.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "quicken" (Từ vựng IELTS ("quicken"): Become faster, or make something happen faster.) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Improved transport links can quicken the pace of economic development by connecting rural producers with urban markets.

en: Supporting government without a monarch, usually through elected representatives
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("republican"): Supporting government without a monarch, usually through elected representatives

ex.en: My uncle often discusses republican ideas over dinner.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "republican" (Từ vựng IELTS ("republican"): Supporting government without a monarch, usually through elected representatives) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: A republican constitution typically establishes a head of state whose position is not inherited through a royal family.

en: to manage to do something difficult or unexpected
vi: Hành động / quá trình (contrive): to manage to do something difficult or unexpected

ex.en: We contrived to fit every suitcase into the tiny car.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "contrive" (Hành động / quá trình (contrive): to manage to do something difficult or unexpected) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Despite limited funding, the research team contrived to develop an affordable device for monitoring water quality.

en: An enclosed structure producing intense heat for industrial processes.
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("furnace"): An enclosed structure producing intense heat for industrial processes.

ex.en: We watched molten metal pour from the glowing furnace.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "furnace" (Từ vựng IELTS ("furnace"): An enclosed structure producing intense heat for industrial processes.) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Replacing an inefficient furnace can reduce household energy consumption and lower heating costs during winter.

en: An estimate that is close to the exact value.
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("approximation"): An estimate that is close to the exact value.

ex.en: My budget is only a rough approximation of the cost.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "approximation" (Từ vựng IELTS ("approximation"): An estimate that is close to the exact value.) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Computer models provide an approximation of future climate conditions rather than a precise prediction of every change.

en: After the time or event just mentioned
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("thereafter"): After the time or event just mentioned

ex.en: The shop opened in spring and closed shortly thereafter.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "thereafter" (Từ vựng IELTS ("thereafter"): After the time or event just mentioned) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: The city introduced stricter vehicle standards, and air quality improved steadily in the years thereafter.

en: A metal made by combining metals or adding other elements.
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("alloy"): A metal made by combining metals or adding other elements.

ex.en: This bicycle frame is made from a lightweight alloy.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "alloy" (Từ vựng IELTS ("alloy"): A metal made by combining metals or adding other elements.) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Engineers are developing stronger alloys to reduce vehicle weight and improve fuel efficiency.

en: The wide tidal mouth of a river meeting the sea.
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("estuary"): The wide tidal mouth of a river meeting the sea.

ex.en: We watched birds feeding beside the estuary at sunset.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "estuary" (Từ vựng IELTS ("estuary"): The wide tidal mouth of a river meeting the sea.) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Protecting an estuary preserves important feeding grounds for migratory birds and supports the livelihoods of local fishing communities.

en: An introductory section explaining a book's purpose or background.
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("preface"): An introductory section explaining a book's purpose or background.

ex.en: The author explains her inspiration in the book's preface.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "preface" (Từ vựng IELTS ("preface"): An introductory section explaining a book's purpose or background.) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: In the preface, the researchers explain how their personal experiences influenced the questions explored throughout the book.

en: Having a fault that prevents something from working properly.
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("defective"): Having a fault that prevents something from working properly.

ex.en: The shop replaced my defective kettle without any fuss.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "defective" (Từ vựng IELTS ("defective"): Having a fault that prevents something from working properly.) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Manufacturers should recall defective products promptly to protect consumers and maintain public confidence in safety standards.

en: work out the meaning of unclear writing or coded information
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("decipher"): work out the meaning of unclear writing or coded information

ex.en: Can you decipher the handwriting on this old postcard?
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "decipher" (Từ vựng IELTS ("decipher"): work out the meaning of unclear writing or coded information) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Researchers used advanced imaging techniques to decipher damaged manuscripts and gain insights into ancient societies.

en: Trusted as accurate because of expert knowledge.
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("authoritative"): Trusted as accurate because of expert knowledge.

ex.en: This gardening guide offers authoritative advice on growing vegetables.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "authoritative" (Từ vựng IELTS ("authoritative"): Trusted as accurate because of expert knowledge.) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Students should consult authoritative sources when evaluating health claims shared widely through social media platforms.

en: by everyone or in every place or situation
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("universally"): by everyone or in every place or situation

ex.en: Her homemade cakes are universally loved by our neighbours.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "universally" (Từ vựng IELTS ("universally"): by everyone or in every place or situation) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Although education is universally recognised as valuable, access to quality schooling remains unequal across regions.

en: unwilling to talk openly about your thoughts or feelings
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("reticent"): unwilling to talk openly about your thoughts or feelings

ex.en: He was reticent about his plans for the weekend.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "reticent" (Từ vựng IELTS ("reticent"): unwilling to talk openly about your thoughts or feelings) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Employees may remain reticent about workplace problems if they fear that speaking openly could damage their careers.

en: The children or young of a person, animal, or plant.
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("offspring"): The children or young of a person, animal, or plant.

ex.en: The mother duck led her offspring safely across the path.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "offspring" (Từ vựng IELTS ("offspring"): The children or young of a person, animal, or plant.) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Many species invest considerable energy in protecting their offspring, which increases the young animals' chances of survival.

en: the quality of resisting pressure rather than being soft
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("firmness"): the quality of resisting pressure rather than being soft

ex.en: Press the mattress gently to check its firmness.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "firmness" (Từ vựng IELTS ("firmness"): the quality of resisting pressure rather than being soft) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Teachers can maintain classroom discipline through calm firmness without discouraging students from expressing their opinions openly.

en: To cause a reaction, feeling, or event.
vi: Hành động / quá trình (provoke): To cause a reaction, feeling, or event.

ex.en: The unexpected ending provoked a lively discussion after dinner.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "provoke" (Hành động / quá trình (provoke): To cause a reaction, feeling, or event.) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Proposals to increase public transport fares often provoke strong criticism from commuters who depend on affordable travel.

en: To make someone extremely annoyed or frustrated.
vi: Hành động / quá trình (exasperate): To make someone extremely annoyed or frustrated.

ex.en: The printer's constant paper jams exasperate everyone in our office.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "exasperate" (Hành động / quá trình (exasperate): To make someone extremely annoyed or frustrated.) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Repeated delays in public transport can exasperate commuters and reduce their willingness to leave cars at home.

en: A different offer made in response to an earlier offer.
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("counter-offer"): A different offer made in response to an earlier offer.

ex.en: The seller rejected our price and made a counter-offer.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "counter-offer" (Từ vựng IELTS ("counter-offer"): A different offer made in response to an earlier offer.) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Employers may make a counter-offer when skilled employees announce plans to accept a position elsewhere.

en: The act of officially choosing someone or something for a purpose.
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("designation"): The act of officially choosing someone or something for a purpose.

ex.en: Her designation as team leader surprised nobody at work.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "designation" (Từ vựng IELTS ("designation"): The act of officially choosing someone or something for a purpose.) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: The designation of coastal wetlands as protected areas can help preserve biodiversity and limit inappropriate development.

en: A ship or large boat.
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("vessel"): A ship or large boat.

ex.en: A large fishing vessel sailed slowly into the harbour.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "vessel" (Từ vựng IELTS ("vessel"): A ship or large boat.) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Commercial vessels can disturb marine ecosystems through underwater noise, fuel leaks, and the introduction of non-native species.

en: subjects studying human culture, such as history, literature, and philosophy
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("humanities"): subjects studying human culture, such as history, literature, and philosophy

ex.en: She chose humanities because she loves history and literature.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "humanities" (Từ vựng IELTS ("humanities"): subjects studying human culture, such as history, literature, and philosophy) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Studying the humanities can develop critical thinking and help students understand perspectives shaped by different cultures.

en: plants growing together in a particular area
vi: Thảm thực vật, cây cối nói chung

ex.en: Thick vegetation hid the narrow path beside the river.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "vegetation" (Thảm thực vật, cây cối nói chung) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Removing natural vegetation increases soil erosion and reduces the capacity of land to absorb heavy rainfall.

en: To dress someone or provide them with clothes
vi: Hành động / quá trình (clothe): To dress someone or provide them with clothes

ex.en: The charity helps feed and clothe families during winter.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "clothe" (Hành động / quá trình (clothe): To dress someone or provide them with clothes) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Low wages can make it difficult for parents to feed and clothe their children adequately.

en: very small in amount, effect, or importance
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("marginal"): very small in amount, effect, or importance

ex.en: The new tyres made only a marginal difference.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "marginal" (Từ vựng IELTS ("marginal"): very small in amount, effect, or importance) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Despite substantial investment, the programme produced only marginal improvements in public transport reliability across the city.

en: The ability to understand ideas, think logically, and solve problems.
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("intellect"): The ability to understand ideas, think logically, and solve problems.

ex.en: Her sharp intellect makes difficult puzzles seem surprisingly easy.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "intellect" (Từ vựng IELTS ("intellect"): The ability to understand ideas, think logically, and solve problems.) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Education should develop students' intellect while also nurturing creativity, emotional awareness, and the ability to collaborate.

en: A difficult or frightening experience that lasts for some time.
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("ordeal"): A difficult or frightening experience that lasts for some time.

ex.en: Getting home through the storm was a real ordeal.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "ordeal" (Từ vựng IELTS ("ordeal"): A difficult or frightening experience that lasts for some time.) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: For displaced families, finding secure housing can become a prolonged ordeal without adequate public support.

en: causing or influencing something without being immediately obvious
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("underlying"): causing or influencing something without being immediately obvious

ex.en: The mechanic found the underlying cause of the noise.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "underlying" (Từ vựng IELTS ("underlying"): causing or influencing something without being immediately obvious) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Addressing the underlying causes of poverty requires sustained investment in education, healthcare, and secure employment.

en: a change in shape caused by pressure or other forces
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("deformation"): a change in shape caused by pressure or other forces

ex.en: The heat caused visible deformation of the plastic lid.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "deformation" (Từ vựng IELTS ("deformation"): a change in shape caused by pressure or other forces) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Engineers test building materials to assess their resistance to deformation under heavy loads and extreme temperatures.

en: a particular area of knowledge, activity, or responsibility
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("domain"): a particular area of knowledge, activity, or responsibility

ex.en: Electrical repairs are my brother's domain, not mine.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "domain" (Từ vựng IELTS ("domain"): a particular area of knowledge, activity, or responsibility) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Environmental protection should not be regarded as the exclusive domain of scientists, since public participation is essential.

en: An infection that inflames the lungs and makes breathing difficult.
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("pneumonia"): An infection that inflames the lungs and makes breathing difficult.

ex.en: My grandfather stayed in hospital while recovering from pneumonia.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "pneumonia" (Từ vựng IELTS ("pneumonia"): An infection that inflames the lungs and makes breathing difficult.) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Improved access to vaccination and timely treatment can reduce deaths from pneumonia, particularly among young children.

en: To move, or make something move, in flowing circles.
vi: Hành động / quá trình (swirl): To move, or make something move, in flowing circles.

ex.en: Dry leaves swirled around my feet in the wind.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "swirl" (Hành động / quá trình (swirl): To move, or make something move, in flowing circles.) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Dust can swirl through urban streets during construction, reducing air quality and causing discomfort for nearby residents.

en: to cause someone to give information or show a reaction
vi: Hành động / quá trình (elicit): to cause someone to give information or show a reaction

ex.en: Her unexpected question elicited a smile from the normally quiet guide.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "elicit" (Hành động / quá trình (elicit): to cause someone to give information or show a reaction) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Teachers can use open questions to elicit detailed responses and encourage independent thinking in the classroom.

en: A tall upright pole supporting sails on a boat
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("mast"): A tall upright pole supporting sails on a boat

ex.en: A white sail fluttered high on the wooden mast.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "mast" (Từ vựng IELTS ("mast"): A tall upright pole supporting sails on a boat) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Installing a new communications mast could improve mobile coverage in remote villages and support local businesses.

en: Having no clear or definite shape
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("shapeless"): Having no clear or definite shape

ex.en: My old sweater became shapeless after too many washes.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "shapeless" (Từ vựng IELTS ("shapeless"): Having no clear or definite shape) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Without careful planning, expanding cities can become shapeless areas lacking distinct neighbourhoods and accessible public spaces.

en: to follow rules or meet required standards
vi: Hành động / quá trình (conform): to follow rules or meet required standards

ex.en: These new helmets conform to the latest safety standards.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "conform" (Hành động / quá trình (conform): to follow rules or meet required standards) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Pressure to conform can discourage young people from expressing original ideas or questioning established traditions.

en: by an amount that is large enough to notice
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("appreciably"): by an amount that is large enough to notice

ex.en: The room felt appreciably warmer after we closed the window.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "appreciably" (Từ vựng IELTS ("appreciably"): by an amount that is large enough to notice) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Expanding reliable public transport could appreciably reduce traffic congestion and improve air quality in urban areas.

en: to hang loosely, or make something hang loosely
vi: Hành động / quá trình (dangle): to hang loosely, or make something hang loosely

ex.en: Her feet dangled above the floor from the high chair.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "dangle" (Hành động / quá trình (dangle): to hang loosely, or make something hang loosely) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Some employers dangle generous bonuses before applicants while offering limited opportunities for long-term career development.

en: Job loss because an employer no longer needs the position.
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("redundancy"): Job loss because an employer no longer needs the position.

ex.en: After the factory closed, Elena faced redundancy and financial uncertainty.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "redundancy" (Từ vựng IELTS ("redundancy"): Job loss because an employer no longer needs the position.) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Automation may increase productivity, but employers should offer retraining to workers at risk of redundancy.

en: To catch again or regain control of something

en: An exciting attractiveness associated with beauty, wealth, or fame.

en: Marx's theories concerning class conflict, capitalism, and a classless society.

en: The process of entering or passing through something.

ex.en: Greater internet penetration in rural areas can improve access to education and support the growth of small businesses.

en: The loss of power, success, or social position.

en: Intense anger caused by something deeply unfair or wrong

en: remember something from the past, sometimes with effort

en: Sympathy expressed to someone whose relative or friend has died.

en: To begin a project, activity, or course of action

en: The strength of connection that keeps a group together

en: the act of taking control of a country by force
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("conquest"): the act of taking control of a country by force

ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "conquest" (Từ vựng IELTS ("conquest"): the act of taking control of a country by force) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

en: Competition between people or groups seeking the same success.
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("rivalry"): Competition between people or groups seeking the same success.

ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "rivalry" (Từ vựng IELTS ("rivalry"): Competition between people or groups seeking the same success.) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

en: To leave someone confused and unable to think clearly.

ex.en: Environmental impact should be a key criterion when governments assess proposals for new transport infrastructure.

en: a ride on someone's back, with legs around their waist

ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "piggyback" (Từ vựng IELTS ("piggyback"): a ride on someone's back, with legs around their waist) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "exceedingly" (Hành động / quá trình (exceedingly): To a very great degree.) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Providing reliable public transport in sparsely populated areas can be exceedingly expensive for local authorities.

en: Concerned with reducing suffering and improving people's lives.
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("humanitarian"): Concerned with reducing suffering and improving people's lives.

ex.en: Volunteers packed blankets and medicine for the humanitarian mission.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "humanitarian" (Từ vựng IELTS ("humanitarian"): Concerned with reducing suffering and improving people's lives.) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: International humanitarian organisations provide essential supplies to communities affected by natural disasters and armed conflict.

en: A serious promise to do or provide something
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("pledge"): A serious promise to do or provide something

ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "pledge" (Từ vựng IELTS ("pledge"): A serious promise to do or provide something) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Local authorities have pledged to improve public transport and reduce traffic congestion over the next decade.

en: easy to notice because of being unusual or different
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("conspicuous"): easy to notice because of being unusual or different

ex.en: Her yellow umbrella was conspicuous among the black ones.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "conspicuous" (Từ vựng IELTS ("conspicuous"): easy to notice because of being unusual or different) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Conspicuous consumption can encourage unnecessary spending as people seek to display their wealth through expensive possessions.

en: An explosive powder historically used in guns and still in fireworks.
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("gunpowder"): An explosive powder historically used in guns and still in fireworks.

ex.en: The museum guide showed us an old gunpowder barrel.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "gunpowder" (Từ vựng IELTS ("gunpowder"): An explosive powder historically used in guns and still in fireworks.) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: The introduction of gunpowder changed military technology and influenced the design of defensive structures in many regions.

en: To save useful things from damage, loss, or destruction.

ex.en: We managed to salvage some books after the flood.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "salvage" (Hành động / quá trình (salvage): To save useful things from damage, loss, or destruction.) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

en: To move around freely without a fixed route or destination.

ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "roam" (Hành động / quá trình (roam): To move around freely without a fixed route or destination.) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

en: to illegally seize control of a vehicle during a journey

ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "hijack" (Hành động / quá trình (hijack): to illegally seize control of a vehicle during a journey) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Powerful interest groups may hijack public debates, preventing communities from discussing their most urgent concerns.

en: A publication released regularly, containing articles on particular subjects.
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("periodical"): A publication released regularly, containing articles on particular subjects.

ex.en: The library keeps that periodical beside the newspapers.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "periodical" (Từ vựng IELTS ("periodical"): A publication released regularly, containing articles on particular subjects.) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

en: a senior army or air force officer
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("colonel"): a senior army or air force officer

ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "colonel" (Từ vựng IELTS ("colonel"): a senior army or air force officer) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: A colonel coordinated the military's emergency response, ensuring that isolated communities received food and medical supplies.

en: fine glass fibres, or plastic strengthened with these fibres
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("fibreglass"): fine glass fibres, or plastic strengthened with these fibres

ex.en: Our small fibreglass boat is easy to carry ashore.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "fibreglass" (Từ vựng IELTS ("fibreglass"): fine glass fibres, or plastic strengthened with these fibres) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Fibreglass is widely used in construction because it combines low weight with considerable strength and durability.

en: A blood vessel carrying blood away from the heart.

ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "artery" (Từ vựng IELTS ("artery"): A blood vessel carrying blood away from the heart.) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: The new railway will become a major transport artery connecting rural communities with regional markets.

en: the hard covering of a horse's or similar animal's foot

en: An older British spelling of jail, a place holding prisoners.

ex.vi: Thế giới đang chứng kiến tốc độ phát triển trí tuệ nhân tạo chưa từng có tiền lệ.

ex.vi: Đại dịch đã gây ra những gián đoạn chưa từng có đối với hệ thống giáo dục toàn cầu.

en: relating to scientific methods used to investigate crime

cognitive skills — kỹ năng tư duy nhận thức
cognitive decline — suy giảm nhận thức

en: Not known by many people

ex.en: Overly technical language can obscure important findings, making scientific research less accessible to the public.

en: Someone within a group who has access to private information.

en: a narrow stretch of sea connecting two larger areas

ex.en: Restrictions on shipping through a major strait can disrupt international trade and increase transport costs.

en: A cloth covering the eyes to prevent someone from seeing.

en: Able to do something well through training and practice.
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("proficient"): Able to do something well through training and practice.

ex.en: After months of practice, she became proficient at sewing.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "proficient" (Từ vựng IELTS ("proficient"): Able to do something well through training and practice.) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Graduates who are proficient in a second language may have better access to international employment opportunities.

en: To give someone special care, comfort, or excessive attention
vi: Hành động / quá trình (pamper): To give someone special care, comfort, or excessive attention

ex.en: I pamper myself with a warm bath on Sundays.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "pamper" (Hành động / quá trình (pamper): To give someone special care, comfort, or excessive attention) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Parents who constantly pamper their children may unintentionally limit opportunities for them to develop independence.

en: a large, strong fire
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("blaze"): a large, strong fire

ex.en: Firefighters rescued the family from the blaze last night.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "blaze" (Từ vựng IELTS ("blaze"): a large, strong fire) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: The forest blaze destroyed valuable habitats, highlighting the need for better fire prevention strategies.

en: To eat something quickly and eagerly.
vi: Hành động / quá trình (devour): To eat something quickly and eagerly.

ex.en: After swimming, we devoured the warm bread within minutes.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "devour" (Hành động / quá trình (devour): To eat something quickly and eagerly.) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Large infrastructure projects can devour public funds unless spending is carefully monitored throughout construction.

en: a safe or peaceful place away from danger or trouble
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("haven"): a safe or peaceful place away from danger or trouble

ex.en: Our little garden is a haven from city noise.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "haven" (Từ vựng IELTS ("haven"): a safe or peaceful place away from danger or trouble) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Protected wetlands provide a safe haven for wildlife threatened by habitat loss and urban expansion.

en: cruel government that uses power without limits
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("tyranny"): cruel government that uses power without limits

ex.en: The film follows a village struggling against a ruler's tyranny.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "tyranny" (Từ vựng IELTS ("tyranny"): cruel government that uses power without limits) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Independent courts and a free press can help prevent tyranny by holding political leaders accountable.

en: To move quickly out of the way of something.
vi: Hành động / quá trình (dodge): To move quickly out of the way of something.

ex.en: I dodged a puddle and nearly dropped my shopping.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "dodge" (Hành động / quá trình (dodge): To move quickly out of the way of something.) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Public officials who dodge difficult questions may weaken citizens' trust in the institutions they represent.

en: To officially order someone to come or request their presence.
vi: Hành động / quá trình (summon): To officially order someone to come or request their presence.

ex.en: The manager summoned everyone to her office after lunch.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "summon" (Hành động / quá trình (summon): To officially order someone to come or request their presence.) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Governments must summon the political will to address environmental problems despite opposition from powerful industries.

en: Anger and resentment caused by unfair treatment or disappointment.
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("bitterness"): Anger and resentment caused by unfair treatment or disappointment.

ex.en: She still feels bitterness about losing her job unfairly.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "bitterness" (Từ vựng IELTS ("bitterness"): Anger and resentment caused by unfair treatment or disappointment.) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Perceived unfairness in promotion decisions can create lasting bitterness among employees and weaken cooperation within organisations.

en: To give someone responsibility for something or someone valuable.
vi: Hành động / quá trình (entrust): To give someone responsibility for something or someone valuable.

ex.en: I entrusted my neighbour with the spare house key.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "entrust" (Hành động / quá trình (entrust): To give someone responsibility for something or someone valuable.) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Parents entrust schools with their children's education and expect teachers to provide a safe learning environment.

en: the activity or business of hunting whales
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("whaling"): the activity or business of hunting whales

ex.en: The harbour museum has an exhibition about whaling.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "whaling" (Từ vựng IELTS ("whaling"): the activity or business of hunting whales) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Commercial whaling has contributed to declining whale populations, prompting international efforts to protect these marine mammals.

en: a large room or building for an audience
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("auditorium"): a large room or building for an audience

ex.en: Families filled the auditorium for the school concert.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "auditorium" (Từ vựng IELTS ("auditorium"): a large room or building for an audience) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: A modern auditorium allows the university to host public lectures and strengthen links with the local community.

en: The advantage or status gained from longer service.
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("seniority"): The advantage or status gained from longer service.

ex.en: Her seniority gives her first choice of holiday dates.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "seniority" (Từ vựng IELTS ("seniority"): The advantage or status gained from longer service.) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Promotion based solely on seniority may discourage younger employees who consistently demonstrate exceptional skills and commitment.

en: to provide evidence showing that something is true
vi: Hành động / quá trình (substantiate): to provide evidence showing that something is true

ex.en: She kept the receipts to substantiate her insurance claim.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "substantiate" (Hành động / quá trình (substantiate): to provide evidence showing that something is true) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Researchers must substantiate claims about new treatments with reliable evidence from carefully designed clinical trials.

en: A long speech delivered by one character in a performance.
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("monologue"): A long speech delivered by one character in a performance.

ex.en: The actor practised her monologue alone in the kitchen.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "monologue" (Từ vựng IELTS ("monologue"): A long speech delivered by one character in a performance.) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: A dramatic monologue can reveal a character's inner conflicts more directly than dialogue between several speakers.

en: A large area of flat land higher than surrounding land.
vi: Cao nguyên rộng lớn

ex.en: We camped on a grassy plateau above the valley.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "plateau" (Cao nguyên rộng lớn) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Language learners often reach a plateau and may need different study methods to make further progress.

en: Acceptance that something is true or that someone's contribution matters.
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("acknowledgment"): Acceptance that something is true or that someone's contribution matters.

ex.en: He nodded in acknowledgment of his sister's helpful suggestion.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "acknowledgment" (Từ vựng IELTS ("acknowledgment"): Acceptance that something is true or that someone's contribution matters.) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Public acknowledgment of past mistakes can help institutions rebuild trust and strengthen their relationships with local communities.

en: To travel across or through an area.
vi: Hành động / quá trình (traverse): To travel across or through an area.

ex.en: We traversed the snowy valley before reaching the mountain hut.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "traverse" (Hành động / quá trình (traverse): To travel across or through an area.) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: New railway routes traverse remote regions, connecting isolated communities with essential services and larger markets.

en: A measurable factor used to describe a system or calculation.
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("parameter"): A measurable factor used to describe a system or calculation.

ex.en: You can adjust this parameter to sharpen the image.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "parameter" (Từ vựng IELTS ("parameter"): A measurable factor used to describe a system or calculation.) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Researchers must identify the key parameters affecting energy consumption before developing reliable models of urban demand.

en: The study of whole economies, including growth, inflation, and unemployment.
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("macroeconomics"): The study of whole economies, including growth, inflation, and unemployment.

ex.en: My sister studies macroeconomics at college every Tuesday.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "macroeconomics" (Từ vựng IELTS ("macroeconomics"): The study of whole economies, including growth, inflation, and unemployment.) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: An understanding of macroeconomics helps policymakers assess how interest rate changes might affect national employment.

en: a lack of agreement between facts, statements, or actions
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("inconsistency"): a lack of agreement between facts, statements, or actions

ex.en: I noticed an inconsistency between your story and hers.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "inconsistency" (Từ vựng IELTS ("inconsistency"): a lack of agreement between facts, statements, or actions) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Inconsistency in the enforcement of regulations can undermine public trust and create unfair advantages for some businesses.

en: able to express ideas clearly and effectively
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("articulate"): able to express ideas clearly and effectively

ex.en: Our articulate neighbour explained the problem clearly at dinner.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "articulate" (Từ vựng IELTS ("articulate"): able to express ideas clearly and effectively) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Schools should help students articulate their opinions clearly while encouraging them to consider alternative perspectives.

en: goods transported in bulk, or the transport of such goods
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("freight"): goods transported in bulk, or the transport of such goods

ex.en: The train carried freight through the valley overnight.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "freight" (Từ vựng IELTS ("freight"): goods transported in bulk, or the transport of such goods) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Moving more freight by rail could reduce road congestion and lower emissions from heavy vehicles.

en: to surround or cover something completely
vi: Hành động / quá trình (engulf): to surround or cover something completely

ex.en: A sudden wave engulfed our sandcastle on the beach.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "engulf" (Hành động / quá trình (engulf): to surround or cover something completely) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Rising sea levels could engulf low-lying coastal settlements unless governments invest in effective flood protection.

en: Extreme suffering or death caused by a prolonged lack of food
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("starvation"): Extreme suffering or death caused by a prolonged lack of food

ex.en: Volunteers brought food to animals at risk of starvation.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "starvation" (Từ vựng IELTS ("starvation"): Extreme suffering or death caused by a prolonged lack of food) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Prolonged drought can lead to widespread starvation when communities lack reliable food reserves and emergency support.

en: relating to a town or city and its administration
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("civic"): relating to a town or city and its administration

ex.en: The mayor welcomed visitors outside the new civic centre.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "civic" (Từ vựng IELTS ("civic"): relating to a town or city and its administration) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Schools can strengthen civic responsibility by encouraging students to participate in projects that benefit their local communities.

en: Selecting a small part of something to study the whole.
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("sampling"): Selecting a small part of something to study the whole.

ex.en: Sampling the soup helped me choose my lunch.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "sampling" (Từ vựng IELTS ("sampling"): Selecting a small part of something to study the whole.) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Random sampling helps researchers obtain representative data without interviewing every individual in a large population.

en: to move upwards or rise to a higher position
vi: Hành động / quá trình (ascend): to move upwards or rise to a higher position

ex.en: We watched the balloon ascend slowly into the clear sky.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "ascend" (Hành động / quá trình (ascend): to move upwards or rise to a higher position) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: As hikers ascend the mountain, they encounter distinct vegetation zones shaped by changing temperatures and moisture levels.

en: The process of becoming damaged or poorer in quality.
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("degradation"): The process of becoming damaged or poorer in quality.

ex.en: The farmer noticed soil degradation across his dry fields.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "degradation" (Từ vựng IELTS ("degradation"): The process of becoming damaged or poorer in quality.) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Environmental degradation often affects poorer communities most severely because they depend directly on local natural resources.

en: the quality of being honest and following strong moral principles
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("integrity"): the quality of being honest and following strong moral principles

ex.en: She showed integrity by returning the money she found.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "integrity" (Từ vựng IELTS ("integrity"): the quality of being honest and following strong moral principles) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Independent inspections help maintain the structural integrity of bridges and protect the public from preventable accidents.

en: to make progress or an activity more difficult
vi: Hành động / quá trình (hamper): to make progress or an activity more difficult

ex.en: Heavy rain hampered our efforts to repair the fence.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "hamper" (Hành động / quá trình (hamper): to make progress or an activity more difficult) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Limited access to reliable internet services can hamper economic development in remote rural communities.

en: To state a requirement clearly as part of an agreement
vi: Hành động / quá trình (stipulate): To state a requirement clearly as part of an agreement

ex.en: The rental rules stipulate that pets must stay downstairs.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "stipulate" (Hành động / quá trình (stipulate): To state a requirement clearly as part of an agreement) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Employment contracts should stipulate working hours clearly to prevent disputes between employers and their staff.

en: Stored under customs control until import duties are paid
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("bonded"): Stored under customs control until import duties are paid

ex.en: The imported coffee stays in a bonded warehouse nearby.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "bonded" (Từ vựng IELTS ("bonded"): Stored under customs control until import duties are paid) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Bonded warehouses allow importers to delay paying duties until goods enter the domestic market.

en: Choosing what works in practice rather than following ideals.
vi: Thực tế, thực dụng, chú trọng hiệu quả

ex.en: We took a pragmatic approach and repaired the old sofa.
ex.vi: Chúng ta cần một cách tiếp cận thực tế hơn để giải quyết bài toán rác thải nhựa.

ex.en: A pragmatic housing policy should balance environmental goals with the immediate needs of local residents.
ex.vi: Các nhà hoạch định chính sách đã đưa ra những giải pháp mang tính thực tiễn cao.

col: pragmatic approach — cách tiếp cận thực tế
pragmatic solution — giải pháp thiết thực
tip: Cụm "take a pragmatic approach to..." rất hay dùng trong phần Conclusion của IELTS Writing Task 2.

en: To happen or become real after being expected or planned.
vi: Hành động / quá trình (materialize): To happen or become real after being expected or planned.

ex.en: Our weekend trip never materialized because everyone was too busy.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "materialize" (Hành động / quá trình (materialize): To happen or become real after being expected or planned.) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: The promised economic benefits may not materialize unless governments also invest in education and transport.

en: a replaceable container holding material needed by a machine
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("cartridge"): a replaceable container holding material needed by a machine

ex.en: I replaced the empty cartridge before printing my homework.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "cartridge" (Từ vựng IELTS ("cartridge"): a replaceable container holding material needed by a machine) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Recycling printer cartridges can reduce plastic waste and recover materials that would otherwise enter landfill sites.

en: Develop industries and factories in a country or region
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("industrialize"): Develop industries and factories in a country or region

ex.en: The town industrialized rapidly after the railway opened.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "industrialize" (Từ vựng IELTS ("industrialize"): Develop industries and factories in a country or region) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: As countries industrialize, governments must balance economic growth with environmental protection and workers' welfare.

en: Moving in circles, or operating through circular movement.
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("rotary"): Moving in circles, or operating through circular movement.

ex.en: Dad uses a rotary mower to cut the grass.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "rotary" (Từ vựng IELTS ("rotary"): Moving in circles, or operating through circular movement.) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Rotary motion is widely used in industrial machinery because it allows continuous and efficient operation.

en: to happen at the same time
vi: Hành động / quá trình (coincide): to happen at the same time

ex.en: My days off rarely coincide with my sister's.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "coincide" (Hành động / quá trình (coincide): to happen at the same time) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Government investment should coincide with local priorities to ensure that public funds address genuine community needs.

en: failure to give enough attention to someone or something
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("inattention"): failure to give enough attention to someone or something

ex.en: A moment of inattention left the toast badly burnt.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "inattention" (Từ vựng IELTS ("inattention"): failure to give enough attention to someone or something) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Driver inattention remains a major road safety concern, particularly as mobile devices become increasingly common.

en: a market with many small shops or stalls
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("bazaar"): a market with many small shops or stalls

ex.en: We bought fragrant spices at the crowded bazaar.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "bazaar" (Từ vựng IELTS ("bazaar"): a market with many small shops or stalls) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Traditional bazaars can attract tourists while providing local craftspeople with opportunities to sell their products directly.

en: An extremely heavy fall of rain or a severe flood.
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("deluge"): An extremely heavy fall of rain or a severe flood.

ex.en: We sheltered in a café until the deluge stopped.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "deluge" (Từ vựng IELTS ("deluge"): An extremely heavy fall of rain or a severe flood.) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: After the new housing policy was announced, local officials were deluged with questions from concerned residents.

en: to become or make something rigid or less flexible
vi: Hành động / quá trình (stiffen): to become or make something rigid or less flexible

ex.en: My legs stiffen after sitting on the bus for hours.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "stiffen" (Hành động / quá trình (stiffen): to become or make something rigid or less flexible) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Public opposition may stiffen if the government approves construction without consulting residents about environmental risks.

en: to cause someone to lose the ability to move
vi: Hành động / quá trình (paralyse): to cause someone to lose the ability to move

ex.en: The injury paralysed his legs, but his arms remained strong.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "paralyse" (Hành động / quá trình (paralyse): to cause someone to lose the ability to move) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Severe flooding can paralyse urban transport systems, preventing essential workers from reaching hospitals and other services.

en: To stay somewhere longer than expected or necessary.
vi: Hành động / quá trình (linger): To stay somewhere longer than expected or necessary.

ex.en: We lingered outside the cinema, chatting about the film.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "linger" (Hành động / quá trình (linger): To stay somewhere longer than expected or necessary.) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: The effects of prolonged unemployment can linger even after individuals return to stable work.

en: an event in which a boat or sea animal becomes stuck
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("stranding"): an event in which a boat or sea animal becomes stuck

ex.en: Volunteers rushed to help after a whale stranding.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "stranding" (Từ vựng IELTS ("stranding"): an event in which a boat or sea animal becomes stuck) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Researchers investigate each mass stranding to understand why marine mammals sometimes become trapped in shallow coastal waters.

en: Love for and loyalty to your country.
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("patriotism"): Love for and loyalty to your country.

ex.en: Her patriotism shines through whenever she discusses her country's achievements.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "patriotism" (Từ vựng IELTS ("patriotism"): Love for and loyalty to your country.) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Schools can encourage patriotism while also teaching students to respect other nations and understand global responsibilities.

en: A small change that makes something better or more effective.
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("refinement"): A small change that makes something better or more effective.

ex.en: One small refinement made the chair much more comfortable.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "refinement" (Từ vựng IELTS ("refinement"): A small change that makes something better or more effective.) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Continued refinement of water treatment methods can improve public health while reducing the cost of supplying clean water.

en: To deliver a religious talk to a group of people.
vi: Hành động / quá trình (preach): To deliver a religious talk to a group of people.

ex.en: The minister preached about kindness at the morning service.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "preach" (Hành động / quá trình (preach): To deliver a religious talk to a group of people.) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Schools should demonstrate respect through everyday practices rather than simply preach the importance of good behaviour.

en: Quiet and unwilling to argue or resist others.
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("meek"): Quiet and unwilling to argue or resist others.

ex.en: He gave a meek nod and stepped aside.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "meek" (Từ vựng IELTS ("meek"): Quiet and unwilling to argue or resist others.) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Students who seem meek in class may express strong opinions when given a supportive discussion environment.

en: Music played to support a singer or main instrument.
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("accompaniment"): Music played to support a singer or main instrument.

ex.en: My sister sang while I played the piano accompaniment.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "accompaniment" (Từ vựng IELTS ("accompaniment"): Music played to support a singer or main instrument.) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Learning to provide musical accompaniment can help students develop listening skills and cooperate more effectively with others.

en: The organization of transporting goods, equipment, or people where needed.
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("logistics"): The organization of transporting goods, equipment, or people where needed.

ex.en: My brother handles the logistics of our camping trips.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "logistics" (Từ vựng IELTS ("logistics"): The organization of transporting goods, equipment, or people where needed.) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Efficient logistics can reduce food waste by ensuring fresh produce reaches urban markets quickly.

en: Noticeable through the senses or the mind.

ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "perceptible" (Từ vựng IELTS ("perceptible"): Noticeable through the senses or the mind.) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

en: Very skilled at doing something.
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("adept"): Very skilled at doing something.

ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "adept" (Từ vựng IELTS ("adept"): Very skilled at doing something.) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Teachers who are adept at using digital tools can adapt lessons to meet a wider range of learning needs.

en: trying to seem more important or impressive than is justified
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("pretentious"): trying to seem more important or impressive than is justified

ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "pretentious" (Từ vựng IELTS ("pretentious"): trying to seem more important or impressive than is justified) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Public art may alienate local residents if its presentation seems pretentious rather than welcoming and accessible.

en: Not central to the main issue or activity.
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("peripheral"): Not central to the main issue or activity.

ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "peripheral" (Từ vựng IELTS ("peripheral"): Not central to the main issue or activity.) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Funding debates should not allow peripheral issues to distract attention from the central goal of improving education.

en: The process of becoming worse in condition or quality.
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("deterioration"): The process of becoming worse in condition or quality.

ex.en: Cracks in the ceiling showed the building's gradual deterioration.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "deterioration" (Từ vựng IELTS ("deterioration"): The process of becoming worse in condition or quality.) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: A deterioration in urban air quality can increase respiratory illness and place additional pressure on healthcare services.

en: The feeling of being disconnected from other people or society.
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("alienation"): The feeling of being disconnected from other people or society.

ex.en: Joining a local choir eased her sense of alienation.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "alienation" (Từ vựng IELTS ("alienation"): The feeling of being disconnected from other people or society.) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Rapid urban development can deepen residents' alienation when familiar neighbourhoods are replaced by anonymous apartment blocks.

en: So important or useful that it cannot be done without
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("indispensable"): So important or useful that it cannot be done without

ex.en: My bicycle is indispensable for getting to work.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "indispensable" (Từ vựng IELTS ("indispensable"): So important or useful that it cannot be done without) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Reliable internet access has become indispensable for students who depend on digital platforms to complete their coursework.

en: Failure to take proper care or fulfil a responsibility
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("negligence"): Failure to take proper care or fulfil a responsibility

ex.en: The leaking roof resulted from years of negligence.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "negligence" (Từ vựng IELTS ("negligence"): Failure to take proper care or fulfil a responsibility) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Stronger workplace inspections can help prevent accidents caused by employer negligence and inadequate safety training.

en: living on or relating to land rather than water
vi: Thuộc về Trái Đất hoặc trên cạn

ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "terrestrial" (Thuộc về Trái Đất hoặc trên cạn) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Protecting terrestrial habitats is essential because many species cannot survive outside their original ecosystems.

en: A carbohydrate found in foods such as potatoes, rice, and bread.
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("starch"): A carbohydrate found in foods such as potatoes, rice, and bread.

ex.en: Mix the corn starch with water before adding it.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "starch" (Từ vựng IELTS ("starch"): A carbohydrate found in foods such as potatoes, rice, and bread.) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Foods rich in starch provide energy, but their nutritional value also depends on fibre content and processing methods.

en: Related to or caused by the circumstances of a particular situation.
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("situational"): Related to or caused by the circumstances of a particular situation.

ex.en: My anxiety is situational, appearing only in crowded lifts.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "situational" (Từ vựng IELTS ("situational"): Related to or caused by the circumstances of a particular situation.) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Teachers should consider situational factors, such as classroom noise, before attributing poor performance to a lack of ability.

en: With the head first, or with great speed.
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("headlong"): With the head first, or with great speed.

ex.en: He tripped over the cushion and fell headlong onto the sofa.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "headlong" (Từ vựng IELTS ("headlong"): With the head first, or with great speed.) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Governments should avoid rushing headlong into major infrastructure projects without first assessing their environmental impact.

en: complete control of a market or exclusive possession of something
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("monopoly"): complete control of a market or exclusive possession of something

ex.en: One company has a monopoly on our island's ferry services.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "monopoly" (Từ vựng IELTS ("monopoly"): complete control of a market or exclusive possession of something) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Without effective regulation, a monopoly can raise prices and leave consumers with few alternatives.

en: A large open pit where stone is dug from the ground.
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("quarry"): A large open pit where stone is dug from the ground.

ex.en: Huge trucks carried pale stone out of the quarry.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "quarry" (Từ vựng IELTS ("quarry"): A large open pit where stone is dug from the ground.) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Restoring an abandoned quarry can create valuable wildlife habitats while reducing risks to nearby communities.

en: An animal resembling a kangaroo but generally smaller.
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("wallaby"): An animal resembling a kangaroo but generally smaller.

ex.en: A wallaby hopped across the path ahead of us.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "wallaby" (Từ vựng IELTS ("wallaby"): An animal resembling a kangaroo but generally smaller.) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Protecting native vegetation helps wallaby populations survive as farming and urban development reduce their natural habitat.

en: To move quickly or make someone move quickly, sometimes roughly.
vi: Hành động / quá trình (hustle): To move quickly or make someone move quickly, sometimes roughly.

ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "hustle" (Hành động / quá trình (hustle): To move quickly or make someone move quickly, sometimes roughly.) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

en: someone without specialist knowledge of a particular subject
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("layman"): someone without specialist knowledge of a particular subject

ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "layman" (Từ vựng IELTS ("layman"): someone without specialist knowledge of a particular subject) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Scientific reports should include summaries that a layman can understand without specialist training.

en: To move suddenly and quickly in a particular direction.

ex.en: A squirrel darted across the path ahead of us.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "dart" (Hành động / quá trình (dart): To move suddenly and quickly in a particular direction.) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

en: To deliberately stop yourself from doing something.

ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "refrain" (Hành động / quá trình (refrain): To deliberately stop yourself from doing something.) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Visitors should refrain from touching fragile exhibits so that museums can preserve them for future generations.

en: A salt of nitric acid, often used in fertilisers
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("nitrate"): A salt of nitric acid, often used in fertilisers

ex.en: The gardener added a nitrate fertiliser to the soil.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "nitrate" (Từ vựng IELTS ("nitrate"): A salt of nitric acid, often used in fertilisers) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Excessive nitrate levels in rivers can encourage algal growth and threaten the survival of aquatic species.

en: To make something seem less valuable, attractive, or impressive.
vi: Hành động / quá trình (detract): To make something seem less valuable, attractive, or impressive.

ex.en: The noisy road detracts from our garden's peaceful atmosphere.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "detract" (Hành động / quá trình (detract): To make something seem less valuable, attractive, or impressive.) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Poor public transport can detract from a city's appeal, even when its cultural attractions are exceptional.

en: To satisfy thirst or a strong desire.
vi: Hành động / quá trình (quench): To satisfy thirst or a strong desire.

ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "quench" (Hành động / quá trình (quench): To satisfy thirst or a strong desire.) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Public drinking fountains allow residents to quench their thirst without buying bottled water, reducing plastic waste.

en: A difficult or unfortunate situation that causes hardship.
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("adversity"): A difficult or unfortunate situation that causes hardship.

ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "adversity" (Từ vựng IELTS ("adversity"): A difficult or unfortunate situation that causes hardship.) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

en: Very unhappy, uncomfortable, or unfortunate.
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("wretched"): Very unhappy, uncomfortable, or unfortunate.

ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "wretched" (Từ vựng IELTS ("wretched"): Very unhappy, uncomfortable, or unfortunate.) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Families living in wretched housing conditions face greater risks of respiratory illness and other health problems.

en: give money to support an institution or position permanently
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("endow"): give money to support an institution or position permanently

ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "endow" (Từ vựng IELTS ("endow"): give money to support an institution or position permanently) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Private donations can endow research centres that investigate long-term solutions to urgent public health problems.

en: A small object attached to keys, sometimes controlling electronic locks.
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("fob"): A small object attached to keys, sometimes controlling electronic locks.

ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "fob" (Từ vựng IELTS ("fob"): A small object attached to keys, sometimes controlling electronic locks.) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Housing providers increasingly issue residents an electronic fob to control access to shared buildings.

en: Allowing light through, but not a clear view of objects.
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("translucent"): Allowing light through, but not a clear view of objects.

ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "translucent" (Từ vựng IELTS ("translucent"): Allowing light through, but not a clear view of objects.) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

en: a deep, narrow valley with steep sides
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("gorge"): a deep, narrow valley with steep sides

ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "gorge" (Từ vựng IELTS ("gorge"): a deep, narrow valley with steep sides) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Building roads through a gorge can damage fragile habitats and increase the risk of landslides.

en: The state of owing money, or the amount owed.
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("indebtedness"): The state of owing money, or the amount owed.

ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "indebtedness" (Từ vựng IELTS ("indebtedness"): The state of owing money, or the amount owed.) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: High household indebtedness can reduce consumer spending and make an economy more vulnerable to financial shocks.

en: to involve someone deeply in an activity or experience
vi: Hành động / quá trình (immerse): to involve someone deeply in an activity or experience

ex.en: On rainy afternoons, I immerse myself in a novel.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "immerse" (Hành động / quá trình (immerse): to involve someone deeply in an activity or experience) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Exchange programmes allow students to immerse themselves in another culture and develop greater independence.

en: Someone with extensive experience in a particular activity or profession.
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("veteran"): Someone with extensive experience in a particular activity or profession.

ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "veteran" (Từ vựng IELTS ("veteran"): Someone with extensive experience in a particular activity or profession.) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

en: Meeting another line or surface at a right angle
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("perpendicular"): Meeting another line or surface at a right angle

ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "perpendicular" (Từ vựng IELTS ("perpendicular"): Meeting another line or surface at a right angle) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

en: containing salt or relating to salt

ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "saline" (Từ vựng IELTS ("saline"): containing salt or relating to salt) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Rising sea levels can make coastal groundwater more saline, reducing its suitability for drinking and irrigation.

en: Something accepted or given up to help reach an agreement

ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "concession" (Từ vựng IELTS ("concession"): Something accepted or given up to help reach an agreement) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Offering concessions to students and older people can make public transport more affordable for these groups.

en: The forced movement of people away from their homes.
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("displacement"): The forced movement of people away from their homes.

ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "displacement" (Từ vựng IELTS ("displacement"): The forced movement of people away from their homes.) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Coastal erosion may lead to widespread displacement unless governments invest in effective protection and planned relocation.

en: someone who leaves their country to settle in another
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("emigrant"): someone who leaves their country to settle in another

ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "emigrant" (Từ vựng IELTS ("emigrant"): someone who leaves their country to settle in another) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Emigrants often maintain strong connections with their countries of origin through family visits and financial support.

en: to happen or exist before something else
vi: Hành động / quá trình (precede): to happen or exist before something else

ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "precede" (Hành động / quá trình (precede): to happen or exist before something else) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Thorough environmental assessments should precede major construction projects to identify potential risks to local ecosystems.

en: Able to dissolve in a liquid.
vi: Có thể hòa tan; có thể giải quyết

ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "soluble" (Có thể hòa tan; có thể giải quyết) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Water-soluble pollutants can spread through rivers, making contamination difficult to contain once it enters the water supply.

en: the muscle below your lungs that helps you breathe
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("diaphragm"): the muscle below your lungs that helps you breathe

ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "diaphragm" (Từ vựng IELTS ("diaphragm"): the muscle below your lungs that helps you breathe) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: During inhalation, the diaphragm contracts and moves downward, allowing the lungs to expand as air enters.

en: able to understand and work with numbers
vi: Có khả năng tính toán số học tốt

ex.en: The shop needs numerate staff who can calculate change.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "numerate" (Có khả năng tính toán số học tốt) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Schools should ensure that all students become numerate enough to manage personal finances and interpret basic statistics.

en: Planned and carried out together to achieve a shared goal.
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("concerted"): Planned and carried out together to achieve a shared goal.

ex.en: Our concerted efforts finally cleared the garden of rubbish.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "concerted" (Từ vựng IELTS ("concerted"): Planned and carried out together to achieve a shared goal.) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Reducing urban air pollution requires concerted action from local authorities, transport providers, businesses and residents.

en: A broad, mostly treeless grassland in North America
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("prairie"): A broad, mostly treeless grassland in North America

ex.en: We watched tall grass ripple across the open prairie.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "prairie" (Từ vựng IELTS ("prairie"): A broad, mostly treeless grassland in North America) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Protecting native prairie habitats helps preserve biodiversity and maintains grassland ecosystems that store substantial amounts of carbon.

en: Very strong, powerful, or large.
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("mighty"): Very strong, powerful, or large.

ex.en: A mighty oak stood in the middle of the field.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "mighty" (Từ vựng IELTS ("mighty"): Very strong, powerful, or large.) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Although mighty rivers provide valuable renewable energy, building large dams can seriously disrupt surrounding ecosystems.

en: An addictive substance from poppies, used to produce certain painkillers
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("opium"): An addictive substance from poppies, used to produce certain painkillers

ex.en: The museum guide explained how opium affected trade.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "opium" (Từ vựng IELTS ("opium"): An addictive substance from poppies, used to produce certain painkillers) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Historical research shows that the opium trade had lasting economic and social consequences for several countries.

en: a hunting bird with pointed wings and a curved beak
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("falcon"): a hunting bird with pointed wings and a curved beak

ex.en: A falcon circled above the cliffs this morning.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "falcon" (Từ vựng IELTS ("falcon"): a hunting bird with pointed wings and a curved beak) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Protecting cliff habitats can help falcon populations recover in regions where suitable nesting sites have disappeared.

en: Refuse to buy or participate in something as a protest.
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("boycott"): Refuse to buy or participate in something as a protest.

ex.en: Local shoppers decided to boycott the store over unfair wages.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "boycott" (Từ vựng IELTS ("boycott"): Refuse to buy or participate in something as a protest.) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: A consumer boycott can pressure companies to improve working conditions throughout their international supply chains.

en: fair to everyone involved, taking their different circumstances into account
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("equitable"): fair to everyone involved, taking their different circumstances into account

ex.en: We agreed on an equitable division of household chores.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "equitable" (Từ vựng IELTS ("equitable"): fair to everyone involved, taking their different circumstances into account) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: An equitable funding system would direct more resources towards schools serving disadvantaged communities.

en: describing a woman who is short and has a small build
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("petite"): describing a woman who is short and has a small build

ex.en: My sister is petite and often needs shorter trousers.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "petite" (Từ vựng IELTS ("petite"): describing a woman who is short and has a small build) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Clothing retailers can serve a wider range of customers by offering petite sizes alongside their standard collections.

en: widely recognised as representing a place, style, or idea
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("iconic"): widely recognised as representing a place, style, or idea

ex.en: We stopped to photograph the city's iconic stone bridge.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "iconic" (Từ vựng IELTS ("iconic"): widely recognised as representing a place, style, or idea) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Preserving iconic buildings can strengthen cultural identity, although maintenance costs may place pressure on public budgets.

en: A person or thing that triggers or accelerates change.

ex.vi: Làm việc từ xa đã trở thành chất xúc tác cho cuộc cách mạng văn phòng số.

ex.vi: Cuộc khủng hoảng năng lượng đóng vai trò là nhân tố thúc đẩy quá trình chuyển đổi xanh.

en: The edible inner part of a nut, or a grain seed.
