ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "navigable" (Từ vựng IELTS ("navigable"): Deep and wide enough for boats or ships to travel through.) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: A clearly organised and easily navigable website can improve access to essential public services.

en: to receive results or rewards from previous actions
vi: Hành động / quá trình (reap): to receive results or rewards from previous actions

ex.en: After months of practice, she finally reaped the rewards.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "reap" (Hành động / quá trình (reap): to receive results or rewards from previous actions) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Countries that invest consistently in early education often reap long-term economic and social benefits.

en: rock containing metal or other valuable substances that can be extracted
vi: Quặng kim loại tự nhiên

ex.en: The truck carried iron ore down the dusty road.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "ore" (Quặng kim loại tự nhiên) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Extracting metals from ore requires substantial energy and can cause serious damage to surrounding ecosystems.

en: relating to a territory controlled by a foreign country
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("colonial"): relating to a territory controlled by a foreign country

ex.en: Our guide showed us several buildings from the colonial period.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "colonial" (Từ vựng IELTS ("colonial"): relating to a territory controlled by a foreign country) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Colonial rule often reshaped local economies by directing agricultural production towards the needs of distant markets.

en: To form a circle around someone or something.
vi: Hành động / quá trình (encircle): To form a circle around someone or something.

ex.en: Tall trees encircle the small pond behind our house.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "encircle" (Hành động / quá trình (encircle): To form a circle around someone or something.) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Green belts that encircle urban areas can protect wildlife habitats and limit uncontrolled development.

en: Waiting for a decision or for something to happen
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("pending"): Waiting for a decision or for something to happen

ex.en: Our application is still pending, so we cannot book flights.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "pending" (Từ vựng IELTS ("pending"): Waiting for a decision or for something to happen) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Construction should remain suspended pending a thorough assessment of its potential impact on the surrounding environment.

en: To comfort someone who feels sad or disappointed.
vi: Hành động / quá trình (console): To comfort someone who feels sad or disappointed.

ex.en: Lena tried to console her brother after his team lost.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "console" (Hành động / quá trình (console): To comfort someone who feels sad or disappointed.) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Teachers should console disappointed students while helping them develop practical strategies for improving their academic performance.

en: To end something, or to come to an end.
vi: Hành động / quá trình (terminate): To end something, or to come to an end.

ex.en: We decided to terminate our gym membership last month.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "terminate" (Hành động / quá trình (terminate): To end something, or to come to an end.) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Employers should not terminate contracts without providing clear reasons and allowing workers sufficient time to respond.

en: An individual animal, plant, or object collected for scientific study.
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("specimen"): An individual animal, plant, or object collected for scientific study.

ex.en: The museum keeps this butterfly specimen behind glass.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "specimen" (Từ vựng IELTS ("specimen"): An individual animal, plant, or object collected for scientific study.) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Researchers examined each plant specimen to assess how prolonged drought had affected its growth.

en: Determined to succeed without caring about harm caused to others.
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("ruthless"): Determined to succeed without caring about harm caused to others.

ex.en: The ruthless landlord evicted the family without any warning.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "ruthless" (Từ vựng IELTS ("ruthless"): Determined to succeed without caring about harm caused to others.) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Ruthless competition may encourage companies to cut labour costs at the expense of employee welfare.

en: The system or process of collecting money through taxes.
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("taxation"): The system or process of collecting money through taxes.

ex.en: Taxation helps pay for our local schools and roads.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "taxation" (Từ vựng IELTS ("taxation"): The system or process of collecting money through taxes.) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Progressive taxation can reduce income inequality by requiring wealthier citizens to contribute a larger proportion of their earnings.

en: A machine whose blades turn when pushed by moving fluid.
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("turbine"): A machine whose blades turn when pushed by moving fluid.

ex.en: We watched the wind turbine turning slowly above the fields.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "turbine" (Từ vựng IELTS ("turbine"): A machine whose blades turn when pushed by moving fluid.) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Installing offshore wind turbines can increase renewable electricity generation, although potential impacts on marine ecosystems require careful assessment.

en: the amount by which spending exceeds income
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("deficit"): the amount by which spending exceeds income

ex.en: Our club faces a deficit after buying new equipment.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "deficit" (Từ vựng IELTS ("deficit"): the amount by which spending exceeds income) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Governments may reduce a budget deficit by raising taxes, but this can slow economic growth.

en: the process of bringing goods into a country from abroad
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("importation"): the process of bringing goods into a country from abroad

ex.en: The importation of fresh fruit requires careful temperature control.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "importation" (Từ vựng IELTS ("importation"): the process of bringing goods into a country from abroad) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Restrictions on the importation of agricultural products may protect local farmers but increase food prices for consumers.

en: What someone plans or means to do.
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("intent"): What someone plans or means to do.

ex.en: My intent was to help, not to interrupt you.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "intent" (Từ vựng IELTS ("intent"): What someone plans or means to do.) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Many governments are intent on reducing traffic congestion through investment in reliable public transport.

en: based on chance or personal choice rather than clear reasons
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("arbitrary"): based on chance or personal choice rather than clear reasons

ex.en: Her choice felt arbitrary: she picked without even looking.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "arbitrary" (Từ vựng IELTS ("arbitrary"): based on chance or personal choice rather than clear reasons) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Arbitrary restrictions on university admissions can prevent capable students from accessing education and may reinforce existing social inequalities.

en: A musical performance given by one person or a small group.
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("recital"): A musical performance given by one person or a small group.

ex.en: Her first piano recital drew a small but enthusiastic audience.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "recital" (Từ vựng IELTS ("recital"): A musical performance given by one person or a small group.) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Regular opportunities to give a recital can help music students develop confidence and improve their performance skills.

en: To walk unevenly because one leg or foot is hurt
vi: Hành động / quá trình (limp): To walk unevenly because one leg or foot is hurt

ex.en: I had to limp home after twisting my ankle.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "limp" (Hành động / quá trình (limp): To walk unevenly because one leg or foot is hurt) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Athletes who continue to limp after an injury should receive professional assessment before returning to competitive sport.

en: Either of two imaginary circles marking Earth's tropical boundaries.
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("tropic"): Either of two imaginary circles marking Earth's tropical boundaries.

ex.en: Our guide pointed to the northern tropic on a globe.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "tropic" (Từ vựng IELTS ("tropic"): Either of two imaginary circles marking Earth's tropical boundaries.) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Communities in the tropics often depend on seasonal rainfall to sustain agriculture and maintain reliable freshwater supplies.

en: Make someone believe something that is not true.
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("delude"): Make someone believe something that is not true.

ex.en: Don't delude yourself into thinking the work is finished.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "delude" (Từ vựng IELTS ("delude"): Make someone believe something that is not true.) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Policymakers should not delude themselves into believing that economic growth alone will eliminate poverty and social inequality.

en: To search for or handle something with awkward hand movements.
vi: Hành động / quá trình (fumble): To search for or handle something with awkward hand movements.

ex.en: I fumbled for my keys in the dark hallway.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "fumble" (Hành động / quá trình (fumble): To search for or handle something with awkward hand movements.) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Users often fumble with unfamiliar controls, highlighting the importance of intuitive design in public transport systems.

en: Extremely violent, fierce, or cruel.
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("savage"): Extremely violent, fierce, or cruel.

ex.en: The documentary showed a savage fight between two wolves.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "savage" (Từ vựng IELTS ("savage"): Extremely violent, fierce, or cruel.) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: The proposed reduction in education funding attracted savage criticism from teachers and parents across the country.

en: Extremely useful or valuable.
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("invaluable"): Extremely useful or valuable.

ex.en: Your advice was invaluable when I bought my first bicycle.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "invaluable" (Từ vựng IELTS ("invaluable"): Extremely useful or valuable.) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Practical work experience provides students with invaluable insights into the skills employers expect from new graduates.

en: to stop happening or doing something
vi: Hành động / quá trình (cease): to stop happening or doing something

ex.en: The bells finally ceased ringing just before midnight.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "cease" (Hành động / quá trình (cease): to stop happening or doing something) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Factories should cease discharging untreated wastewater into rivers to protect aquatic ecosystems and safeguard public health.

en: to give someone pleasure or satisfaction
vi: Hành động / quá trình (gratify): to give someone pleasure or satisfaction

ex.en: Your kind words will gratify everyone who helped today.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "gratify" (Hành động / quá trình (gratify): to give someone pleasure or satisfaction) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Policies that gratify immediate consumer desires may conflict with the need to protect resources for future generations.

en: Full of important, interesting, or unexpected events.
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("eventful"): Full of important, interesting, or unexpected events.

ex.en: After an eventful morning, we finally sat down for lunch.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "eventful" (Từ vựng IELTS ("eventful"): Full of important, interesting, or unexpected events.) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: An eventful period of political reform transformed the country's education system and expanded access to schooling.

en: a large feather, especially one used for decoration
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("plume"): a large feather, especially one used for decoration

ex.en: A bright plume decorated the dancer's tall hat.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "plume" (Từ vựng IELTS ("plume"): a large feather, especially one used for decoration) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: A thick plume of smoke rose above the factory, raising concerns about local air quality.

en: feeling uncertain or doubtful about something
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("dubious"): feeling uncertain or doubtful about something

ex.en: I felt dubious about buying a bicycle without brakes.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "dubious" (Từ vựng IELTS ("dubious"): feeling uncertain or doubtful about something) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Consumers should remain dubious about health claims that are not supported by reliable scientific evidence.

en: boring sameness caused by a lack of variety or change
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("monotony"): boring sameness caused by a lack of variety or change

ex.en: A short walk broke the monotony of my afternoon.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "monotony" (Từ vựng IELTS ("monotony"): boring sameness caused by a lack of variety or change) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Rotating tasks can reduce the monotony of factory work while helping employees develop a wider range of skills.

en: a rotating device with blades that drives boats or aircraft
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("propeller"): a rotating device with blades that drives boats or aircraft

ex.en: The boat's propeller churned the water into white foam.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "propeller" (Từ vựng IELTS ("propeller"): a rotating device with blades that drives boats or aircraft) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Engineers are developing quieter propeller designs to reduce the impact of shipping noise on marine wildlife.

en: A unit used to measure the power of an engine.
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("horsepower"): A unit used to measure the power of an engine.

ex.en: This tractor has enough horsepower to pull the heavy trailer.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "horsepower" (Từ vựng IELTS ("horsepower"): A unit used to measure the power of an engine.) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Although greater horsepower can improve vehicle performance, fuel efficiency remains a major consideration for many consumers.

en: A difference or disagreement between things.
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("variance"): A difference or disagreement between things.

ex.en: His cheerful smile was at variance with his complaints.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "variance" (Từ vựng IELTS ("variance"): A difference or disagreement between things.) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: The proposed housing policy is at variance with the government's commitment to protecting green spaces.

en: A military group whose members are not full-time professional soldiers.
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("militia"): A military group whose members are not full-time professional soldiers.

ex.en: The museum displayed uniforms once worn by the local militia.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "militia" (Từ vựng IELTS ("militia"): A military group whose members are not full-time professional soldiers.) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Historical records show that the militia consisted mainly of farmers who trained alongside their regular work.

en: advice, especially from someone experienced or knowledgeable
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("counsel"): advice, especially from someone experienced or knowledgeable

ex.en: I sought my aunt's counsel before accepting the job.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "counsel" (Từ vựng IELTS ("counsel"): advice, especially from someone experienced or knowledgeable) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Schools should employ trained professionals to counsel students who experience anxiety about examinations or future careers.

en: a very large quantity of something
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("abundance"): a very large quantity of something

ex.en: Our garden produces an abundance of tomatoes every summer.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "abundance" (Từ vựng IELTS ("abundance"): a very large quantity of something) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: An abundance of natural resources does not necessarily guarantee sustainable economic growth or improved living standards.

en: A vertical passage through a building or into the ground.
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("shaft"): A vertical passage through a building or into the ground.

ex.en: The lift stopped halfway up the narrow shaft.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "shaft" (Từ vựng IELTS ("shaft"): A vertical passage through a building or into the ground.) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Engineers installed a ventilation shaft to improve air quality throughout the underground transport station.

en: in a way that suits the particular situation
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("accordingly"): in a way that suits the particular situation

ex.en: The forecast predicted rain, so we dressed accordingly.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "accordingly" (Từ vựng IELTS ("accordingly"): in a way that suits the particular situation) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Schools should identify individual learning needs and adjust their teaching methods accordingly to support every student.

en: A shopping area where vehicles are usually not allowed.
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("precinct"): A shopping area where vehicles are usually not allowed.

ex.en: We met outside the bakery in the shopping precinct.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "precinct" (Từ vựng IELTS ("precinct"): A shopping area where vehicles are usually not allowed.) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Creating a pedestrian precinct can encourage local shopping while reducing traffic pollution in city centres.

en: the process of obtaining something or developing knowledge and skills
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("acquisition"): the process of obtaining something or developing knowledge and skills

ex.en: Daily conversations helped with her acquisition of new vocabulary.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "acquisition" (Từ vựng IELTS ("acquisition"): the process of obtaining something or developing knowledge and skills) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Early exposure to varied speech can support language acquisition and strengthen children's ability to communicate effectively.

en: To make something harmful, unpleasant, or serious less severe
vi: Giảm thiểu, làm dịu bớt mức độ nghiêm trọng

ex.en: Thick curtains helped mitigate the noise from the street.
ex.vi: Trồng thêm cây xanh ở đô thị có thể giúp giảm thiểu tác động của các đợt nắng nóng.

ex.en: Planting trees in urban areas can mitigate the effects of extreme heat and improve residents' quality of life.
ex.vi: Các chính phủ phải hành động quyết liệt để giảm thiểu những hệ lụy tồi tệ nhất của biến đổi khí hậu.

col: mitigate climate change — giảm thiểu biến đổi khí hậu
mitigate the risk — giảm thiểu rủi ro
mitigate negative impacts — làm dịu tác động tiêu cực
tip: Từ vựng C1 ăn điểm tuyệt đối cho chủ đề Environment & Government; thường đi với "mitigate the impact/effects/risks of".

en: The ability to behave responsibly and make sensible judgments.
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("maturity"): The ability to behave responsibly and make sensible judgments.

ex.en: Lena showed maturity by calmly admitting her mistake.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "maturity" (Từ vựng IELTS ("maturity"): The ability to behave responsibly and make sensible judgments.) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Schools can foster emotional maturity by encouraging students to resolve disagreements respectfully and consider different perspectives.

en: put something safely away, especially for a journey
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("stow"): put something safely away, especially for a journey

ex.en: Please stow your bag under the seat in front.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "stow" (Từ vựng IELTS ("stow"): put something safely away, especially for a journey) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Passengers must stow their luggage securely so that loose items do not cause injuries during unexpected turbulence.

en: training or formal introduction when someone joins an organisation
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("induction"): training or formal introduction when someone joins an organisation

ex.en: Our induction included a tour of the whole office.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "induction" (Từ vựng IELTS ("induction"): training or formal introduction when someone joins an organisation) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: A structured induction programme can help new employees understand workplace expectations and adapt to their roles.

en: A singer, especially one performing with a musical group.
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("vocalist"): A singer, especially one performing with a musical group.

ex.en: The band's vocalist sang softly while the guitarist played.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "vocalist" (Từ vựng IELTS ("vocalist"): A singer, especially one performing with a musical group.) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: A skilled vocalist can help traditional music reach younger audiences without losing its distinctive cultural character.

en: Not strict or careful enough about rules or responsibilities.
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("lax"): Not strict or careful enough about rules or responsibilities.

ex.en: The club is lax about checking membership cards.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "lax" (Từ vựng IELTS ("lax"): Not strict or careful enough about rules or responsibilities.) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Lax enforcement of environmental regulations allows some factories to discharge untreated waste into nearby rivers.

en: Likely to experience something undesirable or behave a certain way
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("prone"): Likely to experience something undesirable or behave a certain way

ex.en: My skin is prone to dryness in cold weather.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "prone" (Từ vựng IELTS ("prone"): Likely to experience something undesirable or behave a certain way) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Coastal settlements are increasingly prone to flooding as sea levels rise and extreme storms become more frequent.

en: To make someone familiar or comfortable with something through experience.
vi: Hành động / quá trình (accustom): To make someone familiar or comfortable with something through experience.

ex.en: I slowly accustomed myself to sleeping with the window open.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "accustom" (Hành động / quá trình (accustom): To make someone familiar or comfortable with something through experience.) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Schools can accustom students to collaborative work by regularly assigning tasks that require shared responsibility.

en: something that exists independently, especially an organization
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("entity"): something that exists independently, especially an organization

ex.en: Our small bakery now operates as a separate entity.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "entity" (Từ vựng IELTS ("entity"): something that exists independently, especially an organization) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Each university should remain an independent entity while cooperating with other institutions on important research projects.

en: causing difficulty through excessive work, worry, or expense
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("burdensome"): causing difficulty through excessive work, worry, or expense

ex.en: The extra paperwork became burdensome during our busiest week.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "burdensome" (Từ vựng IELTS ("burdensome"): causing difficulty through excessive work, worry, or expense) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Overly burdensome regulations may discourage small businesses from expanding, even when demand for their products is strong.

en: The order of events in time, or a record showing it.
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("chronology"): The order of events in time, or a record showing it.

ex.en: These family photos helped us establish the chronology.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "chronology" (Từ vựng IELTS ("chronology"): The order of events in time, or a record showing it.) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Establishing an accurate chronology allows historians to examine how environmental changes influenced the development of early settlements.

en: Spending more money than is necessary or sensible.
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("extravagance"): Spending more money than is necessary or sensible.

ex.en: Buying fresh flowers every week is my only extravagance.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "extravagance" (Từ vựng IELTS ("extravagance"): Spending more money than is necessary or sensible.) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Public criticism of government extravagance often increases when essential services face severe budget cuts.

en: The act of officially forcing someone to leave a place.
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("expulsion"): The act of officially forcing someone to leave a place.

ex.en: Repeated cheating led to his expulsion from the club.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "expulsion" (Từ vựng IELTS ("expulsion"): The act of officially forcing someone to leave a place.) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Schools should consider supportive interventions before expulsion, as exclusion can seriously damage a young person's educational prospects.

en: The usual or expected standard of quality or performance.
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("par"): The usual or expected standard of quality or performance.

ex.en: I'm feeling below par, so I'll stay home tonight.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "par" (Từ vựng IELTS ("par"): The usual or expected standard of quality or performance.) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Investment in teacher training could bring educational outcomes in disadvantaged areas up to par with wealthier districts.

en: Without considering or being affected by something, used with of.
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("irrespective"): Without considering or being affected by something, used with of.

ex.en: Everyone can join the walk, irrespective of their age.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "irrespective" (Từ vựng IELTS ("irrespective"): Without considering or being affected by something, used with of.) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Quality education should be available to all children, irrespective of their family income or social background.

en: to experience costs or something unpleasant because of your actions
vi: Hành động / quá trình (incur): to experience costs or something unpleasant because of your actions

ex.en: Late returns may incur an extra charge at this library.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "incur" (Hành động / quá trình (incur): to experience costs or something unpleasant because of your actions) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Businesses may incur substantial costs when replacing outdated equipment, but modern technology can improve productivity over time.

en: To pass material through a sieve to separate its parts.
vi: Hành động / quá trình (sift): To pass material through a sieve to separate its parts.

ex.en: Sift the flour before adding it to the bowl.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "sift" (Hành động / quá trình (sift): To pass material through a sieve to separate its parts.) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Researchers must sift through large amounts of evidence before drawing reliable conclusions about the causes of unemployment.

en: Wood cut into pieces for building, especially in American English.
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("lumber"): Wood cut into pieces for building, especially in American English.

ex.en: We bought some lumber to build a garden bench.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "lumber" (Từ vựng IELTS ("lumber"): Wood cut into pieces for building, especially in American English.) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Demand for sustainably sourced lumber can encourage forest owners to adopt more responsible management practices.

en: A tropical coastal tree with roots growing in salty water
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("mangrove"): A tropical coastal tree with roots growing in salty water

ex.en: Small fish sheltered among the roots of a mangrove.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "mangrove" (Từ vựng IELTS ("mangrove"): A tropical coastal tree with roots growing in salty water) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Mangrove forests protect coastal communities from storms while providing essential habitats for numerous marine species.

en: Force liquid out through a small opening in a narrow stream.
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("squirt"): Force liquid out through a small opening in a narrow stream.

ex.en: She squirted some lemon juice over the grilled fish.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "squirt" (Từ vựng IELTS ("squirt"): Force liquid out through a small opening in a narrow stream.) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Water-saving irrigation systems squirt small amounts of water directly onto roots, reducing waste in dry regions.

en: needing someone or something for support or success
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("reliant"): needing someone or something for support or success

ex.en: Without a car, we are reliant on local buses.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "reliant" (Từ vựng IELTS ("reliant"): needing someone or something for support or success) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Countries heavily reliant on imported fuel are particularly vulnerable to sudden changes in global energy prices.

en: To ignore something or treat it as unimportant.
vi: Hành động / quá trình (disregard): To ignore something or treat it as unimportant.

ex.en: Please disregard my earlier message; the picnic is still happening.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "disregard" (Hành động / quá trình (disregard): To ignore something or treat it as unimportant.) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Companies that disregard environmental regulations may reduce short-term costs but create lasting damage to local ecosystems.

en: Serious spoken or written discussion of a particular subject.
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("discourse"): Serious spoken or written discussion of a particular subject.

ex.en: Her lecture encouraged thoughtful discourse about local history.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "discourse" (Từ vựng IELTS ("discourse"): Serious spoken or written discussion of a particular subject.) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Public discourse on climate change increasingly focuses on practical solutions rather than distant predictions.

en: to be directly next to or share a boundary with something
vi: Hành động / quá trình (adjoin): to be directly next to or share a boundary with something

ex.en: Our garden adjoins a quiet park with tall oak trees.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "adjoin" (Hành động / quá trình (adjoin): to be directly next to or share a boundary with something) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Residential areas that adjoin industrial sites may require additional measures to protect residents from noise and pollution.

en: The highest level of success, achievement or development.
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("pinnacle"): The highest level of success, achievement or development.

ex.en: Winning the tournament was the pinnacle of her career.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "pinnacle" (Từ vựng IELTS ("pinnacle"): The highest level of success, achievement or development.) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: For many researchers, international recognition represents the pinnacle of a career devoted to scientific discovery.

en: To gradually disappear or cause something to spread and disappear.
vi: Hành động / quá trình (dissipate): To gradually disappear or cause something to spread and disappear.

ex.en: The morning mist began to dissipate as sunlight warmed the valley.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "dissipate" (Hành động / quá trình (dissipate): To gradually disappear or cause something to spread and disappear.) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Urban green spaces help dissipate heat, reducing the discomfort caused by high temperatures in densely populated areas.

en: serious danger or a situation involving serious danger
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("peril"): serious danger or a situation involving serious danger

ex.en: The sudden storm put the small boat in peril.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "peril" (Từ vựng IELTS ("peril"): serious danger or a situation involving serious danger) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Coastal communities face increasing peril as rising sea levels threaten their homes and essential infrastructure.

en: Relating to beauty or the appreciation of beautiful things.
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("aesthetic"): Relating to beauty or the appreciation of beautiful things.

ex.en: The wooden shelves give this room greater aesthetic appeal.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "aesthetic" (Từ vựng IELTS ("aesthetic"): Relating to beauty or the appreciation of beautiful things.) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Urban planners should consider both the practical function and aesthetic quality of public spaces.

en: The beginning of something, especially an official activity
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("commencement"): The beginning of something, especially an official activity

ex.en: We heard a whistle at the commencement of play.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "commencement" (Từ vựng IELTS ("commencement"): The beginning of something, especially an official activity) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Environmental assessments should be completed before the commencement of construction to minimise potential damage to local ecosystems.

en: Of excellent quality or exceptionally high ability.
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("first-rate"): Of excellent quality or exceptionally high ability.

ex.en: The small restaurant serves first-rate food at reasonable prices.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "first-rate" (Từ vựng IELTS ("first-rate"): Of excellent quality or exceptionally high ability.) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Access to first-rate training enables young workers to develop skills that employers increasingly value.

en: At the back of an animal's body, especially its legs.
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("hind"): At the back of an animal's body, especially its legs.

ex.en: The rabbit pushed off with its powerful hind legs.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "hind" (Từ vựng IELTS ("hind"): At the back of an animal's body, especially its legs.) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Kangaroos rely on their strong hind legs to travel efficiently across large areas in search of food.

en: best suited to achieving a particular result
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("optimum"): best suited to achieving a particular result

ex.en: This sunny windowsill provides optimum conditions for my herbs.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "optimum" (Từ vựng IELTS ("optimum"): best suited to achieving a particular result) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Maintaining the optimum classroom temperature can help students concentrate and reduce the energy required for heating.

en: having conflicting feelings about someone or something
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("ambivalent"): having conflicting feelings about someone or something

ex.en: I feel ambivalent about moving away from my family.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "ambivalent" (Từ vựng IELTS ("ambivalent"): having conflicting feelings about someone or something) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Many consumers remain ambivalent about online shopping because convenience must be balanced against concerns about privacy.

en: The ability to succeed against others in a market or activity.
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("competitiveness"): The ability to succeed against others in a market or activity.

ex.en: Fresh ingredients help our bakery maintain its competitiveness locally.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "competitiveness" (Từ vựng IELTS ("competitiveness"): The ability to succeed against others in a market or activity.) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Investment in workforce training can improve national competitiveness by increasing productivity and encouraging innovation across industries.

en: Complete and not damaged, altered, or missing any parts
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("intact"): Complete and not damaged, altered, or missing any parts

ex.en: The box was crushed, but the cups remained intact.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "intact" (Từ vựng IELTS ("intact"): Complete and not damaged, altered, or missing any parts) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Careful restoration allows historic buildings to remain intact while meeting the safety requirements of modern urban life.

en: easily affected or harmed by something
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("susceptible"): easily affected or harmed by something

ex.en: These young plants are particularly susceptible to frost damage.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "susceptible" (Từ vựng IELTS ("susceptible"): easily affected or harmed by something) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Children may be more susceptible to online advertising because they lack experience in evaluating commercial claims.

en: To change direction suddenly, especially to avoid hitting something.
vi: Hành động / quá trình (swerve): To change direction suddenly, especially to avoid hitting something.

ex.en: The cyclist swerved to avoid a branch on the road.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "swerve" (Hành động / quá trình (swerve): To change direction suddenly, especially to avoid hitting something.) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Poorly maintained roads may force drivers to swerve unexpectedly, increasing the risk of collisions with other vehicles.

en: Smaller in amount, degree, or importance
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("lesser"): Smaller in amount, degree, or importance

ex.en: We chose the lesser expense of repairing our sofa.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "lesser" (Từ vựng IELTS ("lesser"): Smaller in amount, degree, or importance) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Although funding matters, class size also influences educational outcomes, but usually to a lesser degree.

en: To make a mistake or an incorrect judgement.
vi: Hành động / quá trình (err): To make a mistake or an incorrect judgement.

ex.en: I erred by leaving the cake in too long.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "err" (Hành động / quá trình (err): To make a mistake or an incorrect judgement.) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Policymakers may err when they assume that economic growth automatically improves everyone's quality of life.

col: err on the side of caution

en: Lower in rank, authority, or importance.
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("subordinate"): Lower in rank, authority, or importance.

ex.en: She accepted a subordinate role on the project.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "subordinate" (Từ vựng IELTS ("subordinate"): Lower in rank, authority, or importance.) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: In effective organisations, subordinate staff should feel comfortable raising concerns with senior managers without fear.

en: Deeply and sincerely felt.
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("heartfelt"): Deeply and sincerely felt.

ex.en: She gave her neighbour a heartfelt hug before leaving.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "heartfelt" (Từ vựng IELTS ("heartfelt"): Deeply and sincerely felt.) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: A heartfelt apology can help restore public trust, but institutions must also demonstrate a genuine commitment to change.

en: To force someone out of a position or place.
vi: Hành động / quá trình (oust): To force someone out of a position or place.

ex.en: Club members voted to oust their unpopular chair.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "oust" (Hành động / quá trình (oust): To force someone out of a position or place.) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Shareholders may seek to oust company directors who repeatedly fail to meet environmental commitments or financial targets.

en: a careful judgment of quality, performance, or a situation
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("appraisal"): a careful judgment of quality, performance, or a situation

ex.en: My manager praised my progress during today's performance appraisal.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "appraisal" (Từ vựng IELTS ("appraisal"): a careful judgment of quality, performance, or a situation) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: A thorough appraisal of environmental risks should take place before any major construction project begins.

en: Able to work or exist together without problems
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("compatible"): Able to work or exist together without problems

ex.en: This charger is compatible with both of our tablets.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "compatible" (Từ vựng IELTS ("compatible"): Able to work or exist together without problems) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Economic growth can be compatible with environmental protection if governments encourage cleaner production and responsible resource use.

en: Happening repeatedly, often with short breaks.
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("continual"): Happening repeatedly, often with short breaks.

ex.en: The continual interruptions made it hard to finish cooking.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "continual" (Từ vựng IELTS ("continual"): Happening repeatedly, often with short breaks.) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Continual changes in education policy can prevent teachers from developing effective long-term approaches to classroom learning.

en: A detailed list of items owned or stored somewhere.
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("inventory"): A detailed list of items owned or stored somewhere.

ex.en: We made an inventory of everything in the garage.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "inventory" (Từ vựng IELTS ("inventory"): A detailed list of items owned or stored somewhere.) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Digital systems help retailers manage inventory more efficiently, reducing waste and preventing shortages of essential products.

en: a long, soft worm that lives in soil
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("earthworm"): a long, soft worm that lives in soil

ex.en: An earthworm wriggled out of the wet garden soil.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "earthworm" (Từ vựng IELTS ("earthworm"): a long, soft worm that lives in soil) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Earthworms improve soil structure by creating tunnels that allow air and water to move more freely.

en: remaining after most of something has gone or been removed
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("residual"): remaining after most of something has gone or been removed

ex.en: Residual heat kept the kitchen warm after dinner.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "residual" (Từ vựng IELTS ("residual"): remaining after most of something has gone or been removed) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Residual chemicals in agricultural soil may affect water quality long after farmers stop using them.

en: a written record of words spoken in a conversation or recording
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("transcript"): a written record of words spoken in a conversation or recording

ex.en: I read the transcript while listening to the interview.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "transcript" (Từ vựng IELTS ("transcript"): a written record of words spoken in a conversation or recording) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Researchers checked each interview transcript carefully before analysing participants' views on public transport services.

en: The person someone is married to.
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("spouse"): The person someone is married to.

ex.en: Each employee can bring their spouse to dinner.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "spouse" (Từ vựng IELTS ("spouse"): The person someone is married to.) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Flexible working arrangements can help employees share childcare responsibilities more equally with their spouses.

en: A proposed explanation that can be tested through research
vi: Giả thuyết khoa học

ex.en: Our experiment tested the hypothesis that plants prefer sunlight.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "hypothesis" (Giả thuyết khoa học) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Researchers tested the hypothesis that regular physical activity improves concentration among children in primary education.

en: A rented room used for both living and sleeping.
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("bedsit"): A rented room used for both living and sleeping.

ex.en: He rented a small bedsit close to the station.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "bedsit" (Từ vựng IELTS ("bedsit"): A rented room used for both living and sleeping.) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: For students with limited budgets, a bedsit may provide affordable accommodation near a university campus.

en: Spreading widely and uncontrollably, especially when harmful.
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("rampant"): Spreading widely and uncontrollably, especially when harmful.

ex.en: Rampant weeds have taken over our vegetable patch.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "rampant" (Từ vựng IELTS ("rampant"): Spreading widely and uncontrollably, especially when harmful.) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Where oversight is weak, rampant corruption can undermine public trust and divert resources away from essential services.

en: Improve something by making small, careful changes
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("refine"): Improve something by making small, careful changes

ex.en: I refined my recipe by adding less sugar.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "refine" (Từ vựng IELTS ("refine"): Improve something by making small, careful changes) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Schools can refine their teaching methods by collecting regular feedback from students with different learning needs.

en: to fill someone's mind so they cannot think of anything else
vi: Hành động / quá trình (obsess): to fill someone's mind so they cannot think of anything else

ex.en: Don't obsess over every tiny mark on your shoes.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "obsess" (Hành động / quá trình (obsess): to fill someone's mind so they cannot think of anything else) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Some students obsess over examination results, neglecting the broader skills that education should develop.

en: someone who works in a profession, especially medicine
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("practitioner"): someone who works in a profession, especially medicine

ex.en: The nurse suggested speaking to a qualified medical practitioner.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "practitioner" (Từ vựng IELTS ("practitioner"): someone who works in a profession, especially medicine) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Experienced practitioners should help design training programmes so that graduates develop skills relevant to their profession.

en: very fierce, violent, or aggressive
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("ferocious"): very fierce, violent, or aggressive

ex.en: The ferocious dog growled from behind the locked gate.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "ferocious" (Từ vựng IELTS ("ferocious"): very fierce, violent, or aggressive) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Ferocious competition in the technology sector can encourage innovation but also threaten the survival of smaller firms.

en: Full of conflict, uncertainty, or sudden disruptive changes.
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("turbulent"): Full of conflict, uncertainty, or sudden disruptive changes.

ex.en: After a turbulent week, our family needed a quiet evening.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "turbulent" (Từ vựng IELTS ("turbulent"): Full of conflict, uncertainty, or sudden disruptive changes.) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: During turbulent economic periods, governments may increase public spending to protect jobs and support vulnerable households.

en: Cancel the effect or value of something.
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("negate"): Cancel the effect or value of something.

ex.en: The delivery fee negated the savings on our groceries.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "negate" (Từ vựng IELTS ("negate"): Cancel the effect or value of something.) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Increased energy consumption may negate the environmental benefits of replacing older appliances with more efficient models.

en: agreed on by every person in a group
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("unanimous"): agreed on by every person in a group

ex.en: Our family was unanimous about adopting the little cat.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "unanimous" (Từ vựng IELTS ("unanimous"): agreed on by every person in a group) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: The committee reached a unanimous decision to improve public transport rather than expand the existing road network.

en: A special disc or voucher used instead of money.
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("token"): A special disc or voucher used instead of money.

ex.en: I dropped a token into the machine and played.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "token" (Từ vựng IELTS ("token"): A special disc or voucher used instead of money.) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Critics argue that token environmental measures cannot address the scale of pollution in rapidly expanding cities.

en: To make a long, sharp sound like escaping steam.
vi: Hành động / quá trình (hiss): To make a long, sharp sound like escaping steam.

ex.en: The cat hissed when the puppy came too close.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "hiss" (Hành động / quá trình (hiss): To make a long, sharp sound like escaping steam.) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Engineers investigated a persistent hiss from the heating system to identify possible leaks and prevent energy waste.

en: the act of identifying something's cause, creator, or source
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("attribution"): the act of identifying something's cause, creator, or source

ex.en: Please include an attribution when you share my photograph.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "attribution" (Từ vựng IELTS ("attribution"): the act of identifying something's cause, creator, or source) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Accurate attribution of environmental damage to specific industries is essential for developing fair and effective regulations.

en: A powerful, addictive stimulant drug derived from coca leaves.
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("cocaine"): A powerful, addictive stimulant drug derived from coca leaves.

ex.en: The nurse explained why cocaine can seriously harm the heart.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "cocaine" (Từ vựng IELTS ("cocaine"): A powerful, addictive stimulant drug derived from coca leaves.) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Public health programmes should combine education about cocaine with accessible treatment for people experiencing addiction.

en: A shellfish with two joined shells, often living buried in sand.
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("clam"): A shellfish with two joined shells, often living buried in sand.

ex.en: We found a clam buried in the wet sand.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "clam" (Từ vựng IELTS ("clam"): A shellfish with two joined shells, often living buried in sand.) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Clam farming can support coastal economies, but poor water quality may threaten both shellfish and consumers.

en: someone behaving in an extremely wild or reckless way
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("maniac"): someone behaving in an extremely wild or reckless way

ex.en: That driver is a maniac, speeding around every corner.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "maniac" (Từ vựng IELTS ("maniac"): someone behaving in an extremely wild or reckless way) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Calling a reckless driver a maniac expresses anger but does little to explain the causes of dangerous driving.

en: allowing learners to choose and use materials independently
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("self-access"): allowing learners to choose and use materials independently

ex.en: Our library has a quiet self-access learning area.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "self-access" (Từ vựng IELTS ("self-access"): allowing learners to choose and use materials independently) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Self-access centres encourage students to take responsibility for their progress by selecting materials suited to their needs.

en: offensively sexual in a way considered unacceptable
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("obscene"): offensively sexual in a way considered unacceptable

ex.en: The moderator removed an obscene comment from the chat.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "obscene" (Từ vựng IELTS ("obscene"): offensively sexual in a way considered unacceptable) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Critics argue that obscene executive bonuses are difficult to justify when ordinary workers face wage cuts.

en: To throw or move something suddenly and forcefully.
vi: Hành động / quá trình (fling): To throw or move something suddenly and forcefully.

ex.en: He flung his muddy boots into the empty bucket.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "fling" (Hành động / quá trình (fling): To throw or move something suddenly and forcefully.) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: During severe storms, powerful winds can fling loose debris across roads, creating serious hazards for drivers and pedestrians.

en: Give someone confidence or control over their own life.
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("empower"): Give someone confidence or control over their own life.

ex.en: Learning to cook empowered him to live independently.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "empower" (Từ vựng IELTS ("empower"): Give someone confidence or control over their own life.) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Access to reliable information can empower citizens to make informed decisions about their health.

en: To gradually take over another's space, time, or rights.
vi: Hành động / quá trình (encroach): To gradually take over another's space, time, or rights.

ex.en: The neighbour's bushes are beginning to encroach on our garden.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "encroach" (Hành động / quá trình (encroach): To gradually take over another's space, time, or rights.) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: As new housing developments encroach on wetlands, local wildlife loses essential breeding grounds and sources of food.

en: A formal written request, often supported by many people's signatures.
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("petition"): A formal written request, often supported by many people's signatures.

ex.en: Our neighbours signed a petition to save the playground.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "petition" (Từ vựng IELTS ("petition"): A formal written request, often supported by many people's signatures.) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Residents submitted a petition asking the council to improve public transport in areas outside the city centre.

en: Loud noise or strong public demands
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("clamor"): Loud noise or strong public demands

ex.en: The children clamored for another story before bedtime.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "clamor" (Từ vựng IELTS ("clamor"): Loud noise or strong public demands) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Public clamor for cleaner air has encouraged local authorities to invest in more reliable public transport.

en: Friendly, pleasant, and easy to get along with.
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("amiable"): Friendly, pleasant, and easy to get along with.

ex.en: Our amiable neighbour always stops to chat by the gate.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "amiable" (Từ vựng IELTS ("amiable"): Friendly, pleasant, and easy to get along with.) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: An amiable manner can help healthcare professionals build trust with patients from diverse cultural backgrounds.

en: impossible or very difficult to read because of unclear writing
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("illegible"): impossible or very difficult to read because of unclear writing

ex.en: Rain had made the address on the envelope illegible.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "illegible" (Từ vựng IELTS ("illegible"): impossible or very difficult to read because of unclear writing) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Illegible handwriting on medical forms can cause errors that put patient safety at risk.

en: An official authorised to witness signatures and certify documents.
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("notary"): An official authorised to witness signatures and certify documents.

ex.en: We signed the property documents in front of a notary.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "notary" (Từ vựng IELTS ("notary"): An official authorised to witness signatures and certify documents.) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: A notary can verify signatures on legal documents, helping reduce the risk of fraud in property transactions.

en: The state of not working or doing anything.
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("idleness"): The state of not working or doing anything.

ex.en: After weeks of idleness, I finally cleaned the garage.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "idleness" (Từ vựng IELTS ("idleness"): The state of not working or doing anything.) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Long periods of enforced idleness during unemployment can damage confidence and make returning to work more difficult.

en: Having weather that is neither very hot nor very cold
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("temperate"): Having weather that is neither very hot nor very cold

ex.en: We enjoy walking outdoors in this temperate climate.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "temperate" (Từ vựng IELTS ("temperate"): Having weather that is neither very hot nor very cold) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Temperate regions may experience significant changes in rainfall patterns as global temperatures continue to rise.

en: feeding on plants rather than other animals
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("herbivorous"): feeding on plants rather than other animals

ex.en: These herbivorous lizards enjoy fresh leaves from our garden.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "herbivorous" (Từ vựng IELTS ("herbivorous"): feeding on plants rather than other animals) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Herbivorous animals influence forest growth by consuming young plants and spreading seeds through their droppings.

en: A building where harvested grain is stored.
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("granary"): A building where harvested grain is stored.

ex.en: The farmer carried another sack of wheat into the granary.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "granary" (Từ vựng IELTS ("granary"): A building where harvested grain is stored.) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: A well-maintained granary can protect harvested crops from moisture and reduce food losses in rural communities.

en: the quality of being unreasonable, ridiculous, or illogical
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("absurdity"): the quality of being unreasonable, ridiculous, or illogical

ex.en: We laughed at the absurdity of wearing coats indoors.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "absurdity" (Từ vựng IELTS ("absurdity"): the quality of being unreasonable, ridiculous, or illogical) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Critics highlighted the absurdity of building more roads while claiming to reduce dependence on private cars.

en: Not likely to cause harm or offend anyone.
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("innocuous"): Not likely to cause harm or offend anyone.

ex.en: Her question seemed innocuous, so I answered without hesitation.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "innocuous" (Từ vựng IELTS ("innocuous"): Not likely to cause harm or offend anyone.) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Seemingly innocuous household products can damage aquatic ecosystems when large quantities enter rivers through wastewater.

en: A perfectly round solid shape, like a ball.
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("sphere"): A perfectly round solid shape, like a ball.

ex.en: She rolled the clay into a smooth sphere.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "sphere" (Từ vựng IELTS ("sphere"): A perfectly round solid shape, like a ball.) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Digital technology has expanded the sphere of education beyond classrooms, allowing students to learn almost anywhere.

en: Burning or shining brightly.
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("alight"): Burning or shining brightly.

ex.en: The candles were still alight when we arrived.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "alight" (Từ vựng IELTS ("alight"): Burning or shining brightly.) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Passengers should wait until the bus has stopped completely before they alight from the vehicle.

en: having little importance or seriousness
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("trivial"): having little importance or seriousness

ex.en: We wasted the afternoon arguing over a trivial detail.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "trivial" (Từ vựng IELTS ("trivial"): having little importance or seriousness) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Public debates sometimes focus on trivial disagreements rather than the urgent environmental problems affecting future generations.

en: A promise intended to remove doubt or worry.
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("assurance"): A promise intended to remove doubt or worry.

ex.en: She gave me her assurance that dinner was ready.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "assurance" (Từ vựng IELTS ("assurance"): A promise intended to remove doubt or worry.) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Residents sought an assurance from the council that the new development would not reduce access to public parks.

en: A poisonous, silver-coloured metal that is liquid at room temperature.
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("mercury"): A poisonous, silver-coloured metal that is liquid at room temperature.

ex.en: This old thermometer contains mercury, so handle it carefully.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "mercury" (Từ vựng IELTS ("mercury"): A poisonous, silver-coloured metal that is liquid at room temperature.) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Industrial mercury pollution can accumulate in fish and pose serious risks to human health.

en: Present but not yet active, visible, or fully developed.
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("latent"): Present but not yet active, visible, or fully developed.

ex.en: Her first pottery class revealed a latent artistic talent.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "latent" (Từ vựng IELTS ("latent"): Present but not yet active, visible, or fully developed.) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Supportive teaching can help students develop latent abilities that conventional examinations may fail to identify.

en: To encourage action or cause something to develop faster
vi: Hành động / quá trình (spur): To encourage action or cause something to develop faster

ex.en: Her friend's encouragement spurred her to finish the race.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "spur" (Hành động / quá trình (spur): To encourage action or cause something to develop faster) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Investment in reliable public transport can spur economic growth by connecting workers with a wider range of jobs.

col: on the spur of the moment

en: severe physical pain or mental suffering
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("torment"): severe physical pain or mental suffering

ex.en: The constant itching was a torment all night.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "torment" (Từ vựng IELTS ("torment"): severe physical pain or mental suffering) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Persistent uncertainty about employment can torment workers and undermine their mental health over time.

en: Having more than one possible meaning or interpretation
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("ambiguous"): Having more than one possible meaning or interpretation

ex.en: His ambiguous reply left us unsure whether to come.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "ambiguous" (Từ vựng IELTS ("ambiguous"): Having more than one possible meaning or interpretation) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Ambiguous wording in public health advice can confuse readers and reduce their confidence in official guidance.

en: an unusual habit or feature of someone or something
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("quirk"): an unusual habit or feature of someone or something

ex.en: One of her quirks is sorting socks by colour.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "quirk" (Từ vựng IELTS ("quirk"): an unusual habit or feature of someone or something) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: A quirk of the housing market has left some coastal villages cheaper than nearby inland towns.

en: to follow a rule, agreement, or decision
vi: Hành động / quá trình (abide): to follow a rule, agreement, or decision

ex.en: Everyone using the pool must abide by its rules.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "abide" (Hành động / quá trình (abide): to follow a rule, agreement, or decision) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Companies should abide by environmental regulations even when doing so increases their production costs.

en: A system or device sending messages electrically along wires.
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("telegraph"): A system or device sending messages electrically along wires.

ex.en: The museum guide demonstrated how the old telegraph worked.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "telegraph" (Từ vựng IELTS ("telegraph"): A system or device sending messages electrically along wires.) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: The telegraph transformed international communication by allowing information to travel much faster than physical mail.

en: to measure or express the amount of something
vi: Hành động / quá trình (quantify): to measure or express the amount of something

ex.en: This app helps me quantify how much water I drink.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "quantify" (Hành động / quá trình (quantify): to measure or express the amount of something) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Researchers find it difficult to quantify the long-term social benefits of investing in public libraries.

en: A tall grass with stiff stems growing near water
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("reed"): A tall grass with stiff stems growing near water

ex.en: A small bird balanced on a reed beside the pond.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "reed" (Từ vựng IELTS ("reed"): A tall grass with stiff stems growing near water) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Reed beds provide shelter for wetland wildlife and can help remove pollutants from water flowing through them.

en: working hard and carefully over a sustained period
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("industrious"): working hard and carefully over a sustained period

ex.en: My industrious neighbour grows vegetables and repairs furniture every weekend.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "industrious" (Từ vựng IELTS ("industrious"): working hard and carefully over a sustained period) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Although industrious employees contribute greatly to productivity, employers must also provide adequate training and reasonable working conditions.

en: to encourage something to develop or grow
vi: Thúc đẩy, nuôi dưỡng, khuyến khích phát triển

ex.en: Shared meals foster closer friendships among our neighbours.
ex.vi: Các hoạt động ngoại khóa giúp nuôi dưỡng tinh thần làm việc nhóm ở trẻ nhỏ.

ex.en: Schools can foster creativity by allowing students to explore problems without prescribing a single solution.
ex.vi: Trao đổi văn hóa quốc tế góp phần thúc đẩy sự thấu hiểu lẫn nhau giữa các dân tộc.

col: foster creativity — nuôi dưỡng sự sáng tạo
foster cooperation — thúc đẩy hợp tác
foster a sense of community — xây dựng tinh thần cộng đồng
tip: Động từ C1 cực đẹp để thay cho "encourage" hoặc "promote".

en: A small earthquake or a brief shaking movement.
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("tremor"): A small earthquake or a brief shaking movement.

ex.en: A slight tremor made the cups rattle on their hooks.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "tremor" (Từ vựng IELTS ("tremor"): A small earthquake or a brief shaking movement.) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Sensitive monitoring equipment can detect a minor tremor that people living nearby may not notice.

en: A medical doctor, especially one treating illness without surgery.
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("physician"): A medical doctor, especially one treating illness without surgery.

ex.en: The physician listened carefully as I described my symptoms.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "physician" (Từ vựng IELTS ("physician"): A medical doctor, especially one treating illness without surgery.) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Access to a qualified physician remains limited in remote areas, contributing to significant inequalities in healthcare.

en: To put something valuable at risk of harm or loss.
vi: Hành động / quá trình (jeopardize): To put something valuable at risk of harm or loss.

ex.en: Skipping these safety checks could jeopardize the whole trip.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "jeopardize" (Hành động / quá trình (jeopardize): To put something valuable at risk of harm or loss.) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Excessive use of groundwater could jeopardize future food production in regions already affected by drought.

en: an explanation that makes something clearer or easier to understand
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("clarification"): an explanation that makes something clearer or easier to understand

ex.en: I asked for clarification before signing the rental agreement.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "clarification" (Từ vựng IELTS ("clarification"): an explanation that makes something clearer or easier to understand) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Students benefit from clarification of assessment criteria before they begin complex research assignments at university.

en: great energy and enthusiasm for an activity or cause
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("zeal"): great energy and enthusiasm for an activity or cause

ex.en: She tackled the garden cleanup with remarkable zeal.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "zeal" (Từ vựng IELTS ("zeal"): great energy and enthusiasm for an activity or cause) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Volunteers' zeal can strengthen community projects, but sustained progress also requires reliable funding and professional support.

en: Contracts to trade assets later at prices agreed now.
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("futures"): Contracts to trade assets later at prices agreed now.

ex.en: My cousin trades wheat futures from her home office.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "futures" (Từ vựng IELTS ("futures"): Contracts to trade assets later at prices agreed now.) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Farmers can use futures to protect themselves against falling crop prices, although these contracts also involve financial risks.

en: A surprising fact that becomes known.
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("revelation"): A surprising fact that becomes known.

ex.en: His revelation about the hidden garden surprised us all.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "revelation" (Từ vựng IELTS ("revelation"): A surprising fact that becomes known.) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Recent revelations about industrial pollution have increased public pressure for stricter environmental regulations and greater corporate transparency.

en: Money paid beyond the amount owed, or paying too much
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("overpayment"): Money paid beyond the amount owed, or paying too much

ex.en: The cashier returned my overpayment before I left.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "overpayment" (Từ vựng IELTS ("overpayment"): Money paid beyond the amount owed, or paying too much) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Clear payroll procedures can prevent accidental overpayment and reduce disputes between employers and their staff.

en: Showing great happiness through your face or appearance.
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("radiant"): Showing great happiness through your face or appearance.

ex.en: She looked radiant as she held her newborn baby.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "radiant" (Từ vựng IELTS ("radiant"): Showing great happiness through your face or appearance.) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Buildings can use radiant heating systems to maintain comfortable indoor temperatures during the winter months.

en: following one after another without a break
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("successive"): following one after another without a break

ex.en: Heavy rain kept us indoors for three successive days.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "successive" (Từ vựng IELTS ("successive"): following one after another without a break) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Successive governments have invested in public transport, but rural communities still lack reliable bus services.

en: Separate and distinct rather than joined or continuous.
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("discrete"): Separate and distinct rather than joined or continuous.

ex.en: We divided the project into three discrete tasks.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "discrete" (Từ vựng IELTS ("discrete"): Separate and distinct rather than joined or continuous.) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Researchers classified participants into discrete groups to compare the effects of different teaching methods.

en: To treat people cruelly because of their beliefs or identity.
vi: Hành động / quá trình (persecute): To treat people cruelly because of their beliefs or identity.

ex.en: Her grandparents were persecuted because of their religious beliefs.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "persecute" (Hành động / quá trình (persecute): To treat people cruelly because of their beliefs or identity.) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Governments must protect minority communities and ensure that nobody is persecuted for peacefully expressing their beliefs.

en: the joining of different things into a single whole
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("fusion"): the joining of different things into a single whole

ex.en: Her cooking is a fusion of different regional styles.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "fusion" (Từ vựng IELTS ("fusion"): the joining of different things into a single whole) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Scientists are investigating nuclear fusion as a potential source of abundant energy with low carbon emissions.

en: The wide range of things something includes.
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("breadth"): The wide range of things something includes.

ex.en: The breadth of her interests always surprises her friends.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "breadth" (Từ vựng IELTS ("breadth"): The wide range of things something includes.) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Universities should balance breadth of knowledge with opportunities for students to develop expertise in a chosen field.

en: To make a liquid weaker by adding water or another liquid.
vi: Hành động / quá trình (dilute): To make a liquid weaker by adding water or another liquid.

ex.en: Dilute the juice with water before giving it to children.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "dilute" (Hành động / quá trình (dilute): To make a liquid weaker by adding water or another liquid.) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Excessive commercial involvement may dilute the educational value of programmes designed for young television viewers.

en: A person who is kept in a prison.
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("inmate"): A person who is kept in a prison.

ex.en: Each inmate can borrow books from the prison library.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "inmate" (Từ vựng IELTS ("inmate"): A person who is kept in a prison.) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Providing inmates with vocational training may improve their employment prospects and reduce the risk of reoffending.

en: A strong feeling that someone or something deserves no respect
vi: Từ vựng IELTS ("contempt"): A strong feeling that someone or something deserves no respect

ex.en: He showed contempt for my suggestion by laughing.
ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "contempt" (Từ vựng IELTS ("contempt"): A strong feeling that someone or something deserves no respect) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: When officials treat public concerns with contempt, trust in democratic institutions can decline significantly.

en: so attractive that you cannot refuse or avoid it

ex.vi: Ứng dụng từ "sclerosis" (Từ vựng IELTS ("sclerosis"): Abnormal hardening of tissue within the body.) trong ngữ cảnh câu học thuật IELTS.

ex.en: Multiple sclerosis affects the central nervous system, and its symptoms can vary considerably between individuals.

en: To restrict someone's freedom or ability to act.
vi: Hành động / quá trình (fetter): To restrict someone's freedom or ability to act.
